```html
    $("ck1").checked = true; armClear();
  });
  if (navigator.share) { $("btnShareReport").hidden = false; $("btnShareCsv").hidden = false; }
  $("btnShareReport").addEventListener("click", function () { if (!report) return; share("v60-health-" + stamp() + ".json", reportJSON(), "application/json").then(function () { $("ck1").checked = true; armClear(); }).catch(function () {}); });

  /* ---------------- live data ---------------- */
  var live = { on: false, rows: [], t0: 0, sel: {} };
  PIDS.forEach(function (p) { live.sel[p.pid] = p.on; });
  function renderPicks() {
    $("picks").innerHTML = PIDS.map(function (p) {
      var ok = pidSupported(p.pid);
      return '<label class="' + (ok ? "" : "na") + '"><input type="checkbox" data-pid="' + p.pid + '"' + (live.sel[p.pid] && ok ? " checked" : "") + (ok ? "" : " disabled") + "> " + esc(p.n) + (ok ? "" : " (not supported)") + "</label>";
    }).join("");
    $("tiles").innerHTML = PIDS.filter(function (p) { return live.sel[p.pid] && pidSupported(p.pid); }).map(function (p) { return '<div class="tile"><div class="k">' + esc(p.n) + '</div><div><span class="v" id="tv' + p.pid + '">--</span><span class="u">' + esc(p.us === "F" ? "°F" : (p.us === "mph" ? "mph" : p.u)) + "</span></div></div>"; }).join("");
  }
  $("picks").addEventListener("change", function (e) { var pid = +e.target.getAttribute("data-pid"); if (pid) { live.sel[pid] = e.target.checked; if (!live.on) renderPicks(); } });
  function shown(p, v) { if (p.us === "F") return Math.round(v * 1.8 + 32); if (p.us === "mph") return Math.round(v * 0.621371); return v.toFixed(p.d); }
  function stopLive() { live.on = false; $("btnLive").textContent = "Start recording"; }
  function loop() {
    var pids = PIDS.filter(function (p) { return live.sel[p.pid] && pidSupported(p.pid); });
    if (!pids.length) { stopLive(); $("liveStatus").textContent = "Pick at least one supported channel."; return; }
    (function pass() {
      if (!live.on || !link) { stopLive(); return; }
      var row = { t: (Date.now() - live.t0) / 1000 };
      pids.reduce(function (p, pd) { return p.then(function () { if (!live.on) return; return readPid(pd.pid).then(function (d) { if (d) { var v = pd.f(d[0], d[1]); row[pd.pid] = v; var el = $("tv" + pd.pid); if (el) el.textContent = shown(pd, v); } }).catch(function () {}); }); }, Promise.resolve())
        .then(function () {
          live.rows.push(row);
          var dur = row.t, rate = live.rows.length / Math.max(dur, 0.1);
          $("liveStatus").textContent = live.rows.length + " samples, " + Math.floor(dur / 60) + ":" + String(Math.floor(dur % 60)).padStart(2, "0") + ", " + rate.toFixed(1) + " per second";
          $("btnCsv").disabled = live.rows.length < 5;
          if (live.rows.length > 30000) { stopLive(); $("liveStatus").textContent += ". Stopped at the 30,000-sample limit. Save the CSV."; return; }
          setTimeout(pass, 0);
        });
    })();
  }
  $("btnLive").addEventListener("click", function () {
    if (live.on) { stopLive(); return; }
    if (live.rows.length && !window.__keepRows) live.rows = [];
    renderPicks(); live.on = true; live.t0 = Date.now(); $("btnLive").textContent = "Stop recording"; $("btnCsv").disabled = true; loop();
  });
  function csv() {
    var used = PIDS.filter(function (p) { return live.rows.some(function (r) { return isNum(r[p.pid]); }); });
    var lines = ["Time (s)," + used.map(function (p) { return p.col; }).join(",")];
    live.rows.forEach(function (r) { lines.push(r.t.toFixed(2) + "," + used.map(function (p) { return isNum(r[p.pid]) ? +r[p.pid].toFixed(3) : ""; }).join(",")); });
    return lines.join("\n");
  }
  $("btnCsv").addEventListener("click", function () { download("v60-log-" + stamp() + ".csv", csv(), "text/csv"); });
  $("btnShareCsv").addEventListener("click", function () { if (live.rows.length >= 5) share("v60-log-" + stamp() + ".csv", csv(), "text/csv").catch(function () {}); });

  /* ---------------- clear codes ---------------- */
  function armClear() {
    var ready = !!(report && link);
    ["ck1", "ck2", "ck3", "ck4"].forEach(function (id) { $(id).disabled = !ready || id === "ck1"; });
    var all = ready && ["ck1", "ck2", "ck3", "ck4"].every(function (id) { return $(id).checked; });
    $("clearWord").disabled = !all;
    $("btnClear").disabled = !(all && $("clearWord").value.trim().toUpperCase() === "CLEAR");
  }
  ["ck2", "ck3", "ck4"].forEach(function (id) { $(id).addEventListener("change", armClear); });
  $("clearWord").addEventListener("input", armClear);
  $("btnClear").addEventListener("click", function () {
    $("btnClear").disabled = true; $("clearStatus").textContent = "Checking that the engine is off...";
    stopLive();
    readPid(0x0C).then(function (d) {
      var rpm = d ? (256 * d[0] + d[1]) / 4 : 0;
      if (rpm > 50) throw new Error("The engine is running (" + Math.round(rpm) + " rpm). Turn it off, leave the ignition on, and try again.");
      $("clearStatus").textContent = "Sending clear command...";
      return query("04", 8000);
    }).then(function (res) {
      var okE = res.filter(function (r) { return r.data; }).map(function (r) { return ecuName(r.ecu); });
      var neg = res.filter(function (r) { return r.neg != null; });
      if (!okE.length) throw new Error(neg.length ? "The car refused the request (code " + hex2(neg[0].neg) + "). Usually that means the engine is running or the conditions are not right." : "No module confirmed the clear.");
      $("clearStatus").textContent = "Cleared by: " + okE.join(", ") + ". Running a new health check...";
      $("clearWord").value = ""; ["ck2", "ck3", "ck4"].forEach(function (id) { $(id).checked = false; });
      return sleep(800).then(runScan).then(function () { $("clearStatus").textContent = "Cleared by " + okE.join(", ") + ". Readiness now shows what still has to rerun. Drive normally, with a mix of city and highway, over the next few days."; });
    }).catch(function (e) { $("clearStatus").textContent = (e && e.message) || "Clear failed."; armClear(); });
  });

  function logText() { return logLines.join("\n") || "(empty log)"; }
  function copyLog(btn) {
    var text = logText(), label = btn ? btn.textContent : "";
    var done = function (okk) { if (btn) { btn.textContent = okk ? "Copied" : "Copy failed: use Share or select the text"; setTimeout(function () { btn.textContent = label; }, okk ? 1500 : 4000); } };

  $("btnCopyLog").addEventListener("click", function () { copyLog(this); });
  $("btnCopyLog2").addEventListener("click", function () { $("logBox").open = true; copyLog(this); });
  $("btnDlLog").addEventListener("click", function () { download("v60-adapter-log-" + stamp() + ".txt", logText(), "text/plain"); });
  if (navigator.share) {
    $("btnShareLog").hidden = false;
    $("btnShareLog").addEventListener("click", function () {
      var text = logText(), name = "v60-adapter-log-" + stamp() + ".txt";
      share(name, text, "text/plain").catch(function () {});
    });
  }
  $("btnClearLog").addEventListener("click", function () { logLines = []; showLog(); try { localStorage.removeItem(LOG_KEY); } catch (e) {} });

  window.__link = { parseResponse: parseResponse, dtcsFrom: dtcsFrom, decodeDTC: decodeDTC, SimTransport: SimTransport, csv: csv, live: live, getReport: function () { return report; }, sim: function () { return link; } };
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

### `src/css/app.css`

```css

/* Theme: a workshop manual. Paper and ink, hairline rules, numbered sections, mono numbers.
   One accent, amber, which only ever means "new". Teal stays for instrument traces (Live link, Data lab). */
:root {
  --bg: #F3F0E8;
  --panel: #FBF9F4;
  --panel2: #E8E4DA;
  --ink: #1B1D1F;
  --muted: #5F5C55;
  --line: #D9D4C7;
  --accent: #1B1D1F;
  --accent-ink: #F3F0E8;
  --teal: #1F6F7A;
  --hl: #F0B27A;
  --hl-ink: #1B1D1F;
  --new: #D9731A; --new-ink: #B85C0E; --new-bg: #F7E3CE;
  --done: #2E6B5E;
  --ok: #2E6B5E; --ok-bg: #DCE9E3;
  --warn: #8A5A00; --warn-bg: #F3E6C6;
  --bad: #9B2C1F; --bad-bg: #F2D9D4;
  --none: #6B6861; --none-bg: #E8E4DA;
  --font-display: "Barlow Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif;
  --font-body: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-data: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace;
  --r-lg: 4px; --r-md: 3px; --r-sm: 2px;
  color-scheme: light;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]) {
    --bg: #15171A; --panel: #1D2024; --panel2: #262A2F; --ink: #ECE8DF; --muted: #A39E93; --line: #33373D;
    --accent: #ECE8DF; --accent-ink: #15171A; --teal: #5FB3BE; --hl: #8A4F17; --hl-ink: #ECE8DF;
    --new: #E8893A; --new-ink: #F0A868; --new-bg: #3A2A1A; --done: #7FC2B0;
    --ok: #7FC2B0; --ok-bg: #1C3A33; --warn: #E6B35A; --warn-bg: #3A2F14; --bad: #F08A7B; --bad-bg: #42201B; --none: #8E8A80; --none-bg: #262A2F;
    color-scheme: dark;
  }
}
:root[data-theme="dark"] {
  --bg: #15171A; --panel: #1D2024; --panel2: #262A2F; --ink: #ECE8DF; --muted: #A39E93; --line: #33373D;
  --accent: #ECE8DF; --accent-ink: #15171A; --teal: #5FB3BE; --hl: #8A4F17; --hl-ink: #ECE8DF;
  --new: #E8893A; --new-ink: #F0A868; --new-bg: #3A2A1A; --done: #7FC2B0;
  --ok: #7FC2B0; --ok-bg: #1C3A33; --warn: #E6B35A; --warn-bg: #3A2F14; --bad: #F08A7B; --bad-bg: #42201B; --none: #8E8A80; --none-bg: #262A2F;
  color-scheme: dark;
}
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
body { background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.55; padding-inline: 16px; padding-block: 18px 56px; }
main { max-width: 960px; margin-inline: auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 22px; }
h1, h2, h3, h4 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; margin: 0; text-wrap: balance; }
h1 { font-size: clamp(34px, 7vw, 52px); line-height: 0.95; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .01em; }
h2 { font-size: 30px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 700; }
h3 { font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.1; }
h4 { font-size: 15px; font-family: var(--font-data); font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--muted); }
p { margin: 0; max-width: 68ch; }
a { color: var(--accent); }
a:focus-visible, button:focus-visible, input:focus-visible, select:focus-visible, textarea:focus-visible, summary:focus-visible, .pin:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
.eyebrow { font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }

.top { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px 24px; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; }

.plate b { font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted); margin-right: 6px; }
.hud { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-end; }
.chip { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel); border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 12px; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; color: var(--ink); text-align: left; }
.chip .k { font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
.chip .v { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 30px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 600; }
.tabs { display: flex; gap: 2px; overflow-x: auto; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.tabs button { background: transparent; color: var(--muted); border: 0; border-bottom: 3px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; padding: 10px 14px; font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 12.5px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; }
.tabs button[aria-selected="true"] { color: var(--ink); border-bottom-color: var(--accent); }
[hidden] { display: none !important; }
.panel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 22px; min-width: 0; }

.field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; }
.field label { font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
input, select, textarea { font: inherit; color: var(--ink); background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 3px; padding: 8px 10px; min-width: 0; max-width: 100%; }
textarea { width: 100%; min-height: 84px; resize: vertical; }
input[type="number"] { width: 9.5em; font-family: var(--font-data); }
input[type="date"], input.mono { font-family: var(--font-data); }
input.wide { width: min(26em, 100%); }
button { font: inherit; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 3px; padding: 8px 16px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); border: 1px solid var(--accent); }
button.quiet { background: transparent; color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--line); font-weight: 500; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 13px; }

button:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }
.status { font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
.scroll { overflow-x: auto; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--panel); }
table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; min-width: 600px; }

td.num, th.num { font-family: var(--font-data); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
td small { display: block; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.4; margin-top: 2px; }
.pill { display: inline-block; font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 11px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 99px; white-space: nowrap; }
.pill.ok { background: var(--ok-bg); color: var(--ok); }
.pill.soon, .pill.watch { background: var(--warn-bg); color: var(--warn); }
.pill.over, .pill.bad, .pill.concern { background: var(--bad-bg); color: var(--bad); }
.pill.none, .pill.info { background: var(--none-bg); color: var(--muted); }
.tag { font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 3px; padding: 0 5px; margin-left: 6px; white-space: nowrap; }
.tag.verify { color: var(--warn); border-color: var(--warn); }
.empty { padding: 16px 14px; color: var(--muted); }
.note { border-left: 4px solid var(--warn); background: var(--warn-bg); padding: 11px 14px; border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0; max-width: 72ch; }
.note.calm { border-left-color: var(--teal); background: var(--panel2); }
.cols { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 260px), 1fr)); gap: 16px; }
.cols > div { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.card { border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel); border-radius: 4px; padding: 14px; min-width: 0; }
/* bay */
.bay { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--panel); padding: 8px; }

.legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 16px; font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--muted); align-items: center; }
.legend i { display: inline-block; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; margin-right: 6px; vertical-align: -1px; }

i.z-ok { background: var(--ok); } i.z-soon { background: var(--warn); } i.z-bad { background: var(--bad); } i.z-none { background: var(--none); }
details.part { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--panel); }
details.part > summary { cursor: pointer; padding: 10px 14px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 12px; align-items: center; list-style: none; }
details.part > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
details.part > summary .nm { font-weight: 600; flex: 1 1 14em; min-width: 0; }

.pbody { padding: 12px 14px 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.pbody ul { margin: 0; padding-left: 18px; }

.rate button[data-lv="1"][aria-pressed="true"], .rate button[data-lv="2"][aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--bad); }
.rate button[data-lv="3"][aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--warn); }
.rate button[data-lv="4"][aria-pressed="true"], .rate button[data-lv="5"][aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--ok); }
.rate button[data-lv="0"][aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--none); color: var(--ink); }
/* lab */
.map { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 200px), 1fr)); gap: 10px; }

.finds li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 4px 12px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--panel); align-items: start; }

.chart { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--panel); padding: 8px 10px 4px; }

.chart svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; touch-action: pan-y; }

.chart svg text { font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 11px; fill: var(--muted); }
.player { border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel); border-radius: 4px; padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.pl-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.pl-rank { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 34px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; }

.badges { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
.badge { font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 11.5px; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 3px; border: 1px dashed var(--line); color: var(--muted); }
.badge.on { border: 1px solid var(--accent); color: var(--accent); background: var(--warn-bg); }
.chap { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; padding: 14px; background: var(--bg); gap: 10px; }
.chap.locked { opacity: 0.6; }
.chap-h { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; gap: 10px; }
.mlist { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.mbtn { width: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 4.6em 1fr auto; gap: 10px; align-items: center; text-align: left; background: var(--panel); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--line); font-weight: 500; padding: 10px 12px; }
.mbtn:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }
.mbtn .pill { text-align: center; }
@media (max-width: 520px) { .mbtn { grid-template-columns: 4.6em 1fr; } .mbtn .status { grid-column: 2; } }
.mission { gap: 12px; }
.steps { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
.stp { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: flex-start; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--panel); }
.stp input { margin-top: 4px; width: 18px; height: 18px; flex: none; }
.stp input:checked + span { color: var(--muted); text-decoration: line-through; text-decoration-color: var(--line); }
.quiz { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.quiz fieldset { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--panel); padding: 10px 12px; margin: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; }
.quiz legend { font-weight: 600; padding: 0 4px; }
.quiz label { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: flex-start; padding: 4px 0; }
.quiz input { margin-top: 5px; }
.why { font-size: 14px; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 3px; margin-top: 4px; }
.why.ok { background: var(--ok-bg); color: var(--ok); }
.why.bad { background: var(--bad-bg); color: var(--bad); }
.found { border: 1px solid var(--teal); border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 12px; background: var(--panel2); }
.found p { margin-top: 2px; }
.card > .pill { align-self: flex-start; }
ul.plain { margin: 0; padding-left: 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; max-width: 72ch; }
ul.src { font-size: 13.5px; }
.card h4 { color: var(--ink); text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; font-size: 18px; }
.seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); }
.faults { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 250px), 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.fault { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px 12px; background: var(--bg); min-width: 0; }
.fault label { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; }
input[type="range"] { width: 100%; accent-color: var(--accent); padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; min-height: 32px; }
.chart svg .trace.base { stroke: var(--muted); stroke-width: 1.4; stroke-dasharray: 5 4; opacity: 0.8; }
@media (max-width: 560px) {
  .fault { padding: 6px 10px; gap: 0; }
  .fault .lede { display: none; }
  .faults { gap: 6px; }
}
.slegend { display: flex; gap: 18px; font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
.slegend .lg { display: inline-block; width: 22px; height: 0; border-top: 2px solid var(--teal); vertical-align: middle; margin-right: 6px; }
.slegend .lg.base { border-top: 2px dashed var(--muted); }
fieldset.quizset { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--panel); padding: 10px 12px; margin: 8px 0 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 230px), 1fr)); gap: 2px 12px; }
fieldset.quizset legend { font-weight: 600; padding: 0 4px; }
fieldset.quizset label { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: flex-start; padding: 5px 0; }
.kv { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(9em, auto) 1fr; gap: 6px 18px; margin: 0; }
.kv dt { color: var(--muted); }
.kv dd { margin: 0; }
.phgrid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 260px), 1fr)); gap: 12px; }
.ph { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--panel); display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.ph img { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; object-fit: cover; display: block; background: var(--panel2); }
.phb { padding: 10px 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.filebtn { position: relative; display: inline-flex; }
.filebtn input { position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0; cursor: pointer; }
.filebtn span { display: inline-block; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 3px; padding: 10px 16px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); }
.filebtn:focus-within span { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
.sparks { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(230px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.sparks .chart h4 { margin: 0 0 2px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; }
.sparks .chart .meta { font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--muted); }
.chart svg .base { stroke: var(--muted); stroke-width: 1; stroke-dasharray: 4 3; }
.chart svg .pt { fill: var(--teal); stroke: var(--panel); stroke-width: 2; }
.chart svg .pt.last { fill: var(--accent); }
.chart svg .cur { stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 1; opacity: 0; }
.toggles { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 14px; font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 12px; }
.toggles label { display: inline-flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; color: var(--ink); text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; font-size: 12px; }
.toggles input { width: auto; padding: 0; }
/* health */
.score { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px 28px; align-items: center; }
.score .big { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 84px; line-height: 0.9; font-weight: 600; }
.bars { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; flex: 1 1 260px; min-width: 0; }
.bar { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 9.5em 1fr 3.2em; gap: 10px; align-items: center; font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 12px; }
.bar .tr { height: 8px; background: var(--none-bg); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; }
.bar .fl { height: 100%; background: var(--teal); }
.bar.low .fl { background: var(--bad); } .bar.mid .fl { background: var(--warn); }
.actions { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.actions li { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 12px; align-items: center; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--panel); }
.actions li .tx { flex: 1 1 18em; min-width: 0; }
.answer { white-space: pre-wrap; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--panel); padding: 12px 14px; min-height: 3em; max-width: 78ch; }
/* learn */
.diagram { overflow-x: auto; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--panel); padding: 8px; }
.diagram svg { display: block; min-width: 640px; width: 100%; height: auto; }
.diagram.tall { overflow-x: visible; }
.diagram.tall svg { min-width: 0; max-width: 420px; margin: 0 auto; }
.diagram text { font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 12px; fill: var(--ink); }
.diagram .box { fill: var(--bg); stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 1.4; }
.diagram .engine { fill: var(--panel2); stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 1.4; }
.diagram .flow { fill: none; stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 1.6; }
.diagram .pcv { fill: none; stroke: var(--teal); stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-dasharray: 5 4; }
.diagram .shaft { stroke: var(--muted); stroke-width: 3; stroke-dasharray: 2 3; }
.diagram .head { fill: var(--ink); }
.diagram .headb { fill: var(--teal); }
.diagram .lab-b { fill: var(--teal); }
dl.gloss { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(7em, 11em) 1fr; gap: 10px 18px; margin: 0; }
dl.gloss dt { font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 13px; color: var(--accent); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
dl.gloss dd { margin: 0; min-width: 0; }
@media (max-width: 520px) { dl.gloss { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 2px; } dl.gloss dd { margin-bottom: 10px; } .bar { grid-template-columns: 7em 1fr 3em; } }
ul.src { margin: 0; padding-left: 18px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
ul.src li { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { * { scroll-behavior: auto !important; } }
/* ===== theme layer ===== */
body { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; background: var(--bg); padding: 0 16px 104px; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
main { max-width: 1040px; gap: 26px; }
h1, h2, h3, h4 { font-family: var(--font-display); text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; }
h1 { font-size: clamp(30px, 6.4vw, 44px); line-height: 1; font-weight: 800; font-stretch: 82%; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
h2 { font-size: clamp(25px, 4.6vw, 32px); line-height: 1.05; font-weight: 750; font-stretch: 85%; }
h3 { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; font-stretch: 92%; }
h4 { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: none; }
p { max-width: 70ch; }
.lede { color: var(--muted); font-size: 15.5px; }
.eyebrow { text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); }
.status { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--muted); }
a { color: var(--accent); text-underline-offset: 2px; }
::selection { background: var(--hl); color: var(--hl-ink); }
a:focus-visible, button:focus-visible, input:focus-visible, select:focus-visible, textarea:focus-visible, summary:focus-visible, .pin:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

/* cockpit header */
.cockpit { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; grid-template-areas: "id inst" "st st"; gap: 10px 20px; align-items: center; padding: 18px 0 4px; }
.cockpit .ident { grid-area: id; min-width: 0; }
.cockpit .sub { color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; margin-top: 6px; }
.instruments { grid-area: inst; display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: stretch; }
.savest { grid-area: st; font-size: 12.5px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 4px 10px; margin: 0; }
.syncchip { font: inherit; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink); background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(127,127,127,.35)); border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 10px; min-height: 30px; cursor: pointer; }
.syncchip.on { border-color: transparent; padding-left: 0; font-weight: 600; color: inherit; }
.gauge { position: relative; width: 116px; height: 78px; padding: 0; background: var(--panel); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-md); display: block; }
.gauge svg { position: absolute; inset: 6px 8px auto; width: calc(100% - 16px); height: auto; overflow: visible; }
.gauge .g-track { fill: none; stroke: var(--panel2); stroke-width: 9; stroke-linecap: round; }
.gauge .g-fill { fill: none; stroke: var(--none); stroke-width: 9; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-dasharray: 0 100; transition: stroke-dasharray 900ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), stroke 300ms; }
.gauge.ok .g-fill { stroke: var(--ok); } .gauge.mid .g-fill { stroke: var(--warn); } .gauge.low .g-fill { stroke: var(--bad); }
.gauge .g-ticks line { stroke: var(--muted); stroke-width: 1.5; opacity: .5; }
.gauge .g-val { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 14px; text-align: center; font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800; font-size: 26px; line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.gauge .g-lab { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 3px; text-align: center; font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 700; }
.rankchip { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; min-width: 96px; padding: 8px 12px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--bg); border: 0; border-radius: var(--r-md); text-align: left; }
.rankchip .rk { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800; font-size: 24px; line-height: 1; }
.rankchip .rn { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; opacity: .8; white-space: nowrap; }
.odo { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-md); padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); }
.odo-in { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 4px; }
.odo input { border: 0; padding: 0; width: 5.2em; background: transparent; font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 750; font-size: 22px; color: var(--ink); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.odo input::placeholder { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted); opacity: .8; }
.odo i { font-style: normal; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); }
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .cockpit { grid-template-columns: 1fr; grid-template-areas: "id" "inst" "st"; }
  .instruments { width: 100%; }
  .gauge { flex: 0 0 108px; }
  .rankchip, .odo { flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 0; }
  .odo input { width: 100%; font-size: 19px; min-width: 0; }
  .rankchip { flex: 0.9 1 0; padding: 8px 10px; }
  .odo { flex: 1.25 1 0; padding: 8px 10px; }
  .odo i { display: none; }
  .instruments { gap: 8px; }
  .gauge { flex-basis: 100px; width: 100px; }
}
.cockpit, .cockpit > * { min-width: 0; }

/* section rail: bottom bar on phones, side rail on wide screens */
.rail { position: fixed; z-index: 20; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; display: flex; justify-content: space-around; gap: 2px; padding: 6px 8px calc(6px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel) 92%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px); border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.rail button { flex: 1 1 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 3px; padding: 6px 2px; min-height: 52px; background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: var(--r-md); color: var(--muted); font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; }
.rail svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.rail button[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--ink); }
.rail button[aria-current="page"] svg { stroke: var(--ink); }
.rail button[aria-current="page"] span { background: linear-gradient(transparent 58%, var(--hl) 58%, var(--hl) 92%, transparent 92%); padding: 0 3px; }
@media (min-width: 1000px) {
  body { padding: 0 24px 48px 116px; }
  .rail { top: 0; bottom: 0; right: auto; width: 92px; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-start; gap: 6px; padding: 92px 10px 16px; border-top: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel); }
  .rail button { flex: 0 0 auto; min-height: 64px; }
}
.subnav { display: flex; gap: 4px; overflow-x: auto; padding: 4px; background: var(--panel2); border-radius: 999px; align-self: flex-start; max-width: 100%; }
.subnav button { background: transparent; color: var(--muted); border: 0; border-radius: 999px; padding: 8px 16px; min-height: 40px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14.5px; white-space: nowrap; }
.subnav button[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--panel); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(19,35,46,.16); }

/* surfaces and controls */
.card, .bay, .chart, .player, .scroll, .diagram, .answer { border-radius: var(--r-lg); border-color: var(--line); }
.card { padding: 16px; }
.chap { border-radius: var(--r-lg); background: transparent; border-style: solid; padding: 16px; }
.chap.locked { opacity: .55; border-style: dashed; }
details.part, .finds li, .actions li, .stp, .quiz fieldset, fieldset.quizset, .fault, .mbtn, .sysrow button, .found, .ph { border-radius: var(--r-md); }
.field label { font-family: var(--font-body); text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); }
input, select, textarea { border-radius: var(--r-sm); min-height: 44px; font-size: 16px; }
input[type="checkbox"], input[type="radio"] { min-height: 0; accent-color: var(--accent); width: 18px; height: 18px; }
input[type="range"] { min-height: 32px; border-radius: 0; }
button { border-radius: var(--r-sm); min-height: 44px; font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 700; padding: 10px 18px; }
button.quiet { min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 14px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; border-color: var(--line); background: var(--panel); }
button.quiet:hover { border-color: var(--ink); }
.filebtn span { border-radius: var(--r-sm); padding: 12px 18px; }
th { font-family: var(--font-body); text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; }
td.num, th.num, .num { font-family: var(--font-display); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.pill { font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; padding: 3px 10px; }
.tag { font-family: var(--font-body); border-radius: 999px; padding: 0 8px; }
.note { border-radius: 0 var(--r-md) var(--r-md) 0; }
.toggles, .toggles label { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 14px; }
.chead { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 13px; }
.chead .nm { font-weight: 700; }
.chart svg text, .diagram text, .bay text.lab, .pin text { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 600; }
.chart svg .trace { stroke: var(--teal); stroke-width: 2; }
.slegend, .legend { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 13px; }
.bar { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 13px; }
.score .big { font-weight: 800; font-stretch: 80%; }
dl.gloss dt { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; }

/* highlighter: the one marker for "selected" */
.sysrow button[aria-pressed="true"], .seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--ink); box-shadow: none; color: var(--ink); background: linear-gradient(transparent 55%, var(--hl) 55%, var(--hl) 90%, transparent 90%), var(--panel); }
.pin[aria-pressed="true"] circle.ring { stroke: var(--hl); stroke-width: 6; stroke-dasharray: none; opacity: .9; }

/* academy */
.player { background: var(--ink); color: var(--bg); border: 0; padding: 20px; }
.player .eyebrow, .player .status { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 70%, transparent); }
.pl-rank { font-size: clamp(30px, 6vw, 42px); font-weight: 800; font-stretch: 80%; text-transform: none; }
.pl-xp { font-family: var(--font-body); color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 70%, transparent); }
.pl-xp .v { color: var(--hl); font-weight: 800; }
.xpbar { height: 12px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 18%, transparent); border: 0; }
.xpbar i { background: var(--hl); }
.badge { font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 700; border-radius: 999px; border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 35%, transparent); color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 60%, transparent); }
.badge.on { background: var(--hl); color: var(--hl-ink); border-color: var(--hl); }
.player button { background: var(--hl); color: var(--hl-ink); border-color: var(--hl); }
.mbtn { min-height: 56px; }
.mbtn:hover { border-color: var(--ink); }
.why.ok, .why.bad { border-radius: var(--r-sm); }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .gauge .g-fill { transition: none; } }

/* engine bay explorer */
.ebwrap { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.6fr) minmax(260px, 1fr); gap: 18px; align-items: start; }
@media (max-width: 860px) { .ebwrap { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
.ebmain { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; min-width: 0; }
.ebside { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; position: sticky; top: 12px; min-width: 0; }
.ebstage { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-lg); padding: 10px; }
.ebsvg { display: block; width: 100%; max-width: 480px; margin: 0 auto; height: auto; }
.bi .hit circle { fill: transparent; stroke: none; }
.ebsvg .bayshell { fill: var(--panel2); stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 2; }
.ebsvg .tower { fill: none; stroke: var(--muted); stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-dasharray: 3 3; }
.ebsvg .cowl { stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 2; }
.ebsvg .edge { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; fill: var(--muted); }
.bi { cursor: pointer; }
.bi > rect, .bi > circle, .bi > path { fill: var(--panel); stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 2; transition: fill 160ms; }
.bi .block { fill: var(--panel2); } .bi .cover { fill: var(--panel); } .bi .fan { fill: none; stroke-dasharray: 4 3; }
.bi .mark { fill: none; stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 2.5; stroke-linecap: round; }
.bi .belt { fill: var(--panel2); }
.bi.conf-approx > rect, .bi.conf-approx > circle { stroke-dasharray: 5 4; stroke: var(--muted); }
@media (max-width: 600px) { .ebsvg .lbl { font-size: 15px !important; stroke-width: 4px !important; } .ebsvg .edge { font-size: 14px; } }
.ebsvg .lbl { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 700; fill: var(--ink); paint-order: stroke; stroke: var(--panel2); stroke-width: 4px; stroke-linejoin: round; pointer-events: none; }
.bi .q { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800; font-size: 15px; fill: var(--muted); }
.bi:hover > rect, .bi:hover > circle { fill: color-mix(in srgb, var(--hl) 35%, var(--panel)); }
.bi.sel > rect, .bi.sel > circle { fill: var(--hl); stroke: var(--ink); stroke-dasharray: none; }
.bi.chk > rect, .bi.chk > circle { stroke: var(--ok); stroke-width: 3.5; }
.bi:focus-visible { outline: none; } .bi:focus-visible > rect, .bi:focus-visible > circle { stroke: var(--accent); stroke-width: 4; }
.flow path { fill: none; stroke-width: 4; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-dasharray: 10 8; animation: ebflow 1.2s linear infinite; opacity: .9; pointer-events: none; }
.flow path.approx { stroke-dasharray: 3 7; }
.flow-cool path { stroke: #2f80d1; } .flow-air path { stroke: var(--teal); } .flow-elec path { stroke: #d08a00; }
@keyframes ebflow { to { stroke-dashoffset: -36; } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .flow path { animation: none; } }
.ebinfo h3 { margin-bottom: 4px; }
.ebinfo, #ebLayerInfo { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.ebphoto { position: relative; border-radius: var(--r-md); overflow: hidden; }
.ebphoto img { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; }
.ebphoto.pinning { cursor: crosshair; outline: 3px dashed var(--hl); outline-offset: -3px; }
.ppin { position: absolute; transform: translate(-50%, -100%); min-height: 0; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--bg); border: 2px solid var(--panel); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; max-width: 46vw; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.ppin::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: -7px; width: 10px; height: 10px; background: inherit; transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(45deg); z-index: -1; }
.ppin.sel { background: var(--hl); color: var(--hl-ink); }
.ebempty { padding: 28px 18px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; align-items: flex-start; }
/* budget */
.budsum { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 200px), 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.budsum > div { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-md); padding: 12px 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.budsum .lab { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); }
.budsum .big { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800; font-size: 26px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
table.budget { min-width: 520px; }
table.budget tr:not(.on) td { color: var(--muted); }
label.bud { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: flex-start; }
label.bud input { margin-top: 3px; flex: none; }
label.bud small.due { color: var(--warn); font-weight: 700; }
/* specs */
.specs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 300px), 1fr)); gap: 12px; }
.specg { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-md); padding: 12px 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.specg .kv { grid-template-columns: minmax(7.5em, auto) 1fr; font-size: 14.5px; }
ul.sched { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
ul.sched li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(10em, 13em) 1fr; gap: 4px 14px; padding: 10px 12px; background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-md); }
@media (max-width: 560px) { ul.sched li { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

/* ===== shell additions ===== */
.sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; }
.updatebar { position: fixed; z-index: 40; left: 12px; right: 12px; top: calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-top)); display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 10px 12px 10px 16px; background: var(--ink); color: var(--bg); border-radius: var(--r-md); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.25); max-width: 520px; margin: 0 auto; }
.updatebar button { background: var(--hl); color: var(--hl-ink); border: 0; min-height: 40px; }
/* today */
.today-hero { background: var(--ink); color: var(--bg); border-radius: var(--r-lg); padding: 20px; gap: 16px; }
.today-hero h2 { font-size: clamp(26px, 6vw, 36px); }
.th-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start; }
.th-kicker { font-weight: 700; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 70%, transparent); margin-bottom: 4px; }
.th-odo { text-align: right; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.th-odo b { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 26px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; }
.th-odo span { font-size: 12px; opacity: .7; }
.today-hero .quiet { background: transparent; color: var(--bg); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 40%, transparent); }
.askbar { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
.askbar input { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; padding: 0 18px; background: var(--panel); color: var(--ink); min-height: 50px; }
.askbar button { border-radius: 999px; background: var(--hl); color: var(--hl-ink); border: 0; min-height: 50px; padding: 0 20px; }
.quick { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(96px, 1fr)); gap: 8px; }
.qa { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 12px 6px; min-height: 76px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 10%, transparent); color: var(--bg); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 18%, transparent); border-radius: var(--r-md); font-size: 13px; }
.qa svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.qa:hover { border-color: var(--hl); }
.tdgrid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 300px), 1fr)); gap: 14px; align-items: start; }
.tcard { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-lg); padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; align-items: flex-start; }
.tcard h3 { font-size: 19px; }
.tlist { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; width: 100%; }
.tlist li { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: flex-start; }
.tlink { background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; min-height: 0; color: var(--ink); font-weight: 500; text-align: left; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.4; }
.tlink:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.bigline { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800; font-size: 22px; }
.tcard.feature { background: var(--panel2); border-color: transparent; }

/* Upright phone (Kyle's only way of using the app): tables stack each row as a card, labelled by its column name
   (ui.js sets data-label), so nothing scrolls sideways. */
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .scroll { overflow-x: visible; border: 0; background: transparent; }
  .scroll table, table.budget { min-width: 0; }
  .scroll table, .scroll tbody, .scroll tr, .scroll td { display: block; width: 100%; }
  .scroll thead { display: none; } /* each cell carries its column name instead */
  .scroll tr { border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel); margin: 0 0 8px; padding: 6px 12px; }
  .scroll td { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 14px; padding: 6px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); text-align: right; }
  .scroll tr td:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
  .scroll td::before { content: attr(data-label); flex: none; max-width: 45%; text-align: left; font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .04em; color: var(--muted); }
  .scroll td[data-label=""]::before, .scroll td[data-wide]::before { content: none; }
  .scroll td[data-wide], .scroll td[data-label=""] { justify-content: flex-start; text-align: left; }
  .scroll td > * { min-width: 0; }
  .scroll td.num { white-space: normal; }
  .scroll td small { text-align: right; }
}

/* Upright phone: everything you tap is at least finger-sized (44 px tall for rows, 36 px for small buttons). */
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  summary { min-height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; }
  details > summary { list-style-position: inside; }
  label:has(> input[type=checkbox]), label:has(> input[type=radio]) { min-height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
  button.mn-pill, .mn-link, .syncchip { min-height: 36px !important; min-width: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
  #lk-noBt a { display: inline-block; padding: 8px 0; }
}
.gmap .ghit { fill: transparent !important; stroke: none !important; }
```

### `src/css/manual.css`

```css
/* The workshop manual: home, views, items, chapters (manual.js). Paper, ink, hairlines, mono numbers.
   Amber only ever means "new" (glow) or "where you left off" (dot). */
.mn { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }
.mn p { max-width: 68ch; }
.mn-kick { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
.mn-kick .mn-link { text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; font-size: 14px; }
.mn-mono { font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted); letter-spacing: .02em; }
.mn-amber { color: var(--new-ink); }
.mn-link { background: transparent; border: 0; padding: 6px 0; min-height: 36px; color: var(--ink); font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; }
.mn-link:hover { color: var(--new-ink); }
.mn-top { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.mn-title { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.mn-title h2, .mn-h1 { font-size: 34px; line-height: 1; }
.mn-prog { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.mn-prog .mn-segs { flex: 1; }

/* figures */
.mn-figwrap { border-top: 1px solid var(--ink); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 10px 0 8px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.mn-fig { position: relative; width: 100%; max-width: 540px; margin-inline: auto; }
.mn-fig svg, .mn-fig img { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
.mn-fig img { object-fit: cover; border: 1px solid var(--ink); }
.mn-fig.photo { background: var(--panel2); }
.fg-body { fill: var(--bg); stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 2; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.fg-thin { fill: none; stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 1.2; }
.fg-dash { fill: none; stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 1; stroke-dasharray: 3 3; }
.fg-glass { fill: var(--panel2); stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 1.5; }
.fg-part { fill: var(--bg); stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 1.5; }
.fg-fill { fill: var(--ink); }
.fg-arch { fill: var(--bg); stroke: var(--ink); stroke-width: 2; }
.fg-ground { stroke: var(--line); stroke-width: 1; }
.fg-text { font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 13px; fill: var(--ink); }
.fg-label { font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 11.5px; letter-spacing: .06em; fill: var(--muted); }
.mn-hs { position: absolute; width: 42px; height: 42px; margin: -21px 0 0 -21px; padding: 0; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid var(--ink); background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-data); font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; min-height: 0; }
.mn-hs.locked { border-style: dashed; border-color: var(--none); color: var(--none); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 85%, transparent); }
.mn-hs.closed { background: var(--ink); color: var(--bg); }
.mn-hs.new { border-color: var(--new); color: var(--new-ink); animation: mn-glow 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
.mn-hs.resume::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: -5px; right: -5px; width: 13px; height: 13px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--new); border: 2px solid var(--bg); }
.mn-hs.sel { outline: 3px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; }
.mn-hs.new.sel { outline-color: var(--new); }
.mn-hs.onphoto { border-color: var(--bg); background: var(--ink); color: var(--bg); box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.45); }
.mn-hs.onphoto.locked { background: rgba(27,29,31,.55); color: #D9D4C7; border-style: dashed; }
.mn-hs.onphoto.new { background: var(--new); color: #1B1D1F; }
.mn-hs.onphoto.sel { outline-color: var(--bg); }
.mn-hs.onphoto.new.sel { outline-color: var(--new); }
@keyframes mn-glow { 0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--new) 16%, transparent); } 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--new) 30%, transparent); } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .mn-hs.new { animation: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--new) 25%, transparent); } }
.mn-legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 16px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); padding-top: 6px; }
.mn-legend span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.mn-legend .mn-hs { position: static; margin: 0; width: 28px; height: 28px; font-size: 11px; animation: none; box-shadow: none; cursor: default; }
.mn-legend .mn-hs.resume::after { top: -4px; right: -4px; width: 10px; height: 10px; }

/* the sheet under a figure */
.mn-sheet { border: 1.5px solid var(--ink); background: var(--panel); padding: 12px 14px 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.mn-sheet h3 { font-size: 26px; line-height: 1; }
.mn-pre { border-color: var(--new); }
.mn-segs { display: flex; gap: 4px; }
.mn-segs i { display: block; height: 6px; flex: 1; background: var(--line); }
.mn-segs i.closed { background: var(--ink); }
.mn-segs i.new, .mn-segs i.resume { background: var(--new); }
.mn-segs i.open { background: var(--none); }
.mn-cta { align-self: flex-start; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 11px 16px; min-height: 44px; }
.mn-locked { border: 1px dashed var(--none); padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); }
.mn-toast { background: var(--ink); color: var(--bg); padding: 10px 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.35; }
.mn-toast b { font-family: var(--font-data); font-weight: 500; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--hl); }

/* lists */
.mn-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0; }
.mn-list > .mn-kick { padding-bottom: 5px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink); margin-bottom: 2px; }
.mn-ix, .mn-row, .mn-ch { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; width: 100%; text-align: left; padding: 9px 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: inherit; font-weight: 400; font-size: 15px; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; }
.mn-ix .n, .mn-ch .n { font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted); flex: none; width: 2.4em; }
.mn-ch .n { width: 3.6em; }
.mn-ix .st, .mn-ch .s { margin-left: auto; flex: none; font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .04em; color: var(--muted); text-align: right; }
.mn-ix.locked, .mn-ch.locked { color: var(--none); cursor: default; }
.mn-ix.new .st, .mn-ix.resume .st, .mn-ch.new .s, .mn-ch.resume .s, .mn-ch.new .n { color: var(--new-ink); }
.mn-ix.closed .st { color: var(--done); }
.mn-ch { align-items: flex-start; padding: 12px 0; }
.mn-ch .b { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; min-width: 0; }
.mn-ch .t { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 600; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.05; }
.mn-ch .d { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.35; }
.mn-ch.locked .d { color: var(--none); }
.mn-ch .s { padding-top: 3px; }
.mn-stamp { display: inline-block; transform: rotate(-6deg); border: 2px solid var(--done); color: var(--done); font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .12em; padding: 2px 6px; }
.mn-row { align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.mn-row b { font-weight: 600; }
.mn-dot { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--new); flex: none; }
.mn-pill { display: inline-block; font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 2px 7px; border: 1px solid currentColor; flex: none; }
.mn-pill.new, .mn-pill.resume { color: var(--new-ink); }
.mn-pill.closed { color: var(--done); }
.mn-pill.bad { color: var(--bad); }
.mn-back summary { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; padding: 9px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); cursor: pointer; list-style: none; min-height: 44px; }
.mn-back summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.mn-back summary .n { font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); width: 2.4em; flex: none; }
.mn-back summary .st { margin-left: auto; font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
.mn-also { margin-top: 16px; }
.mn-also .mn-chip { min-height: 44px; }
.mn-alsotop .mn-also { margin: 8px 0 12px; }
.mn-mapbtn { display: flex; width: 100%; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 10px; }
.mn-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; padding: 10px 0 4px; }
.mn-chip { font: inherit; font-size: 13px; padding: 7px 10px; min-height: 36px; border: 1px solid var(--ink); background: var(--panel); color: var(--ink); border-radius: 0; font-weight: 400; }
.mn-chip.locked { border-style: dashed; border-color: var(--none); color: var(--none); background: transparent; font-family: var(--font-data); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; }
.mn-spec { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr)); gap: 0; border: 1px solid var(--ink); margin: 0; }
.mn-spec div { padding: 8px 10px; border-right: 1px solid var(--line); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); min-width: 0; }
.mn-spec dt { font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
.mn-spec dd { margin: 2px 0 0; font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; word-wrap: break-word; }
.mn-thumbs { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; padding: 8px 0; }
.mn-thumbs button { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; min-height: 0; color: var(--muted); font: inherit; font-size: 11px; font-family: var(--font-data); }
.mn-thumbs img { width: 84px; height: 64px; object-fit: cover; border: 1px solid var(--ink); display: block; }
.mn-seg { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--ink); }
.mn-seg button { min-height: 32px; padding: 4px 10px; font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 500; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); }
.mn-seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--ink); color: var(--bg); }

/* a chapter */
.mn-chh { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: baseline; }
.mn-num { font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 20px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted); }
.mn-num.amber { color: var(--new-ink); }
.mn-step { display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); align-items: flex-start; }
.mn-step .n { font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted); width: 1.6em; flex: none; padding-top: 2px; }
.mn-step .b { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.mn-step .b p { font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.4; }
.mn-step .b b { font-weight: 600; }
.mn-step .row { gap: 8px; }
.mn-step.done .b > p:first-child { color: var(--muted); }
.mn-tick { width: 24px; height: 24px; border: 1.5px solid var(--line); flex: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--done); margin-top: 2px; }
.mn-step.done .mn-tick { border-color: var(--done); }
.mn-note { border-left: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--panel); padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.45; }
.mn-note b { font-weight: 600; }

/* "Something's wrong" */
.mn-sos { border: 1.5px solid var(--bad); }
.mn-sos summary { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 12px 14px; min-height: 48px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; color: var(--bad); list-style: none; }
.mn-sos summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.mn-sosi { width: 0; height: 0; border-left: 7px solid transparent; border-right: 7px solid transparent; border-bottom: 12px solid var(--bad); }
.mn-sos > p, .mn-sos ul { padding: 0 14px; }
.mn-sos ul { list-style: none; margin: 0 0 8px; }
.mn-sos .mn-row { font-size: 14.5px; }

/* crumb bar: the way back from an old page */
.crumb { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 5; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 92%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 2px 0; margin-top: -10px; }

/* ---- the part page: chapters as sections, steps that open in place (Oct 2026 flattening) ---- */
.mn-areas { padding: 4px 0 0; }
.mn-areas .mn-chip { font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 11.5px; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; min-height: 32px; padding: 5px 9px; }
.mn-fold { border: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 0 12px 10px; }
.mn-fold > summary { list-style: none; cursor: pointer; min-height: 40px; display: flex; align-items: center; }
.mn-fold > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.mn-fold > summary .mn-kick { width: 100%; }
.mn-fold > summary .mn-kick::after { content: "+"; font-size: 16px; color: var(--muted); margin-left: 8px; }
.mn-fold[open] > summary .mn-kick::after { content: "–"; }
.mn-fold .mn-spec { margin-top: 2px; }
.mn-chs { border-top: 2px solid var(--ink); padding: 12px 0 6px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.mn-chs.locked { border-top-color: var(--line); }
.mn-chs.locked .mn-chh2 h3, .mn-chs.locked .mn-chh2 p { color: var(--none); }
.mn-chh2 { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start; }
.mn-chh2 .mn-num { font-size: 15px; padding-top: 3px; flex: none; width: 3.4em; }
.mn-chh2 .b { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.mn-chh2 h3 { font-size: 24px; line-height: 1; display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.mn-chh2 .mn-tier { font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 500; }
.mn-chh2 p { font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.4; margin-top: 3px; }
.mn-chh2 > .mn-mono, .mn-chh2 > .mn-stamp { flex: none; margin-left: auto; padding-top: 4px; }
.mn-chh2 > .mn-stamp { padding-top: 0; }
.mn-chs.new .mn-chh2 .mn-num { animation: mn-glow 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; border-radius: 50%; }
.mn-steps { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.mn-stepx { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.mn-stepx > summary { list-style: none; cursor: pointer; display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start; padding: 11px 0; min-height: 44px; }
.mn-stepx > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.mn-stepx > summary .n { font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted); width: 1.6em; flex: none; padding-top: 2px; }
.mn-stepx > summary .b { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.mn-stepx > summary .t { font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.3; }
.mn-stepx > summary .kind { font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .06em; color: var(--muted); }
.mn-stepx.done > summary .t { color: var(--muted); }
.mn-stepx.done .mn-tick { border-color: var(--done); }
.mn-stepx[open] > summary .t { color: var(--ink); }
.mn-stepb { padding: 0 0 14px 1.6em; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.mn-stepb > p { font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.45; }
.mn-stepx:not([open]) .mn-stepb { display: none; }
.mn-inl { border-left: 3px solid var(--ink); padding: 4px 0 4px 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; min-width: 0; }
.mn-inl.kbart h3 { font-size: 20px; margin-top: 6px; }
.mn-inl.kbart h4 { margin-top: 6px; }
.mn-inl .jobcard { border: 0; padding: 0; background: transparent; }
.mn-inl .mission { padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; }
.mn-inl .mission h2 { font-size: 22px; }
.mn-tree p b { font-weight: 600; }
.mn-note.sev-stop { border-left-color: var(--bad); background: var(--bad-bg); }
.mn-note.sev-act { border-left-color: var(--warn); background: var(--warn-bg); }
.mn-note.sev-ok { border-left-color: var(--ok); background: var(--ok-bg); }
.mn-chnote { padding: 2px 0 0 3.4em; }
.mn-homefoot { padding: 6px 0 2px; }
@media (max-width: 600px) { .mn-stepb { padding-left: 0; } .mn-chnote { padding-left: 0; } .mn-chh2 .mn-num { width: 3em; } }

/* ---- the certification track ---- */
.track { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 18px; }
.tk-big { display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: stretch; border: 1.5px solid var(--ink); background: var(--panel); padding: 12px 14px; }
.tk-num { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800; font-size: 56px; line-height: .9; letter-spacing: -.01em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; flex: none; align-self: center; }
.tk-num small { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; margin-left: 2px; }
.tk-bigr { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; justify-content: center; }
.tk-meter { height: 6px; background: var(--line); overflow: hidden; }
.tk-meter i { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--ink); }
.tk-meter.tall { height: 10px; }
.tk-meter.thin { height: 4px; }
.tk-parts { display: flex; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 2px 0 0; }
.tk-parts div { min-width: 0; }
.tk-parts dt { font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
.tk-parts dd { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; }
.tk-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; width: 100%; text-align: left; padding: 11px 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 0; }
.tk-row .n { font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted); flex: none; width: 1.8em; padding-top: 2px; }
.tk-row .b { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; }
.tk-row .t { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 600; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.05; }
.tk-row .d { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.35; }
.tk-row .s { flex: none; margin-left: auto; padding-top: 3px; }
.tk-row.closed .n, .tk-row.closed .s { color: var(--done); }
.tk-row.closed .tk-meter i { background: var(--done); }
.tk-row.new .n { color: var(--new-ink); }
.tk-mock { border-color: var(--ink); }
.tk-rung.done { border-color: var(--done); }
.tk-rung.done .mn-kick { color: var(--done); }
.tk-q { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
.tk-q h3 { font-size: clamp(20px, 4.8vw, 26px); line-height: 1.25; font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 600; }
.tk-opts { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.tk-opt { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start; width: 100%; text-align: left; padding: 11px 12px; min-height: 48px; border: 1.5px solid var(--ink); background: var(--panel); color: var(--ink); font: inherit; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.4; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; }
.tk-opt .l { font-family: var(--font-data); font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted); flex: none; width: 1.2em; }
.tk-opt:disabled { cursor: default; opacity: .7; }
.tk-opt.right { border-color: var(--done); background: var(--ok-bg); opacity: 1; }
.tk-opt.right .l { color: var(--done); }
.tk-opt.wrong { border-color: var(--bad); background: var(--bad-bg); opacity: 1; }
.tk-why { border-left: 3px solid var(--ink); padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.45; background: var(--panel); }
.tk-why.ok { border-left-color: var(--done); }
.tk-why.bad { border-left-color: var(--bad); }
.tk-why b { font-weight: 700; }
.tk-why .status { display: block; margin-top: 4px; }
.tk-rev { padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; }
.tk-rev p { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.4; }
.tk-rev p b { font-weight: 600; }
/* the strip on the home */
.tk-strip { display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: stretch; width: 100%; text-align: left; border: 1.5px solid var(--ink); background: var(--panel); padding: 10px 14px; color: var(--ink); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 0; }
.tk-stripn { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800; font-size: 40px; line-height: 1; align-self: center; flex: none; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.tk-stripn small { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; }
.tk-stripb { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.tk-segs { display: flex; gap: 3px; height: 8px; }
.tk-segs i { display: block; background: var(--line); min-width: 4px; }
.tk-segs i.r1 { background: var(--none); }
.tk-segs i.r2 { background: var(--done); }
/* the G1 task list on an area page */
.tk-group { font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); padding: 12px 0 2px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.tk-task { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.tk-task > summary { list-style: none; cursor: pointer; display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: flex-start; padding: 10px 0; min-height: 44px; }
.tk-task > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.tk-task > summary .n { font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted); width: 2.6em; flex: none; padding-top: 2px; }
.tk-task > summary .b { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.tk-task > summary .t { font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 500; }
.tk-task.read > summary .t { color: var(--muted); }
.tk-task.read .mn-tick { border-color: var(--done); }
.tk-task.empty > summary .t { color: var(--muted); font-weight: 400; }
.tk-task[open] > summary .t { color: var(--ink); }
.tk-taskb { padding: 0 0 14px 2.6em; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; border-left: 0; }
.tk-taskb p { font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.5; }
.tk-taskb .tk-car { border-left: 3px solid var(--ink); padding: 4px 10px; background: var(--panel); }
.tk-taskb .tk-car b { font-weight: 600; }
.tk-task:not([open]) .tk-taskb { display: none; }
@media (max-width: 600px) { .tk-taskb { padding-left: 0; } }

/* ---------- the path (2026-10-15): one Next card on the home, the whole path on its own page ---------- */
.mn-next { border-color: var(--new); }
.mn-next h3 { font-size: 26px; }
.mn-pbar { height: 8px; background: var(--line); overflow: hidden; }
.mn-pbar i { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--ink); }
.mn-unit { font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .1em; color: var(--new-ink); margin-top: 4px; }
.mn-park { font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--muted); }
.mn-park > summary { cursor: pointer; min-height: 32px; display: flex; align-items: center; }
.mn-park[open] { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.mn-park[open] > button { align-self: flex-start; }
.mn-parked { line-height: 1.6; }
.mn-homenote { margin-top: 6px; }
.mn-toast .mn-cta { margin-top: 6px; background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--bg); }
.mn-unitx { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.mn-unitx > summary { list-style: none; cursor: pointer; display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start; padding: 11px 0; min-height: 44px; }
.mn-unitx > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.mn-unitx > summary .n { font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted); width: 1.8em; flex: none; padding-top: 2px; }
.mn-unitx > summary .b { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.mn-unitx > summary .t { font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.3; }
.mn-unitx > summary .kind { font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .06em; color: var(--muted); }
.mn-unitx.locked > summary .t { color: var(--none); }
.mn-unitx.resume > summary .n, .mn-unitx.resume > summary .mn-tick { color: var(--new-ink); }
.mn-unitx.closed .mn-tick { border-color: var(--done); }
.mn-unitx > .status, .mn-unitx > .mn-list { padding-left: 2.6em; }
.mn-unitx > .mn-list { padding-bottom: 10px; }
.tk-task.locked { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: baseline; padding: 10px 0; color: var(--none); }
.tk-task.locked .n { font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 12.5px; width: 2.6em; flex: none; }
.tk-task.locked .b { flex: 1; min-width: 0; font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.35; }
.tk-task.locked .mn-mono { font-size: 11px; flex: none; }
```

### `src/css/modules.css`

```css
/* ===== module styles (library, cards, exam, story, fuel, glovebox, diy, troubleshoot, achievements, live) ===== */
.askbar.light input { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); }
.kbbody { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }
.kbh { margin-top: 6px; }
.ans { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-lg); padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.ans.best { border: 2px solid var(--ink); box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 var(--hl); }
.ans h3 { font-size: 17px; }
.ans-a { font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.5; }
.ans.best .ans-a { font-size: 19px; }
.ans-k { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); }
.anslist { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 280px), 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.artlist { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.artbtn { width: 100%; text-align: left; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; background: var(--panel); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-md); padding: 12px 14px; font-weight: 500; }
.artbtn:hover { border-color: var(--ink); }
.kbcats { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 300px), 1fr)); gap: 16px; }
.kbcat { gap: 8px; }
.kbart { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; max-width: 72ch; align-items: flex-start; }
.kbart h3 { margin-top: 8px; }
.tries { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
.chipq { background: var(--panel); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px; min-height: 36px; padding: 6px 14px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; }
.chipq:hover { border-color: var(--ink); }
.askclaude { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; align-items: flex-start; }
.bigline.sm { font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.35; font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 700; }

.stats { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(118px, 1fr)); gap: 8px; }
.stat { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-md); padding: 10px 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.stat b { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800; font-size: 26px; line-height: 1.1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.stat span { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 700; }
.meter { height: 10px; background: var(--panel2); border-radius: 99px; overflow: hidden; }
.meter.thin { height: 6px; }
.meter i { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--teal); border-radius: 99px; }

.fc { background: var(--panel); border: 2px solid var(--ink); border-radius: var(--r-lg); padding: 22px 20px; min-height: 260px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; justify-content: center; }
.fc.done { border-style: dashed; border-color: var(--line); }
.fc-meta { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.fc-q { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 750; font-size: clamp(22px, 5vw, 28px); line-height: 1.2; }
.fc-a { font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.5; background: linear-gradient(transparent 0, transparent), var(--panel2); border-left: 5px solid var(--hl); padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 0 var(--r-sm) var(--r-sm) 0; }
.flipbtn { align-self: stretch; min-height: 52px; }
.fc-grade { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 8px; }
.fc-grade button { min-height: 52px; padding: 8px; }
@media (max-width: 420px) { .fc-grade { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } }

.cert { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-lg); padding: 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.cert.earned { background: var(--ink); color: var(--bg); border: 0; }
.cert.earned .ans-k { color: var(--hl); }
.cert.earned button.quiet { background: transparent; color: var(--bg); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 40%, transparent); }
.exq { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }
.exq h3 { font-size: clamp(20px, 4.6vw, 26px); }
.opts { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.opt { text-align: left; background: var(--panel); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-md); padding: 14px 16px; font-weight: 500; min-height: 54px; }
.opt:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--ink); }
.opt.right { background: var(--ok-bg); border-color: var(--ok); color: var(--ok); }
.opt.wrong { background: var(--bad-bg); border-color: var(--bad); color: var(--bad); }
.opt:disabled { opacity: 1; cursor: default; }
ul.missed li { padding: 6px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.printcard { display: none; }
@media print {
  body.printing-card > *:not(#printCard):not(main) { display: none !important; }
  body.printing-card main > *:not(#p-exam) { display: none !important; }
  body.printing-card #p-exam > *:not(#printCard) { display: none !important; }
  body.printing-card #printCard { display: block !important; color: #000; }
  #printCard h1 { font-size: 28px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
  #printCard table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; min-width: 0; font-size: 12px; }
  #printCard th, #printCard td { border: 1px solid #999; padding: 5px 8px; text-align: left; vertical-align: top; }
  #printCard th { width: 26%; background: #eee; }
  body.printing-card .rail, body.printing-card .subnav { display: none !important; }
}

/* story + cinema */
.stlist { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.stch { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 14px 16px; background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-md); }
.stch > div { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; min-width: 0; }
.stch.locked { opacity: .55; }
.lockic { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); }
.tcard.story { background: var(--ink); color: var(--bg); border: 0; }
.tcard.story .ans-k { color: var(--hl); }
.tcard.story button { background: var(--hl); color: var(--hl-ink); border: 0; }
body.cine-open { overflow: hidden; }
.cinema { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 100; background: #0b141a; color: #eef3f6; display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto auto; padding: calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-top)) 18px calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); outline: none; cursor: pointer; }
.cin-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.cin-title { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #ffd84a; }
.cin-skip, .cin-next { background: transparent; color: #eef3f6; border: 1px solid rgba(238,243,246,.35); min-height: 40px; padding: 6px 16px; }
.cin-stage { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 0; }
.cin-stage svg { width: min(100%, 880px); height: auto; max-height: 58vh; }
.cin-cap { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 650; font-size: clamp(20px, 4.4vw, 34px); line-height: 1.25; max-width: 30ch; margin: 0 auto 18px; text-align: center; min-height: 3.8em; }
.cin-bot { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; max-width: 880px; width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; }
.cin-dots { display: flex; gap: 6px; }
.cin-dots i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(238,243,246,.25); }
.cin-dots i.past { background: rgba(238,243,246,.6); }
.cin-dots i.on { background: #ffd84a; width: 22px; border-radius: 99px; }
.cinema .ln { fill: none; stroke: #eef3f6; stroke-width: 2.4; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.cinema .ln.thin { stroke-width: 1.4; opacity: .75; }
.cinema .ground, .cinema .lane { stroke: rgba(238,243,246,.4); stroke-width: 2; }
.cinema .lane { stroke-dasharray: 36 28; animation: lane 0.9s linear infinite; }
.cinema .beam { fill: rgba(255,216,74,.18); }
.cinema text.q { fill: #ffd84a; font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800; font-size: 54px; text-anchor: middle; }
.cinema text.q.big { font-size: 110px; }
.cinema text.mono { fill: #ffd84a; font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 26px; text-anchor: middle; letter-spacing: 0.08em; }
.cinema .draw .ln { stroke-dasharray: 1400; stroke-dashoffset: 1400; animation: draw 2.4s cubic-bezier(.3,.7,.2,1) forwards; }
.cinema .carmove { animation: bob 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
.cinema .spin { transform-origin: 380px 170px; animation: spin 9s linear infinite; }
.cinema .waves .ln { animation: pulse 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; }
.cinema .waves .ln:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .3s; } .cinema .waves .ln:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: .6s; }
.cinema .needle { transform-origin: 360px 280px; animation: needle 2.6s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.2,1) forwards; }
.cinema .glow .ln { stroke: #ffd84a; }
@keyframes draw { to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } }
@keyframes lane { to { stroke-dashoffset: -64; } }
@keyframes bob { 50% { transform: translateY(-2px); } }
```
