```css
@keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
@keyframes pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: .25; } 50% { opacity: 1; } }
@keyframes needle { from { transform: rotate(-80deg); } to { transform: rotate(52deg); } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .cinema * { animation: none !important; } .cinema .draw .ln { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } .cinema .needle { transform: rotate(52deg); } }

/* fuel */
label.inl { display: inline-flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; min-height: 44px; }
.chart svg .pt { fill: var(--teal); }

/* glovebox */
.gbman { border: 1px dashed var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-md); padding: 10px 14px; }
.gbman summary { font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; min-height: 32px; display: flex; align-items: center; }
.gbman[open] summary { margin-bottom: 10px; }
.warnc { color: var(--warn) !important; font-weight: 700; }
.tools { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 260px), 1fr)); gap: 6px; }
.tool { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-md); background: var(--bg); min-width: 0; }
.tool .tcheck { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: flex-start; min-height: 36px; cursor: pointer; }
.tool .tcheck input { margin-top: 3px; flex: none; width: 20px; height: 20px; }
.tool .tcheck span { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; }
.tool small { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12.5px; }
.tool.have .tprice summary { color: var(--muted); }
.ttier { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; margin-top: 14px; }
.ttier:first-child { margin-top: 4px; }
.ttier h4 { margin: 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px 10px; align-items: baseline; }
.ttier h4 .status { text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; font-family: var(--font-body, inherit); font-size: 13px; }
.ttier > p.status { margin: 0 0 4px; }
.tprice { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding-top: 4px; margin-left: 30px; }
.tprice summary { cursor: pointer; min-height: 36px; display: flex; align-items: center; font-size: 13px; }
.tprice[open] summary { margin-bottom: 6px; }
.tprice .tpsrc { margin: 0 0 6px; padding-left: 18px; font-size: 13.5px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.tprice .tpsrc li + li { margin-top: 4px; }
.tprice .tpmine { align-items: flex-end; gap: 8px; }
.tprice .tpmine input { width: 120px; }
.tprice .tpmine button { min-height: 36px; }

/* diy */
.joblist { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.jobcard { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start; max-width: 76ch; }
.jobmeta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
ol.jsteps { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; counter-reset: st; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; width: 100%; }
ol.jsteps li { counter-increment: st; }
ol.jsteps label { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 2em 1fr; gap: 8px; align-items: start; padding: 10px 12px; background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-md); }
ol.jsteps label::before { content: counter(st); grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800; font-size: 18px; color: var(--muted); }
ol.jsteps input { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; margin-top: 3px; }
ol.jsteps span { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 1; }
ol.jsteps input:checked ~ span { color: var(--muted); text-decoration: line-through; text-decoration-color: var(--line); }

/* troubleshoot */
.tree { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start; max-width: 72ch; }
.crumbs { margin: 0; padding-left: 20px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
.tq, .tres { width: 100%; background: var(--panel); border: 2px solid var(--ink); border-radius: var(--r-lg); padding: 18px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
.tres.stop, .tres.act { border-color: var(--bad); }
.tres.ok { border-color: var(--ok); }
.tres p:first-of-type { font-size: 17px; }

/* achievements */
.achs { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 230px), 1fr)); gap: 8px; }
.ach { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 34px 1fr; gap: 2px 10px; padding: 12px; border: 1px dashed var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-md); color: var(--muted); }
.ach .medal { grid-row: span 2; width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px dashed var(--line); display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 15px; }
.ach b { color: var(--ink); opacity: .6; }
.ach span:last-child { font-size: 13px; }
.ach.on { border-style: solid; border-color: var(--ink); background: var(--panel); color: var(--ink); }
.ach.on b { opacity: 1; }
.ach.on .medal { background: var(--hl); color: var(--hl-ink); border: 0; }

/* live (V60 Link inside the app) */
#p-live .conn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; }
#p-live .conn i { width: 11px; height: 11px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--muted); display: inline-block; }
#p-live .conn.on i { background: var(--ok); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--ok-bg); }
#p-live .conn.busy i { background: var(--warn); }
#p-live .list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
#p-live .list li { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-md); background: var(--panel); padding: 10px 12px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 2px 12px; align-items: start; }
#p-live .list li .d { grid-column: 2; color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; }
#p-live .code { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; }
#p-live .tiles { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(150px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
#p-live .tile { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-md); background: var(--panel); padding: 10px 12px; }
#p-live .tile .k { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); }
#p-live .tile .v { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 32px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.05; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
#p-live .tile .u { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); margin-left: 4px; }
#p-live .picks { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 14px; }
#p-live .picks label { display: inline-flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; font-size: 14px; }
#p-live .picks label.na { opacity: .45; }
#p-live .mon { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 6px; }
#p-live .mon div { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-sm); padding: 8px 10px; background: var(--panel); font-size: 14px; }
#p-live .checks label { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: flex-start; padding: 6px 0; }
#p-live .checks input { margin-top: 4px; flex: none; }
#p-live pre.log, #p-live textarea.log { margin: 0; width: 100%; min-height: 160px; max-height: 260px; overflow: auto; font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--ink); -webkit-user-select: text; user-select: text; background: var(--panel2); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-md); padding: 10px; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-all; }
#p-live button.danger { background: var(--bad); border-color: var(--bad); color: #fff; }
#p-live .note.bad { border-left-color: var(--bad); background: var(--bad-bg); }
.cluster { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(46%, 220px), 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.dial { background: var(--ink); color: var(--bg); border-radius: var(--r-lg); padding: 12px; position: relative; }
.dial svg { width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
.dial .dtrack { fill: none; stroke: rgba(238,243,246,.15); stroke-width: 10; stroke-linecap: round; }
.dial .dfill { fill: none; stroke: var(--hl); stroke-width: 10; stroke-linecap: round; transition: stroke-dasharray 220ms; }
.dial .dfill.hot { stroke: #ff8b7b; }
.dial .dv { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 18px; text-align: center; font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800; font-size: 30px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.dial .dl { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 6px; text-align: center; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; opacity: .7; }
.zero60 { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.zero60 .big { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800; font-size: 40px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.coach li { margin-bottom: 4px; }

/* Live link additions */
#p-live .card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
#p-live .card.flat { background: var(--panel2); border-color: transparent; }
#p-live .zruns { margin: 0; padding-left: 20px; font-size: 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
#p-live .coach { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
#p-live .coach li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 26px 1fr; gap: 10px; align-items: start; font-size: 14.5px; }
#p-live .coach li .d { display: block; color: var(--muted); font-size: 13.5px; }
#p-live .coach li.chead { display: block; font-size: 14px; }
#p-live .coach li.chead .pill { margin: 2px 2px 0 0; }
#p-live .coach .cdot { width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid var(--line); display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; }
#p-live .coach li.rel .cdot { border-color: var(--warn); }
#p-live .coach li.done .cdot { background: var(--ok); border-color: var(--ok); color: var(--panel); }
#p-live .coach li.done b { text-decoration: line-through; text-decoration-color: var(--muted); }

/* Toggle groups (bulletins, upgrades) */
.seg { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
.seg button { min-height: 38px; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; background: var(--panel); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--line); }
.seg button:hover { border-color: var(--ink); }

/* Bulletins */
.tsbs { list-style: none; margin: 10px 0 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.tsb { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-md); background: var(--panel); overflow: hidden; }
.tsb.star { border-left: 4px solid var(--accent); }
.tsbh { all: unset; box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 7.4em 1fr; gap: 10px; align-items: start; padding: 12px 14px; cursor: pointer; }
.tsbh:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: -2px; }
.tsbh .pill { justify-self: start; margin-top: 2px; }
.tsbh .tt b { display: block; font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.3; }
.tsbh .tt small { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12.5px; }
.tsbb { padding: 0 14px 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding-top: 12px; }
.tsbb .kv { grid-template-columns: minmax(7em, auto) 1fr; font-size: 14.5px; }
pre.sheet { margin: 0; white-space: pre-wrap; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 14px; background: var(--panel2); border-radius: var(--r-md); padding: 10px 12px; }
@media (max-width: 520px) { .tsbh { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 4px; } .tsbb .kv { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .tsbb .kv dd { margin-bottom: 6px; } }

/* Upgrades */
.upg { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.upg > li { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-lg); background: var(--panel); padding: 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.upg .uh { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: baseline; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.upg .uh h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; }
.upg .rank { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800; font-size: 22px; color: var(--muted); min-width: 1.4em; }
.upg .facts { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 14px; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--muted); }
.upg .facts b { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 700; }
.upg .verdict { border-radius: var(--r-md); padding: 10px 12px; background: var(--panel2); font-size: 14.5px; }
.upg .verdict.go { background: var(--ok-bg); }
.upg .verdict.wait { background: var(--warn-bg); }
.upg .qs { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.upg .qs label { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: flex-start; font-size: 14.5px; }
.upg .qs input { margin-top: 3px; flex: none; }

/* Story case board */
.sthero { gap: 8px; }
.sbar { height: 10px; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--panel2); overflow: hidden; }
.sbar i { display: block; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--teal)); border-radius: 99px; transition: width 300ms; }
.stnext { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.nextc { background: #10202a; color: #eef3f6; border: 1px solid rgba(238,243,246,.14); border-radius: var(--r-lg); padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.nextc h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 19px; color: inherit; }
.nextc .ans-k { color: var(--hl); margin: 0; }
.nextc button { background: var(--hl); color: #1a1600; border: 0; }
.nextc button.quiet { background: transparent; color: #eef3f6; border: 1px solid rgba(238,243,246,.35); }
.nextc.scene { background: var(--panel); color: var(--ink); border: 2px solid var(--hl); }
.nextc.scene .ans-k { color: var(--muted); }
.act h3 { font-size: 17px; margin: 6px 0 8px; display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: baseline; }
.act h3 span { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
.cases { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.case { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-md); background: var(--panel); overflow: hidden; }
.case.closed { border-color: var(--ok); }
.case.risk { border-color: var(--bad); }
.case.open { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--accent); border-color: transparent; }
.caseh { all: unset; box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 6.6em 1fr auto; gap: 10px; align-items: start; padding: 12px 14px; cursor: pointer; }
.caseh.static { cursor: default; }
.caseh:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: -2px; }
.caseh .pill { justify-self: start; margin-top: 2px; }
.caseh .ct b { display: block; font-size: 15.5px; }
.caseh .ct small { color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.35; display: block; }
.caseh .cn { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800; font-size: 15px; color: var(--muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.caseb { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 12px 14px 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.steps { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.steps li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 26px 1fr auto; gap: 10px; align-items: center; font-size: 14.5px; }
.steps .sdot { width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid var(--line); display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; }
.steps li.done .sdot { background: var(--ok); border-color: var(--ok); color: var(--panel); }
.steps li.done .stx { color: var(--muted); }
.steps .stx small { display: block; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12.5px; }
.steps .sact { display: flex; gap: 6px; }
.steps .sact button { min-height: 36px; padding: 4px 12px; }
.steps li .sact:empty { display: none; }
.reason summary { cursor: pointer; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted); }
.reason[open] { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
@media (max-width: 520px) { .caseh { grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; } .caseh .pill { grid-column: 1 / -1; } }

/* Progressive reveal */
.newdot { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--hl); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--panel); margin-left: 6px; vertical-align: top; }
.rail button { position: relative; }
.rail button .newdot { position: absolute; top: 6px; right: calc(50% - 18px); margin: 0; }
.gate-nohealth .cockpit .gauge { display: none; }
.hidden-note { text-align: center; padding: 6px 0 2px; }
#p-story .seg { margin-top: 4px; }
.flab { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); }
.brief { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-md); padding: 10px 12px; background: var(--panel2); }
.brief summary, .qz summary { cursor: pointer; font-weight: 800; font-size: 14px; }
.brief[open] { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.brief p, .bshort { margin: 0; font-size: 14.5px; }
.mech { color: var(--teal); }
small.mech { color: var(--teal) !important; }
.bfacts { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 4px 12px; margin: 0; font-size: 14px; }
.bfacts dt { font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted); }
.bfacts dd { margin: 0; }
.steps .stx small.prog { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 700; }
.debrief { border-left: 4px solid var(--ok); background: var(--ok-bg); border-radius: 0 var(--r-md) var(--r-md) 0; padding: 10px 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.debrief p { margin: 0; }
.qz { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.qzq { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding-top: 8px; }
.qzq p { margin: 0; }
.qzq p.ok { color: var(--ok); }
.qzq p.bad { color: var(--bad); }
.qzo { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.qzo button { text-align: left; justify-content: flex-start; }
.nextc .nwhy { margin: 0; opacity: .82; font-size: 14px; }
/* The File */
.fsec { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding-top: 10px; margin-top: 10px; }
.fsec h3 { font-size: 16px; margin: 0 0 8px; }
.fl { margin: 0; padding-left: 18px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-size: 14.5px; }
.riskt { color: var(--bad); }
/* Codebook and cipher */
.cipher { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .06em; color: var(--accent); }
button.decode { min-height: 26px; padding: 2px 9px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--hl); color: #1a1600; border: 0; letter-spacing: .02em; }
.cbg h3 { font-size: 15px; margin: 14px 0 6px; }
.cbl { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.cbl li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 8.2em 1fr auto; gap: 10px; align-items: center; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-sm); background: var(--panel); font-size: 14.5px; }
.cbl li.dec { border-color: var(--ok); }
.cbl .raw { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .05em; color: var(--muted); }
.cbl li.dec .raw { color: var(--ok); }
.cbl button.sm { min-height: 30px; padding: 2px 10px; font-size: 12.5px; }
.dsheet { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 110; background: rgba(5,10,14,.72); display: grid; place-items: end center; padding: 16px; }
.dsin { width: min(560px, 100%); background: #0f1c25; color: #eef3f6; border-radius: var(--r-lg) var(--r-lg) var(--r-md) var(--r-md); padding: 18px 18px calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; max-height: 86vh; overflow: auto; }
.dsin .ans-k { color: var(--hl); margin: 0; }
.dsin p { margin: 0; }
.dsin a { color: #9cc4ff; }
.dsin .status { color: rgba(238,243,246,.7); }
.dsraw { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800; font-size: 22px; letter-spacing: .08em; color: rgba(238,243,246,.6); }
.dsname { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800; font-size: 28px; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--hl); min-height: 1.1em; }
.dscar { background: rgba(238,243,246,.07); border-radius: var(--r-sm); padding: 8px 10px; }
.dsparts { margin: 0; padding-left: 0; list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.dsparts b { display: inline-block; min-width: 2.2em; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 20px; color: var(--hl); }
.dsin button { background: var(--hl); color: #1a1600; border: 0; }
.dsin button.quiet { background: transparent; color: #eef3f6; border: 1px solid rgba(238,243,246,.35); }
/* Something's wrong */
.sos { margin-top: 10px; border: 2px solid var(--bad); border-radius: var(--r-md); padding: 10px 12px; background: var(--panel); }
.sos summary { cursor: pointer; font-weight: 800; color: var(--bad); }
.sos[open] { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.soslist { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
@media print {
  body.printing-file > *:not(main) { display: none !important; }
  body.printing-file main > *:not(#p-story) { display: none !important; }
  body.printing-file #p-story > *:not(#stV-file) { display: none !important; }
  body.printing-file #stV-file .row, body.printing-file #stV-file > .status { display: none !important; }
  body.printing-file .rail, body.printing-file .subnav { display: none !important; }
  body.printing-file #fileDoc { color: #000; }
}

/* Pulse strip (header) */
.cockpit { grid-template-areas: "id inst" "pu pu" "st st"; }
@media (max-width: 760px) { .cockpit { grid-template-areas: "id" "inst" "pu" "st"; } }
.pulse { grid-area: pu; display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.pdot { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 34px; padding: 4px 12px 4px 10px; border-radius: 99px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel); color: var(--ink); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; cursor: pointer; }
.pdot b { font-weight: 800; }
.pdot i { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--none, #8a99a5); flex: none; }
.pdot.ok i { background: var(--ok); }
.pdot.watch i { background: var(--warn); }
.pdot.concern i { background: var(--bad); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--bad-bg); }
.pdot:hover { border-color: var(--ink); }

/* Garage map (Today): drawn in the hero's own text color so it works on both hero themes */
#tdQuick { display: block; }
.gmap { width: 100%; max-width: 560px; height: auto; display: block; margin: 8px auto 0; color: inherit; }
.gmap .gbody { fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-opacity: .45; stroke-width: 1.6; }
.gz path, .gz rect, .gz circle { stroke-width: 1.8; transition: fill .3s, stroke .3s; }
.gz.off path, .gz.off rect, .gz.off circle { fill: currentColor; fill-opacity: .06; stroke: currentColor; stroke-opacity: .15; }
.gz.on { cursor: pointer; }
.gz.on path, .gz.on rect, .gz.on circle { fill: #ffd84a; fill-opacity: .55; stroke: currentColor; stroke-opacity: .9; }
.gz.on:hover path, .gz.on:hover rect, .gz.on:hover circle, .gz.on:focus path, .gz.on:focus rect, .gz.on:focus circle { fill-opacity: .85; }
.gz:focus { outline: none; }
.glab { fill: currentColor; font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800; font-size: 13px; pointer-events: none; paint-order: stroke; }
.gmhint { margin: 4px 0 0; text-align: center; font-size: 13px; opacity: .75; }

/* Swipeable Today on phones */
@media (max-width: 700px) {
  .tdgrid { display: flex; overflow-x: auto; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; gap: 12px; padding-bottom: 8px; margin-inline: -16px; padding-inline: 16px; scrollbar-width: none; }
  .tdgrid::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
  .tdgrid > * { flex: 0 0 86%; scroll-snap-align: center; min-width: 0; }
}

/* Skill tree */
.sktree { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; align-items: start; }
.skcol { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; min-width: 0; }
.skb { margin: 0 0 8px; font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); text-align: center; }
.sknode { all: unset; box-sizing: border-box; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; width: 100%; padding: 6px 2px; cursor: pointer; text-align: center; border-radius: var(--r-md); }
.sknode:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); }
.skdot { width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800; font-size: 18px; border: 2px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel); color: var(--muted); }
.sknode.open .skdot { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); }
.sknode.earned .skdot { background: var(--ok); border-color: var(--ok); color: var(--panel); }
.sknode.perk .skdot { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--hl); }
.sknode.locked { opacity: .5; }
.sknode.sel .skdot { outline: 3px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 2px; }
.skt { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; overflow-wrap: break-word; }
@media (min-width: 600px) { .skb { font-size: 12.5px; letter-spacing: .06em; } .skt { font-size: 13px; } }
.skline { display: block; width: 3px; height: 18px; background: var(--line); border-radius: 2px; }
.skline.lit { background: var(--ok); }
.skcap { grid-column: 1 / -1; display: flex; justify-content: center; border-top: 1px dashed var(--line); padding-top: 10px; margin-top: 4px; }
.skcap .sknode { width: auto; }
.skcap .skdot { width: 64px; height: 64px; font-size: 24px; }
.skdetail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; margin-top: 12px; }
.skdetail h3, .skdetail p { margin: 0; }
.perkline { background: var(--panel2); border-radius: var(--r-sm); padding: 8px 10px; }

/* Timeline */
.tline { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.tmon { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800; font-size: 15px; margin-top: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
.tev { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2.4em 1fr; gap: 10px; align-items: start; position: relative; }
.tday { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800; font-size: 18px; text-align: right; padding-top: 8px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.tbtn { all: unset; box-sizing: border-box; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 8px 12px; border-left: 3px solid var(--line); background: var(--panel); border-radius: 0 var(--r-sm) var(--r-sm) 0; cursor: pointer; min-width: 0; }
.tbtn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); }
.tbtn small { color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; }
.tk { font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
.k-case .tbtn { border-left-color: var(--ok); }
.k-risk .tbtn { border-left-color: var(--bad); }
.k-scan .tbtn, .k-codebook .tbtn { border-left-color: var(--accent); }
.k-service .tbtn, .k-receipt .tbtn, .k-oil .tbtn { border-left-color: var(--teal); }

/* Proof photos */
.proofs { display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 4px; }
.proofs img { width: 56px; height: 56px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: var(--r-sm); border: 1px solid var(--line); }
.proofgrid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(120px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.proofgrid figure { margin: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
.proofgrid img { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; object-fit: cover; border-radius: var(--r-sm); }
.proofgrid figcaption { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); }
.steps .sact { flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: flex-end; }

/* Small buttons, toast, sync */
button.sm { min-height: 32px; padding: 4px 12px; font-size: 13px; }
.nospeech [data-speak] { display: none; }
.toast { position: fixed; left: 16px; right: 16px; bottom: calc(84px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); z-index: 120; background: var(--ink); color: var(--bg); padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: var(--r-md); font-size: 14.5px; max-width: 520px; margin: 0 auto; }
.syncbox { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--r-md); padding: 12px; background: var(--panel2); margin: 8px 0; }
.syncbox p { margin: 0; }
.syncsteps { font-size: 14px; }
.syncbar { flex-wrap: wrap; }

/* Drive mode */
.drivemode { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 115; background: #05090c; color: #eef3f6; display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-top)) 16px calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); gap: 12px; }
.dvg { flex: 1; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; }
.dvt { border: 1px solid rgba(238,243,246,.14); border-radius: 18px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; }
.dvt b { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800; font-size: clamp(48px, 16vw, 140px); line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #ffd84a; }
.dvt span { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(238,243,246,.7); }
.dvmsg { margin: 12px 0; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; font-size: 17px; color: #eef3f6; }
.dvmsg:empty { margin: 4px 0; }
.dvx { min-height: 52px; background: #13222c; color: #eef3f6; border: 1px solid rgba(238,243,246,.2); font-size: 16px; }
@media (orientation: landscape) { .dvg { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); } }

/* scan.js: review sheet for reading and redacting a photo before it is saved */
.scanov { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 300; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 92%, transparent); overflow-y: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; padding: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-top)) 16px max(24px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); }
.scanov[hidden] { display: none; }
html.scanning, html.scanning body { overflow: hidden; }
.scanbox { max-width: 760px; margin: 0 auto; background: var(--panel); border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.25); }
.scanbox h2 { margin: 2px 0 6px; }
.scanimg { margin: 10px 0; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; background: #000; display: flex; justify-content: center; }
.scanimg canvas { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; touch-action: none; cursor: crosshair; }
.scanread { margin: 8px 0; }
.scanread .kv dd { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.scanmine { margin-top: 12px; }
.scanmine textarea { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; font: inherit; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(127,127,127,.35)); background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink); }

/* guide.js: full-screen walkthrough, its "back" pill, and one-time tab intros */
.gwov { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 290; background: var(--bg); overflow-y: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; padding: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-top)) 16px max(24px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); }
.gwov[hidden] { display: none; }
html.guiding, html.guiding body { overflow: hidden; }
.gwbox { max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto; }
.gwtop { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.gwtop .ans-k { margin: 0; }
.gwbox h2 { font-size: clamp(26px, 7vw, 34px); line-height: 1.15; margin: 18px 0 10px; }
.gwwhy { font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.45; }
.gwhow { line-height: 1.5; }
.gwprev { margin: 14px 0 0; font-size: 14px; }
.gwbig { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; margin: 22px 0 8px; }
.gwbig button { min-height: 54px; font-size: 18px; width: 100%; }
.gwstuck { background: var(--panel); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; margin: 12px 0; }
.gwstuck .row { margin-top: 8px; }
.gwgate { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; margin: 14px 0; font-size: 17px; }
.gwgate input { width: 22px; height: 22px; }
.gwfoot { margin-top: 10px; }
.gwpill { position: fixed; z-index: 280; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); bottom: calc(84px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); min-height: 46px; padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.25); font-weight: 700; max-width: calc(100vw - 32px); }
.gwpill[hidden] { display: none; }
@media (min-width: 900px) { .gwpill { bottom: 24px; } }
.gintro { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px 12px; background: var(--panel); border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 14px; margin: 0 0 14px; }
.gintro p { margin: 0; flex: 1 1 16em; }

/* batch photo upload */
.phbatch { margin: 10px 0; }
.phbl { list-style: none; margin: 8px 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 8px; }
.phbl li { box-sizing: border-box; max-width: 100%; display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: flex-start; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(128,128,128,.3)); border-radius: 8px; }
.phbl li.dup { opacity: .7; }
.phbl img { width: 56px; height: 56px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 6px; flex: none; }
.phbm { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; flex: 1; }
.phbm select { max-width: 100%; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; }

/* Documents (docs.js) */
.dc-fields .field { min-width: 140px; flex: 1 1 140px; }
.dc-ex { margin: 8px 0 0; max-height: 220px; overflow: auto; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.4; background: var(--panel2); border: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 8px; }
.dc-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin: 8px 0; }
.dc-chips .mn-pill { cursor: pointer; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--ink); font-weight: 500; min-height: 28px; padding: 2px 10px; }
.dc-chips .mn-pill.on { background: var(--ink); color: var(--bg); }
.dc-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.dc-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; gap: 8px 10px; align-items: start; padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.dc-row > div { min-width: 0; }
.dc-row b { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 600; font-size: 17px; }
.dc-row details { margin-top: 4px; }
.dc-row details summary { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; }
.dc-img { display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 240px; margin: 6px 0; border: 1px solid var(--line); }
.dc-rev .ans-k { margin-bottom: 4px; }
@media (max-width: 480px) { .dc-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; } .dc-row .pill { grid-column: 1 / -1; justify-self: start; } }
```

### `src/css/theme.css`

```css
/* Theme overrides, loaded last: the whole app in the manual's dress. Square corners, hairline borders, no shadows,
   ink buttons, mono numbers. Live link and the Data lab keep their instrument faces (teal traces, gauges). */
body { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.5; }
main { gap: 20px; }
h1, h2, h3 { text-transform: none; }
.lede { color: var(--muted); font-size: 14.5px; }
.eyebrow, .ans-k { font-family: var(--font-data); font-weight: 500; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }

/* header */
.cockpit { grid-template-columns: 1fr; grid-template-areas: "strip" "id" "inst" "pu"; gap: 6px; padding: 12px 0 2px; }
.cockpit .strip { grid-area: strip; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.cockpit .brand { font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
.cockpit .savest { grid-area: auto; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
.cockpit .ident h1 { font-size: 34px; line-height: 1; }
.cockpit .sub { font-size: 13px; margin-top: 2px; font-family: var(--font-data); color: var(--muted); }
.instruments { gap: 8px; }
.gauge, .rankchip, .odo { border-radius: 0; border: 1px solid var(--ink); background: var(--panel); }
.gauge { width: 104px; height: 64px; }
.gauge svg { inset: 4px 8px auto; }
.gauge .g-track { stroke-width: 7; stroke-linecap: butt; }
.gauge .g-fill { stroke-width: 7; stroke-linecap: butt; }
.gauge .g-val { bottom: 11px; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; }
.gauge .g-lab { bottom: 1px; font-family: var(--font-data); font-weight: 500; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.rankchip { background: var(--ink); color: var(--bg); border-color: var(--ink); min-width: 0; padding: 6px 10px; }
.rankchip .rk { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; }
.rankchip .rn { font-family: var(--font-data); font-weight: 500; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: .85; }
.odo { padding: 6px 10px; font-family: var(--font-data); font-weight: 500; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.odo input { font-family: var(--font-data); font-weight: 500; font-size: 20px; }
.odo input::placeholder { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; }
.odo i { font-family: var(--font-data); font-weight: 500; }
@media (max-width: 720px) { .gauge { flex-basis: 96px; width: 96px; } }
.syncchip { border-radius: 0; font-family: var(--font-data); font-weight: 500; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .04em; min-height: 28px; padding: 3px 8px; }
.pulse { border-radius: 0; }

/* the bar */
.rail { gap: 0; padding: 0 0 env(safe-area-inset-bottom); background: var(--bg); border-top: 1px solid var(--ink); backdrop-filter: none; -webkit-backdrop-filter: none; }
.rail button { border-radius: 0; border-top: 2px solid transparent; margin-top: -1px; padding: 8px 2px 10px; font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .02em; min-height: 56px; }
.rail button[aria-current="page"] { border-top-color: var(--ink); }
.rail button[aria-current="page"] span { background: none; padding: 0; font-weight: 600; }
.rail button.locked { color: var(--none); }
.rail button.locked svg { stroke-dasharray: 3 2; opacity: .8; }
.rail .newdot { background: var(--new); }
@media (min-width: 1000px) {
  .rail { border-top: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--ink); background: var(--bg); padding-top: 24px; }
  .rail button { border-top: 0; border-left: 2px solid transparent; margin: 0; }
  .rail button[aria-current="page"] { border-left-color: var(--ink); }
}

/* surfaces and controls */
.card, .bay, .chart, .player, .scroll, .diagram, .answer, .tcard, .chap, details.part, .finds li, .actions li, .stp, .quiz fieldset, fieldset.quizset, .fault, .mbtn, .sysrow button, .found, .ph { border-radius: 0; }
.card, .tcard { border: 1px solid var(--line); box-shadow: none; }
.tcard.feature { background: var(--panel); border-color: var(--ink); }
input, select, textarea { border-radius: 0; border-color: var(--line); background: var(--panel); }
input:focus, select:focus, textarea:focus { border-color: var(--ink); }
button { border-radius: 0; font-weight: 600; background: var(--ink); color: var(--bg); border-color: var(--ink); }
button.quiet { background: var(--panel); color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--ink); font-weight: 500; }
button.quiet:hover { background: var(--panel2); }
.filebtn span { border-radius: 0; }
.pill { border-radius: 0; font-family: var(--font-data); font-weight: 500; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 2px 7px; border: 1px solid currentColor; background: transparent; }
.pill.ok { color: var(--ok); } .pill.soon, .pill.watch { color: var(--warn); } .pill.over, .pill.bad, .pill.concern { color: var(--bad); } .pill.none, .pill.info { color: var(--muted); }
.tag { border-radius: 0; font-family: var(--font-data); }
.note { border-radius: 0; background: var(--panel); border-left-width: 3px; }
.note.calm { background: var(--panel); border-left-color: var(--ink); }
.subnav { display: none; }
.seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--ink); color: var(--bg); border-color: var(--ink); }
th { font-family: var(--font-data); font-weight: 500; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
td.num, th.num, .num { font-family: var(--font-data); }
.chip, .chip .v { border-radius: 0; }
.chip .v { font-family: var(--font-data); font-size: 24px; font-weight: 500; }
details > summary { font-weight: 600; }
::selection { background: var(--new-bg); color: var(--ink); }
a:focus-visible, button:focus-visible, input:focus-visible, select:focus-visible, textarea:focus-visible, summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--new); outline-offset: 2px; }
.pdot { border-radius: 0; min-height: 30px; padding: 3px 10px 3px 8px; font-size: 12.5px; }
.pdot b { font-weight: 600; }
.pdot i { border-radius: 0; width: 8px; height: 8px; }

/* Cases (the story) in the manual's dress */
.sthero h2 { font-size: 34px; }
.sbar { height: 6px; border-radius: 0; background: var(--line); }
.sbar i { background: var(--ink); border-radius: 0; }
.stnext { gap: 10px; }
.nextc { background: var(--panel); color: var(--ink); border: 0; border-left: 3px solid var(--new); border-radius: 0; padding: 10px 12px 12px; }
.nextc .ans-k { color: var(--new-ink); }
.nextc h3 { font-size: 22px; }
.nextc button { background: var(--ink); color: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--ink); }
.nextc button.quiet { background: transparent; color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--ink); }
.nextc.scene { border: 0; border-left: 3px solid var(--new); background: var(--panel); }
.act h3 { font-family: var(--font-data); font-weight: 500; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink); padding: 14px 0 5px; margin: 0; gap: 10px; }
.act h3 span { font-family: var(--font-data); font-weight: 500; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .12em; color: var(--muted); }
.cases { gap: 0; }
.case { border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; overflow: visible; }
.case.closed, .case.risk { border-color: var(--line); }
.case.open { box-shadow: none; border-left: 3px solid var(--ink); background: var(--panel); margin: 6px 0; }
.caseh { grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; padding: 11px 0; }
.case.open .caseh { padding: 11px 12px; }
.caseh .pill { grid-column: 1 / -1; order: 3; justify-self: start; margin-top: 4px; }
.caseh .ct b { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 600; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.05; }
.caseh .ct small { font-size: 13px; }
.case .cto { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; padding: 0 0 10px; }
.case.open .cto { padding: 0 12px 10px; }
.case .cto .mn-pill { cursor: pointer; min-height: 28px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--ink); font-weight: 500; }
.case.unknown .cto .mn-pill { color: var(--muted); border-color: var(--muted); }
.caseh .cn { font-family: var(--font-data); font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); padding-top: 4px; }
.mn-stamp.risk { border-color: var(--bad); color: var(--bad); }
.caseb { padding: 12px; }
.case.unknown .caseh .ct b { color: var(--muted); }
.steps .sdot { border-radius: 0; border-width: 1.5px; font-weight: 700; }
.steps li.done .sdot { background: transparent; color: var(--done); border-color: var(--done); }

/* inner pages (anything but the home) get a one-row header: the brand strip and the pulse, no title, no instruments */
body.inner .cockpit { grid-template-areas: "strip" "pu"; padding: 8px 0 0; gap: 4px; }
body.inner .cockpit .ident, body.inner .cockpit .instruments { display: none; }
body.inner .cockpit .brand { font-size: 10px; }
body.inner .cockpit #saveStatus { display: none; }
```

### `src/js/core.js`

```javascript

(function () {
  "use strict";

  /* ---------- reference data ---------- */
  var ITEMS = [
    { key: "oil", name: "Engine oil and filter", mi: 10000, mo: 12, verify: false, note: "Volvo's 2016 US schedule: every 10,000 miles or 12 months. Full synthetic ACEA A5/B5 5W-30, or Volvo's 0W-20 (VCC RBS0-2AE). 6.2 quarts with filter." },
    { key: "cabin", name: "Cabin air filter", mi: 20000, mo: 12, verify: false, note: "Every 20,000 miles, and Volvo suggests at least once a year." },
    { key: "airfilter", name: "Engine air filter", mi: 40000, mo: null, verify: false, note: "At 40k, 80k and 120k miles per Volvo's 2016 US schedule." },

  function esc(s) { return String(s == null ? "" : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) { return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c]; }); }
  function fmt(n) { return Number(n).toLocaleString("en-US"); }
  function f1(n) { return (Math.round(n * 10) / 10).toString(); }
  function uid() { return Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7); }
  function todayStr() { var d = new Date(); return d.getFullYear() + "-" + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0"); }
  function monthsSince(dateStr) { var p = dateStr.split("-"); var d = new Date(Number(p[0]), Number(p[1]) - 1, Number(p[2])); return (Date.now() - d.getTime()) / (30.4375 * 86400000); }
  function setStatus(t) { $("saveStatus").textContent = t; }
  function isNum(x) { return typeof x === "number" && isFinite(x); }

  function clean(raw) {
    var out = { odo: null, log: [], oil: [], rate: {}, codes: [], runs: [], mods: {} };
    if (!raw || typeof raw !== "object") return out;
    if (isNum(raw.odo)) out.odo = raw.odo;
    ["log", "oil"].forEach(function (k) {
      if (Array.isArray(raw[k])) out[k] = raw[k].filter(function (e) { return e && isNum(e.miles) && typeof e.date === "string"; });
    });
    if (Array.isArray(raw.codes)) out.codes = raw.codes.filter(function (e) { return e && typeof e.code === "string" && typeof e.date === "string"; });
    if (Array.isArray(raw.runs)) out.runs = raw.runs.filter(function (e) { return e && typeof e.date === "string"; });
    if (raw.academy && typeof raw.academy === "object") {
      var ac = raw.academy, o = { done: {}, quiz: {}, jobs: {}, data: {} };
      if (ac.bayFound && typeof ac.bayFound === "object") { o.bayFound = {}; Object.keys(ac.bayFound).forEach(function (k) { o.bayFound[k] = 1; }); }
      if (ac.sim && isNum(ac.sim.played) && isNum(ac.sim.correct)) o.sim = { played: ac.sim.played, correct: ac.sim.correct, clean: isNum(ac.sim.clean) ? ac.sim.clean : 0 };
      ["done", "quiz", "jobs", "data"].forEach(function (k) { if (ac[k] && typeof ac[k] === "object" && !Array.isArray(ac[k])) Object.keys(ac[k]).slice(0, 200).forEach(function (id) { if (ac[k][id] && typeof ac[k][id] === "object") o[k][id] = ac[k][id]; }); });
      out.academy = o;
    }
    if (raw.lastScan && typeof raw.lastScan === "object") out.lastScan = raw.lastScan;
    if (raw.bayMap && typeof raw.bayMap === "object") { var bm = { photo: typeof raw.bayMap.photo === "string" ? raw.bayMap.photo : null, pins: {} }; if (raw.bayMap.pins && typeof raw.bayMap.pins === "object") Object.keys(raw.bayMap.pins).forEach(function (k) { var v = raw.bayMap.pins[k]; if (Array.isArray(v) && isNum(v[0]) && isNum(v[1])) bm.pins[k] = [v[0], v[1]]; }); out.bayMap = bm; }
    if (raw.recalls && typeof raw.recalls === "object") { out.recalls = {}; Object.keys(raw.recalls).forEach(function (k) { if (["unknown", "done", "open", "na"].indexOf(raw.recalls[k]) >= 0) out.recalls[k] = raw.recalls[k]; }); }
    if (Array.isArray(raw.specs)) out.specs = raw.specs.filter(function (x) { return x && typeof x.k === "string" && typeof x.v === "string"; }).slice(-200);
    if (Array.isArray(raw.photos)) { var seenH = {}; out.photos = raw.photos.filter(function (x) { if (!(x && typeof x.asset === "string" && typeof x.date === "string")) return false; /* the same picture saved twice (two devices, or a repeat pick) keeps its first copy */ if (typeof x.hash === "string" && x.hash) { if (seenH[x.hash]) return false; seenH[x.hash] = 1; } return true; }).slice(-200); }
    out.mods = {};
    if (raw.mods && typeof raw.mods === "object") MODS.forEach(function (m) { var v = raw.mods[m.id]; if (v != null) { try { out.mods[m.id] = m.clean ? m.clean(v) : v; } catch (e) { /* drop bad module data */ } } });
    if (raw.rate && typeof raw.rate === "object") {
      Object.keys(raw.rate).forEach(function (k) {
        var r = raw.rate[k];
        if (r && isNum(r.r) && r.r >= 1 && r.r <= 5) out.rate[k] = { r: r.r, d: String(r.d || ""), n: String(r.n || "").slice(0, 200) };
      });
    }
    return out;
  }

  var quietSave = false;
  /* Nothing may be written to storage until the saved copy has been read: modules (the Story sweep) call save() while the page starts, and a snapshot of the still-empty state used to overwrite the saved data, which then synced. */
  var loaded = false;
  function save() {
    if (!loaded) return;
    var snapshot = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state));
    chain = chain.then(function () {
      if (mode === "db" && ref) return ref.set(snapshot).then(function () { setStatus("Saved to your private data for this page"); });
      try { localStorage.setItem(LSKEY, JSON.stringify(snapshot)); setStatus(window.V60_SYNC && window.V60_SYNC.on() ? "Saved on this device · syncing" : "Saved on this device"); }
      catch (e) { setStatus("Could not save. Changes last until you close the page."); }
      if (window.V60_SYNC && !quietSave) window.V60_SYNC.changed();
    }).catch(function () {
      try { localStorage.setItem(LSKEY, JSON.stringify(snapshot)); setStatus("Cloud save failed. Kept in this browser only."); }
      catch (e) { setStatus("Could not save. Changes last until you close the page."); }
    });
  }

  /* ---------- maintenance logic ---------- */
  function lastFor(key) {
    var best = null;
    state.log.forEach(function (e) {
      if (e.item !== key) return;
      if (!best || e.date > best.date || (e.date === best.date && e.miles > best.miles)) best = e;
    });
    return best;
  }
  function itemByKey(k) { for (var i = 0; i < ITEMS.length; i++) if (ITEMS[i].key === k) return ITEMS[i]; return null; }
  function statusFor(item) {
    var last = lastFor(item.key);
    if (!last) return { cls: "none", label: "No record", detail: "", ratio: null };
    var ratios = [], parts = [];
    if (item.mi && state.odo != null) {
      var since = state.odo - last.miles;
      ratios.push(since / item.mi);
      var left = item.mi - since;
      parts.push(left >= 0 ? fmt(Math.round(left)) + " mi left" : fmt(Math.round(-left)) + " mi over");
    }
    if (item.mo) {
      var m = monthsSince(last.date);
      ratios.push(m / item.mo);
      var days = Math.round((item.mo - m) * 30.4375);
      parts.push(days >= 0 ? fmt(days) + " days left" : fmt(-days) + " days over");
    }
    if (!ratios.length) return { cls: "none", label: item.mi || item.mo ? "Need odometer" : "Check only", detail: "", ratio: null };
    var r = Math.max.apply(null, ratios);
    return { cls: r >= 1 ? "over" : (r >= 0.85 ? "soon" : "ok"), label: r >= 1 ? "Overdue" : (r >= 0.85 ? "Due soon" : "On track"), detail: parts.join(", "), ratio: r };
  }
  function oilRate() {
    var list = state.oil.slice().sort(function (a, b) { return a.miles - b.miles; });
    if (list.length < 2) return null;
    var span = list[list.length - 1].miles - list[0].miles;
    if (span <= 0) return null;
    var added = 0;
    for (var i = 1; i < list.length; i++) added += Number(list[i].qts) || 0;
    return { rate: added / span * 1000, added: added, span: span, from: list[0].date, to: list[list.length - 1].date };
  }

  /* ---------- parts and systems ---------- */
  function partsOf(sys) { return PARTS.filter(function (p) { return p.sys === sys; }); }
  function partById(id) { for (var i = 0; i < PARTS.length; i++) if (PARTS[i].id === id) return PARTS[i]; return null; }
  function ratingOf(id) { var r = state.rate[id]; return r ? r.r : 0; }
  function sysCond(sys) {
    var ps = partsOf(sys), rated = ps.filter(function (p) { return ratingOf(p.id) > 0; });
    if (!rated.length) return { cls: "none", avg: null, n: 0, total: ps.length };
    var sum = 0, min = 5;
    rated.forEach(function (p) { var r = ratingOf(p.id); sum += r; if (r < min) min = r; });
    var avg = sum / rated.length;
    return { cls: (min <= 2 || avg < 3) ? "bad" : (avg < 4 ? "soon" : "ok"), avg: avg, n: rated.length, total: ps.length };
  }
  function sysMaint(sys) {
    var rank = { none: 0, ok: 1, soon: 2, over: 3 }, worst = "none";
    partsOf(sys).forEach(function (p) {
      if (!p.link) return;
      var it = itemByKey(p.link);
      if (!it) return;
      var s = statusFor(it).cls;
      if (rank[s] > rank[worst]) worst = s;
    });
    return worst === "over" ? "bad" : worst;
  }
  function zoneCls(sys) { return ui.overlay === "maint" ? sysMaint(sys) : sysCond(sys).cls; }

  /* ---------- bay ---------- */
  function buildBay() {
    /* upright phone: crop to the car and draw the numbers bigger; the 13 buttons under the drawing stay the main way in */
    var phone = window.matchMedia && matchMedia("(max-width: 600px)").matches, rr = phone ? 32 : 20, rd = phone ? 27 : 13;
    var pins = SYSTEMS.map(function (s, i) {
      return '<g class="pin z-none" data-sys="' + s.id + '" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="' + esc(s.n) + '" transform="translate(' + s.pin[0] + " " + s.pin[1] + ')">' +
        '<title>' + esc(s.n) + '</title><circle class="ring" r="' + rr + '"/><circle class="dot" r="' + rd + '"/><text y="' + (phone ? 9 : 4.5) + '"' + (phone ? ' style="font-size:26px"' : "") + ">" + (i + 1) + "</text></g>";
    }).join("");
    $("bayDiagram").innerHTML = '<svg viewBox="' + (phone ? "30 112 830 252" : "0 112 900 258") + '" role="group" data-also="buttons" aria-label="Side view of the car with a numbered pin for each system">' +
      '<line class="ground" x1="10" y1="356" x2="890" y2="356"/>' +
      '<path class="body" d="M44 316 L40 262 Q44 236 92 228 L250 214 L372 148 Q386 140 408 140 L640 140 Q700 144 756 190 L808 232 Q834 244 840 270 L842 316 Z"/>' +
      '<path class="glass" d="M262 210 L368 156 L444 156 L444 210 Z"/>' +
      '<path class="glass" d="M458 156 L636 156 Q684 160 728 198 L744 210 L458 210 Z"/>' +
      '<path class="seam" d="M451 156 V316"/><path class="seam" d="M92 228 Q200 240 250 214"/>' +
      '<circle class="cut" cx="200" cy="300" r="66"/><circle class="cut" cx="705" cy="300" r="66"/>' +
      '<circle class="tire" cx="200" cy="300" r="54"/><circle class="tire" cx="705" cy="300" r="54"/>' +
      '<circle class="rim" cx="200" cy="300" r="34"/><circle class="rim" cx="705" cy="300" r="34"/>' +
      '<circle class="rim" cx="200" cy="300" r="9"/><circle class="rim" cx="705" cy="300" r="9"/>' +
      pins + "</svg>";
    $("sysRow").innerHTML = SYSTEMS.map(function (s, i) {
      return '<button type="button" data-sys="' + s.id + '" aria-pressed="false"><i class="z-none"></i>' + (i + 1) + ". " + esc(s.n) + "</button>";
    }).join("");
  }

  function renderBay() {
    SYSTEMS.forEach(function (s) {
      var z = zoneCls(s.id);
      var pin = document.querySelector('.pin[data-sys="' + s.id + '"]');
      if (pin) { pin.setAttribute("class", "pin z-" + z); pin.setAttribute("aria-pressed", ui.sys === s.id ? "true" : "false"); }
      var chip = document.querySelector('#sysRow button[data-sys="' + s.id + '"]');
      if (chip) { chip.setAttribute("aria-pressed", ui.sys === s.id ? "true" : "false"); chip.querySelector("i").setAttribute("class", "z-" + z); }
    });
    var sys = SYSTEMS.filter(function (s) { return s.id === ui.sys; })[0];
    var c = sysCond(sys.id);
    var parts = partsOf(sys.id).map(function (p) {
      var r = ratingOf(p.id), note = state.rate[p.id] ? state.rate[p.id].n : "";
      var cls = r === 0 ? "none" : (r <= 2 ? "bad" : (r === 3 ? "soon" : "ok"));
      var lbl = ["Unrated", "Failed", "Poor", "Fair", "Good", "New"][r];
      var link = "";
      if (p.link) {
        var it = itemByKey(p.link), last = lastFor(p.link);
        if (it) { var s = statusFor(it); link = '<p><b>Service:</b> <span class="pill ' + s.cls + '">' + s.label + "</span> " + (last ? "last at " + fmt(last.miles) + " mi on " + esc(last.date) : "no record yet") + ' <button type="button" class="quiet" data-jump="tab:records">Open records</button></p>'; }
        else if (p.link === "trans" || p.link === "tires") { var l2 = lastFor(p.link); link = "<p><b>Service:</b> " + (l2 ? "last logged at " + fmt(l2.miles) + " mi on " + esc(l2.date) : "no record yet") + "</p>"; }
      }
      var rb = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(function (n) {
        return '<button type="button" data-rate="' + p.id + ":" + n + '" data-lv="' + n + '" aria-pressed="' + (r === n ? "true" : "false") + '">' + (n === 0 ? "Unrated" : n + " " + ["", "Failed", "Poor", "Fair", "Good", "New"][n]) + "</button>";
      }).join("");
      return '<details class="part" id="part-' + p.id + '"' + (ui.open[p.id] ? " open" : "") + ' data-pid="' + p.id + '">' +
        '<summary><span class="nm">' + esc(p.name) + '</span><span class="tag">' + DIFFN[p.diff] + '</span><span class="pill ' + cls + '">' + lbl + "</span></summary>" +
        '<div class="pbody"><p>' + esc(p.role) + "</p>" +
        "<div><h4>Signs of trouble</h4><ul>" + p.signs.map(function (x) { return "<li>" + esc(x) + "</li>"; }).join("") + "</ul></div>" +
        "<div><h4>How to check</h4><p>" + esc(p.check) + "</p></div>" + link +
        '<div class="rate" role="group" aria-label="Condition of ' + esc(p.name) + '">' + rb + "</div>" +
        '<div class="field"><label for="n-' + p.id + '">Inspection note</label><input id="n-' + p.id + '" class="wide" data-note="' + p.id + '" type="text" maxlength="200" value="' + esc(note) + '"></div>' +
        (state.rate[p.id] && state.rate[p.id].d ? '<p class="status">Rated ' + esc(state.rate[p.id].d) + "</p>" : "") +
        "</div></details>";
    }).join("");
    $("sysDetail").innerHTML = "<h2>" + esc(sys.n) + "</h2><p>" + esc(sys.b) + '</p><p class="status">' +
      (c.n ? c.n + " of " + c.total + " parts rated, average " + f1(c.avg) + " out of 5" : c.total + " parts, none rated yet") + "</p>" + parts;
  }

  /* ---------- diagnose ---------- */
  function sysName(id) { for (var i = 0; i < SYSTEMS.length; i++) if (SYSTEMS[i].id === id) return SYSTEMS[i].n; return id; }
  function renderSymptom() {
    var id = $("symSel").value, out = $("symOut");
    var s = SYMPTOMS.filter(function (x) { return x.id === id; })[0];
    if (!s) { out.innerHTML = '<p class="empty">Choose a symptom to see the likely causes.</p>'; return; }
    out.innerHTML = '<ol class="actions" style="list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0">' + s.causes.map(function (c, i) {
      var p = partById(c[0]);
      if (!p) return "";
      var r = ratingOf(p.id);
      return '<li><span class="pill none">' + (i + 1) + '</span><span class="tx"><b>' + esc(p.name) + '</b> <span class="tag">' + DIFFN[p.diff] + "</span><br>" + esc(c[1]) + "</span>" +
        (r ? '<span class="pill ' + (r <= 2 ? "bad" : (r === 3 ? "soon" : "ok")) + '">rated ' + r + "</span>" : "") +
        '<button type="button" class="quiet" data-jump="part:' + p.id + '">Inspect</button></li>';
    }).join("") + "</ol>" + '<p class="lede">Ordered roughly from cheapest and easiest to check toward harder jobs. A flashing check engine light means an active misfire: ease off and get it checked soon, since raw fuel can damage the catalytic converter.</p>';
  }
  function decodeCode(raw) {
    var c = String(raw || "").trim().toUpperCase();
    if (!/^[PBCU][0-3][0-9A-F]{3}$/.test(c)) return { code: c, valid: false };
    var known = CODES[c];
    var d2 = c.charAt(1);
    var scope = d2 === "0" ? "generic (standard across makes)" : (d2 === "1" ? "manufacturer-specific (Volvo, needs Volvo information)" : "can be generic or manufacturer-specific");
    return { code: c, valid: true, known: known || null, prefix: PREFIX[c.charAt(0)], scope: scope };
  }
  function renderCodeLookup() {
    var v = $("codeIn").value.trim();
    var out = $("codeOut");
    if (!v) { out.innerHTML = ""; return; }
    var r = decodeCode(v);
    if (!r.valid) { out.innerHTML = '<p class="empty">Codes have five characters: a letter (P, B, C or U) followed by four digits, such as P0128.</p>'; return; }
    if (!r.known) {
      out.innerHTML = '<div class="card"><h3>' + esc(r.code) + '</h3><p>' + esc(r.prefix) + ". The second character marks it as " + esc(r.scope) + ". This code is not in the short list the page carries. Look it up in Volvo service information or ask a Volvo-capable shop.</p></div>";
      return;
    }
    var k = r.known;
    out.innerHTML = '<div class="card"><h3>' + esc(r.code) + " " + esc(k.t) + '</h3><p>' + esc(r.prefix) + ", " + esc(r.scope) + "." +
      '</p><p><b>Common causes:</b> ' + esc(k.c) + '.</p><p><b>Urgency:</b> ' + esc(URG[k.u]) + '</p><p><button type="button" class="quiet" data-jump="sys:' + k.sys + '">Open ' + esc(sysName(k.sys)) + "</button></p></div>";
  }
  function codeTitle(code) { var k = CODES[String(code).toUpperCase()]; return k ? k.t : "Not in the page's short list"; }
  function renderLastScan() {
    var L = state.lastScan, el = $("lastScan"); if (!el) return;
    if (!L) { el.innerHTML = ""; return; }
    el.innerHTML = '<div class="note calm"><b>Last V60 Link check, ' + esc(L.date) + ":</b> check-engine light " + (L.mil ? "on" : "off") + ", " + L.codes + " code" + (L.codes === 1 ? "" : "s") + " reported, " + (L.monitors ? (L.notReady.length ? L.notReady.length + " of " + L.monitors + " readiness monitors not ready (" + esc(L.notReady.join(", ")) + ")" : "all " + L.monitors + " readiness monitors ready") : "no readiness data") + ".</div>";
  }
  function renderCodes() {
    renderLastScan();
    var list = state.codes.slice().sort(function (a, b) { return a.date < b.date ? 1 : -1; });
    if (!list.length) { $("codeBody").innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" class="empty">No codes logged. When a scanner shows one, add it here so the Health tab counts it while it is active.</td></tr>'; return; }
    var lab = { active: "Active", cleared: "Cleared", resolved: "Fixed" };
    var cl = { active: "bad", cleared: "soon", resolved: "ok" };
    $("codeBody").innerHTML = list.map(function (e) {
      return '<tr><td class="num">' + esc(e.code) + "</td><td>" + esc(codeTitle(e.code)) + (e.note ? "<small>" + esc(e.note) + "</small>" : "") + '</td><td class="num">' + esc(e.date) + '</td><td class="num">' + (isNum(e.miles) ? fmt(e.miles) : "") +
        '</td><td><span class="pill ' + cl[e.status] + '">' + lab[e.status] + "</span></td><td>" + delBtn("code", e.id) + "</td></tr>";
    }).join("");
  }

  /* ---------- records ---------- */
  function delBtn(kind, id) { var k = kind + ":" + id, armed = !!pendingDel[k]; return '<button type="button" class="quiet' + (armed ? " confirm" : "") + '" data-del="' + k + '">' + (armed ? "Confirm" : "Delete") + "</button>"; }
  function renderDue() {
    var rows = ITEMS.map(function (item) {
      var s = statusFor(item), last = lastFor(item.key), interval = [];
      if (item.mi) interval.push(fmt(item.mi) + " mi");
      if (item.mo) interval.push(item.mo + " mo");
      return "<tr><td>" + esc(item.name) + (item.verify ? '<span class="tag verify">verify</span>' : "") + "<small>" + esc(item.note) + "</small></td>" +
        '<td class="num">' + esc(interval.join(" / ")) + '</td><td class="num">' + (last ? fmt(last.miles) + " mi<small>" + esc(last.date) + "</small>" : "<small>Not logged</small>") + "</td>" +
        '<td><span class="pill ' + s.cls + '">' + s.label + "</span>" + (s.detail ? "<small>" + esc(s.detail) + "</small>" : "") + "</td></tr>";
    });
    var t = lastFor("trans");
    rows.push("<tr><td>Automatic transmission fluid<small>Volvo publishes no fixed interval for normal driving. Some shops service it anyway. Ask a dealer for the right fluid by VIN.</small></td>" +
      '<td class="num">none set</td><td class="num">' + (t ? fmt(t.miles) + " mi<small>" + esc(t.date) + "</small>" : "<small>Not logged</small>") + '</td><td><span class="pill none">Inspect</span></td></tr>');
    $("dueBody").innerHTML = rows.join("");
  }
  function renderLog() {
    var list = state.log.slice().sort(function (a, b) { return a.date < b.date ? 1 : (a.date > b.date ? -1 : b.miles - a.miles); });
    if (!list.length) { $("logBody").innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="5" class="empty">No entries yet. Add the last oil change, brake fluid flush or any repair you know the date of, and the table above fills in.</td></tr>'; return; }
    $("logBody").innerHTML = list.map(function (e) {
      return '<tr><td class="num">' + esc(e.date) + '</td><td class="num">' + fmt(e.miles) + "</td><td>" + esc(NAMES[e.item] || e.item) + "</td><td>" + esc(e.notes || "") + "</td><td>" + delBtn("log", e.id) + "</td></tr>";
    }).join("");
  }
  function renderOil() {
    var box = $("oilReadout"), o = oilRate();
    if (state.oil.length < 2) box.innerHTML = '<span class="status">Add at least two checks to see a consumption rate. Log the first right after an oil change.</span>';
    else if (!o) box.innerHTML = '<span class="status">The checks need different odometer readings to give a rate.</span>';
    else box.innerHTML = '<span style="font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:40px;font-weight:600;line-height:1">' + o.rate.toFixed(2) + '</span><span class="status">quarts per 1,000 miles</span><span class="status">' + f1(o.added) + " qt added over " + fmt(o.span) + " mi, " + esc(o.from) + " to " + esc(o.to) + "</span>";
    var rows = state.oil.slice().sort(function (a, b) { return b.miles - a.miles; });
    if (!rows.length) { $("oilBody").innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="4" class="empty">No checks yet. Read the oil level in the instrument cluster at fill-ups and log the odometer and any quarts you add.</td></tr>'; return; }
    $("oilBody").innerHTML = rows.map(function (e) {
      return '<tr><td class="num">' + esc(e.date) + '</td><td class="num">' + fmt(e.miles) + '</td><td class="num">' + esc(e.qts) + "</td><td>" + delBtn("oil", e.id) + "</td></tr>";
    }).join("");
  }

  /* ---------- data lab: parsing ---------- */
  function splitLine(line, d) {
    var out = [], cur = "", q = false;
    for (var i = 0; i < line.length; i++) {
      var c = line.charAt(i);

  function demoDataset() {

    function spd(x) { for (var i = 1; i < key.length; i++) if (x <= key[i][0]) { var a = key[i - 1], b = key[i], f = (x - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0]); return a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * f; } return 0; }

      var thr = v < 0.5 ? 0 : Math.max(0, Math.min(100, 8 + v * 0.18 + acc * 7));
      var rpm = v < 0.5 ? 760 + rnd() * 40 : 1100 + v * 17 + acc * 40 + rnd() * 40;

      var boost = thr > 55 ? (thr - 55) * 2.2 : 0;
      o.speed.push(v + rnd() * 0.4);
      o.rpm.push(rpm);
      o.throttle.push(thr + rnd());
      o.load.push(load);
      o.maf.push(2.6 + (rpm * load) / 3200 + rnd() * 0.3);
      o.map.push(34 + load * 0.55 + boost + rnd() * 2);
      o.coolant.push(21 + (89 - 21) * (1 - Math.exp(-s / 190)) + rnd() * 0.6);
      o.iat.push(26 + 12 * (1 - Math.exp(-s / 260)) + rnd() * 0.5);
      o.stft.push(rnd() * 6 + (v < 0.5 ? 1.5 : 0));
      o.ltft.push(3.5 + rnd() * 0.8 + (v < 0.5 ? 2.5 : 0));
      o.volt.push(s < 3 ? 12.2 : 14.1 + rnd() * 0.25);

    { k: "volt", label: "Running voltage", u: "V", judge: function (c, b) { return b - c >= 0.4 ? { level: "watch", title: "Running voltage is " + f1(b - c) + " V below your baseline", detail: "A steady decline over several runs can mean a tiring alternator or battery.     { k: "idleRpm", label: "Warm idle", u: "rpm", r: 0, judge: function (c, b) { return Math.abs(c - b) >= 100 ? { level: "watch", title: "Warm idle has shifted " + Math.round(c - b) + " rpm from your baseline", detail: "The computer may be compensating for an intake leak, a dirty throttle body or a load such as A/C.   /* ---------- health ---------- */

      var s = statusFor(it);

        if (dueWithin(it, 0, 0)) actions.push({ sev: it.key === "timingbelt" ? 88 : 35, text: "No record of " + it.name.toLowerCase() + ". " + (function (m) { m = m.replace(/^No record, and /, ""); return m.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + m.slice(1); })(dueWithin(it, 0, 0)) + ". " + (it.key === "timingbelt" ?         return;

      if (s.cls === "over") actions.push({ sev: 90, text: it.name + " is overdue" + (s.detail ? " (" + s.detail + ")" : ""), jump: "tab:records" });
      else if (s.cls === "soon") actions.push({ sev: 50, text: it.name + " is due soon" + (s.detail ? " (" + s.detail + ")" : ""), jump: "tab:records" });
    });
    if (ms.length) comps.push({ k: "Service status", w: 30, v: ms.reduce(function (a, b) { return a + b; }, 0) / ms.length, n: ms.length + " items logged" });
    var rated = PARTS.filter(function (p) { return ratingOf(p.id) > 0; });
    if (rated.length) {
      comps.push({ k: "Part condition", w: 30, v: rated.reduce(function (a, p) { return a + (ratingOf(p.id) - 1) / 4 * 100; }, 0) / rated.length, n: rated.length + " parts rated" });
      rated.forEach(function (p) {

        if (r === 1) actions.push({ sev: 95, text: p.name + " is rated failed" + (note ? ": " + note : ""), jump: "part:" + p.id });
        else if (r === 2) actions.push({ sev: 70, text: p.name + " is rated poor" + (note ? ": " + note : ""), jump: "part:" + p.id });
      });
    }
    if (state.codes.length) {
      var act = state.codes.filter(function (c) { return c.status === "active"; });
      comps.push({ k: "Trouble codes", w: 20, v: Math.max(0, 100 - act.length * 20), n: act.length + " active" });
      act.forEach(function (c) { var k = CODES[String(c.code).toUpperCase()]; actions.push({ sev: k && k.u === "now" ? 92 : 85, text: "Active code " + c.code + ": " + codeTitle(c.code), jump: "tab:diag" }); });
    }
    var o = oilRate();
    if (o) {
      var v = o.rate <= 0.25 ? 100 : (o.rate <= 0.5 ? 75 : (o.rate <= 1 ? 45 : 20));
      comps.push({ k: "Oil use", w: 10, v: v, n: o.rate.toFixed(2) + " qt per 1,000 mi" });
      if (o.rate > 0.5) actions.push({ sev: 65, text: "Oil use is " + o.rate.toFixed(2) + " qt per 1,000 miles. Keep logging and ask Volvo about a consumption test.", jump: "tab:records" });
    }

      (run.titles || []).forEach(function (t) { actions.push({ sev: t.level === "concern" ? 80 : 45, text: "Data lab " + (t.level === "concern" ? "concern" : "watch item") + ": " + t.title, jump: "tab:lab" }); });
      computeDrift().finds.forEach(function (f) { actions.push({ sev: f.level === "concern" ? 85 : 55, text: "Trend: " + f.title, jump: "tab:lab" }); });

    var unrated = PARTS.length - rated.length;
    if (unrated > 0) actions.push({ sev: 10, text: unrated + " of " + PARTS.length + " parts are not rated yet. Walk the bay and rate what you can see.", jump: "tab:bay" });
    if (state.odo == null) actions.push({ sev: 30, text: "Enter your odometer so service intervals can be checked.", jump: "tab:records" });
    var wsum = 0, tot = 0;
    comps.forEach(function (c) { wsum += c.w; tot += c.w * c.v; });
    MODS.forEach(function (m) { if (m.actions) try { m.actions(API, actions); } catch (e) {} });
    actions.sort(function (a, b) { return b.sev - a.sev; });
    return { score: wsum ? Math.round(tot / wsum) : null, comps: comps, used: comps.length, actions: actions };
  }
  function renderHealth() {
    var h = computeHealth();
    $("hudScore").textContent = h.score == null ? "--" : String(h.score);
    var gb = document.querySelector(".gauge"); if (gb) { gb.className = "gauge" + (h.score == null ? "" : (h.score >= 75 ? " ok" : (h.score >= 50 ? " mid" : " low"))); $("gFill").style.strokeDasharray = (h.score == null ? 0 : h.score) + " 100"; }
    var sc = $("scoreCard");
    if (h.score == null) sc.innerHTML = '<div><div class="big">--</div><div class="status">No data yet</div></div><p class="lede">Log a service, rate a few parts or add a code and a score appears here.</p>';
    else sc.innerHTML = '<div><div class="big">' + h.score + '</div><div class="status">out of 100, from ' + h.used + " of 5 inputs</div></div><div class=\"bars\">" +
      h.comps.map(function (c) { var cl = c.v < 50 ? "low" : (c.v < 75 ? "mid" : ""); return '<div class="bar ' + cl + '"><span>' + esc(c.k) + '</span><span class="tr"><span class="fl" style="display:block;width:' + Math.round(c.v) + '%"></span></span><span>' + Math.round(c.v) + "</span></div>"; }).join("") + "</div>";
    var top = h.actions.slice(0, 10);
    $("actions").innerHTML = top.length ? top.map(function (a) {
      var cl = a.sev >= 85 ? "bad" : (a.sev >= 45 ? "soon" : "none");
      return '<li><span class="pill ' + cl + '">' + (a.sev >= 85 ? "Act" : (a.sev >= 45 ? "Soon" : "Later")) + '</span><span class="tx">' + esc(a.text) + '</span><button type="button" class="quiet" data-jump="' + a.jump + '">Open</button></li>';
    }).join("") : '<li><span class="tx">Nothing to fix yet. Enter some records and this list ranks them.</span></li>';
  }

  /* ask claude */
  var sampleFn = null, askCtl = null;
  function ctxJSON() {
    var due = ITEMS.map(function (it) { var s = statusFor(it), l = lastFor(it.key); return { item: it.name, status: s.label, detail: s.detail, lastMiles: l ? l.miles : null, lastDate: l ? l.date : null }; });
    var lowParts = PARTS.filter(function (p) { var r = ratingOf(p.id); return r > 0 && r <= 3; }).map(function (p) { return { part: p.name, system: sysName(p.sys), rating: ratingOf(p.id), note: state.rate[p.id].n }; });
    var codes = state.codes.filter(function (c) { return c.status !== "resolved"; }).map(function (c) { return { code: c.code, state: c.status, meaning: codeTitle(c.code), note: c.note || "" }; });
    var o = oilRate(), run = latestRun();
    return JSON.stringify({ odometerMiles: state.odo, service: due, partsRatedFairOrWorse: lowParts, codes: codes, oilQuartsPer1000mi: o ? Math.round(o.rate * 100) / 100 : null, latestRun: run ? { date: run.date, coolMaxC: run.coolMax, warmUpMin: run.warmMin, ltftPct: run.ltft, stftPct: run.stft, volts: run.volt, idleRpm: run.idleRpm, findings: run.titles } : null, ratingScale: "1 failed, 2 poor, 3 fair, 4 good, 5 new" });
  }
  function askClaude() {
    var q = $("askQ").value.trim();
    if (!q || !sampleFn) return;
    var prompt = "You are helping the owner of a 2016 Volvo V60 T5 (2.0 L turbo Drive-E, front-wheel drive, 8-speed automatic) plan maintenance and diagnosis. Use only the owner data below plus well-established general automotive knowledge. Do not invent Volvo specifications or intervals; when unsure, say so and suggest checking Volvo's dealer information or the owner's manual. Separate what can be done safely at home from what needs a shop. Never recommend engine tuning or ECU flashing. Be practical and keep the answer under 350 words, in short plain paragraphs without tables.\n\nOWNER DATA (JSON):\n" + ctxJSON() + "\n\nQUESTION:\n" + q;
    askCtl = new AbortController();
    $("askGo").disabled = true; $("askStop").hidden = false;
    $("askOut").textContent = "Thinking...";
    $("askStatus").textContent = "";
    sampleFn(prompt, { signal: askCtl.signal, cache: false, onText: function (u) { $("askOut").textContent = u.text; } }).then(function (r) {
      if (r.truncated) $("askStatus").textContent = "The answer was cut short. Ask for less at a time.";
    }).catch(function (e) {
      if (e && e.text) $("askOut").textContent = e.text; else $("askOut").textContent = "No answer.";
      var m = { not_granted: "Claude access was not allowed for this page.", rate_limited: "Too many requests right now. Try again later.", session_expired: "Sign in again to continue.", upstream_error: "The request was interrupted. Try again.", cancelled: "Stopped." };
      $("askStatus").textContent = (e && m[e.code]) || "That did not work. Try again.";
      if (e && (e.code === "not_granted" || e.code === "sampling_disabled")) $("askBox").hidden = true;
    }).then(function () { $("askGo").disabled = false; $("askStop").hidden = true; });
  }

  /* ---------- records forms etc ---------- */

    oilcheck: { t: "This engine has no dipstick. Oil level is read electronically in the instrument cluster (see the Check your oil level mission). Dipsticks are only on the five- and six-cylinder V60s." },

Use those numbers, not the maximum printed on the tire. Your Premier's standard 215/50R17 tires take 38 psi front and rear, cold, per Volvo's manual." },
    obd: { t: "The OBD-II port is a 16-pin socket under the dashboard on the driver's side. Look up under the dash near the hood release with a flashlight.", v: true },
```
