    stages: [{ ch: "3.1.3" }, { ch: "2.2.3" }, { ch: "3.3.3" }, { ch: "3.2.3" }] },
  { id: "feel", t: "Diagnose: sounds, feel and fluids", d: "Oil use over real miles, running hot, a no-start, tires, brakes, the parking brake, suspension noises and the bulletins.",
    stages: [{ ch: "1.1.4" }, { ch: "1.2.3" }, { ch: "1.3.4" }, { ch: "2.1.4" }, { ch: "2.3.3" }, { ch: "2.4.3" }, { ch: "4.3.3" }, { ch: "1.9.2", park: "Needs a dealer to look up the service action by VIN." }, { ch: "3.5.4" }] },
  { id: "upgrade", t: "Upgrades", d: "Each upgrade decided with the cost against the benefit: tires, brakes, wipers, lights, tuning, tint, paint and a rack.",
    stages: [{ ch: "2.1.5" }, { ch: "2.3.4" }, { ch: "5.2.3" }, { ch: "5.1.3" }, { ch: "3.3.4" }, { ch: "5.3.2" }, { ch: "5.4.3" }, { ch: "5.5.1" }] },
  { id: "test", t: "The Technician quizzes and the mock G1", d: "Diagnosis questions area by area, then the full test: 55 questions, 90 minutes.",
    stages: [{ quiz: "sus", rung: 2 }, { quiz: "brk", rung: 2 }, { quiz: "ele", rung: 2 }, { quiz: "eng", rung: 2 }, { quiz: "at", rung: 2 }, { quiz: "mdt", rung: 2 }, { quiz: "hvac", rung: 2 }, { mock: true }] }
];
```

### `src/js/data/quiz.js`

```javascript
/* Quiz bank for the certification track. Original questions in the style ASE's study guides show (a scenario, "most likely",
   "EXCEPT", Technician A / Technician B), every one grounded in a sourced fact about this car. Nothing here is copied from ASE.
   Fields: id, area (track.js), rung (1 Owner, 2 Technician), item (the manual part it belongs to, for weak spots), q, o (four options),
   a (index of the right one), why, src (a V60_SOURCES key or [title, url]).
   Recall questions (the flashcard facts with their exam distractors) are added to each area at run time; see track.js in modules. */
window.V60_SOURCES = window.V60_SOURCES || {};
window.V60_SOURCES.aseg1 = ["ASE G1 Auto Maintenance and Light Repair study guide (task list and question counts)", "https://www.laspositascollege.edu/auto/assets/asenatef/ASE_MaintenanceLtRepair_Study_Guide_2024.pdf"];
window.V60_SOURCES.aseg1p = ["ASE: G1 Auto Maintenance and Light Repair test page", "https://ase.com/?p=2669"];
window.V60_SOURCES.asefees = ["ASE: register now, dates and fees", "https://ase.com/tests/register-now/"];
window.V60_QUIZ = [
  /* ---------- A. Engine systems ---------- */
  { id: "q-e1", area: "eng", rung: 1, item: "oil", q: "The owner of a 2016 V60 T5 Drive-E wants to check the engine oil level. Which procedure is correct?",
    o: ["Pull the dipstick, wipe it, reinsert it and read the level", "Put the ignition in mode II and read the level in the driver display", "Remove the filler cap and look for oil at the threads", "The level can only be read with Volvo's workshop system"], a: 1,
    why: "This engine has no dipstick. The level is read in the driver display, with the ignition in mode II and the thumb wheel rolled to Oil level.", src: "oilchk" },
  { id: "q-e2", area: "eng", rung: 1, item: "oil", q: "Technician A says this engine takes 6.2 US quarts of oil including the filter. Technician B says Volvo specifies a full synthetic oil meeting ACEA A5/B5. Who is correct?",
    o: ["Technician A only", "Technician B only", "Both A and B", "Neither A nor B"], a: 2, why: "Both are in Volvo's manual: 6.2 US quarts (5.9 L) with the filter, and a full synthetic meeting ACEA A5/B5, SAE 5W-30 for normal use.", src: "om" },
  { id: "q-e3", area: "eng", rung: 1, item: "oil", q: "The red oil pressure warning comes on while driving. Which is the most appropriate action?",
    o: ["Drive to the nearest shop at reduced speed", "Add a quart of oil at the next fuel stop", "Stop, switch the engine off at once and check the oil level", "Ignore it unless the engine makes a noise"], a: 2,
    why: "Volvo's manual says stop and switch off immediately, then check the level. If the level is fine and the light stays on, the engine must not be run.", src: "om" },
  { id: "q-e4", area: "eng", rung: 1, item: "coolant", q: "All of the following statements about this car's coolant expansion tank are true EXCEPT:",
    o: ["It sits on the passenger side of the engine bay", "The level is checked with the engine cold", "The cap can be opened right after a drive for a quick check", "It is topped up with Volvo coolant mixed 50/50 with water"], a: 2,
    why: "The system is pressurised when hot. Volvo says never open the tank hot; check and top up cold only.", src: "om" },
  { id: "q-e5", area: "eng", rung: 1, item: "coolant", q: "After a drive, the engine is switched off and the cooling fan starts running on its own. The most likely explanation is:",
    o: ["A stuck fan relay that needs replacing", "Normal: the fan can run for up to 6 minutes after shutdown", "The thermostat has failed closed", "The coolant level is too high"], a: 1,
    why: "Volvo's manual warns the fan can run for up to 6 minutes after the engine is switched off. Keep hands clear.", src: "om" },
  { id: "q-e6", area: "eng", rung: 1, item: "belts", q: "Which statement about the timing drive on the B4204T11 engine is correct?",
    o: ["It uses a chain that lasts the life of the engine", "It uses a belt, and the engine is an interference design", "It uses a belt, and a broken belt only stops the engine without damage", "It uses gears and needs no service"], a: 1,
    why: "The Drive-E four-cylinder uses a timing belt. It is an interference engine: a broken belt usually puts valves into pistons.", src: "acr" },
  { id: "q-e7", area: "eng", rung: 1, item: "belts", q: "Volvo's 2016 US maintenance schedule lists the timing belt tensioner and idler for replacement at:",
    o: ["60,000 miles or 5 years", "100,000 miles or 7 years", "150,000 miles or 10 years", "Only when the belt shows cracks"], a: 2, why: "The 2016 US schedule lists the timing belt tensioner and idler at 150,000 miles or 10 years, whichever comes first.", src: "ms" },
  { id: "q-e8", area: "eng", rung: 1, item: "filters", q: "Volvo's schedule replaces this car's engine air filter at which mileages?",
    o: ["Every 10,000 miles", "20,000, 40,000 and 60,000 miles", "40,000, 80,000 and 120,000 miles", "Only when it looks dirty"], a: 2, why: "The 2016 schedule lists the engine air filter at 40,000, 80,000 and 120,000 miles.", src: "ms" },
  { id: "q-e9", area: "eng", rung: 1, item: "plugs", q: "Spark plugs on this engine are due, per Volvo's schedule, at:",
    o: ["30,000 and 60,000 miles", "60,000 and 120,000 miles", "100,000 miles only", "Every oil change"], a: 1, why: "Volvo's 2016 US schedule lists spark plugs at 60,000 and 120,000 miles.", src: "ms" },
  { id: "q-e10", area: "eng", rung: 1, item: "exhaust", q: "A car is brought in for the Texas OBD emissions test with the check-engine light on and one stored code. The result will be:",
    o: ["A pass, because only one code is stored", "A pass if the code is not emissions-related", "A fail: a lit check-engine light with a stored code fails", "A conditional pass with a 30-day retest"], a: 2,
    why: "Under the federal OBD rule Texas uses, a lit malfunction indicator with a stored code fails. At most one readiness monitor may be incomplete on 2001 and newer cars.", src: "cfr" },
  { id: "q-e11", area: "eng", rung: 1, item: "exhaust", q: "Codes were cleared with a scan tool the day before the emissions test. Technician A says the car will pass if the light stays off. Technician B says the readiness monitors reset and the car needs to be driven first. Who is correct?",
    o: ["Technician A only", "Technician B only", "Both A and B", "Neither A nor B"], a: 1, why: "Clearing codes resets every monitor to not ready. The car has to be driven normally, often over several days, before it can pass.", src: "cfr" },
  { id: "q-e12", area: "eng", rung: 1, item: "oil", q: "The engine has auto-stopped at a traffic light with start/stop. Which is the correct precaution before opening the hood?",
    o: ["None; an auto-stopped engine cannot restart on its own", "Switch the car fully off first, because the engine can restart without warning", "Open the hood only from the passenger side", "Wait 6 minutes for the fan to stop"], a: 1,
    why: "Volvo's manual warns that an auto-stopped engine can start by itself. Switch the car off before working under the hood.", src: "om" },
  { id: "q-e13", area: "eng", rung: 1, item: "oil", q: "Volvo's 2016 US schedule changes this engine's oil and filter every:",
    o: ["5,000 miles or 6 months", "7,500 miles or 12 months", "10,000 miles or 12 months", "15,000 miles or 24 months"], a: 2, why: "Every 10,000 miles or 12 months, whichever comes first.", src: "ms" },
  { id: "q-e14", area: "eng", rung: 1, item: "coolant", q: "A customer asks when the coolant should be replaced. According to Volvo's 2016 manual:",
    o: ["Every 2 years", "Every 30,000 miles", "It normally does not need to be changed", "Whenever the thermostat is replaced"], a: 2, why: "The 2016 manual says the coolant normally does not need to be changed. The schedule lists level checks only.", src: "om" },
  { id: "q-e15", area: "eng", rung: 2, item: "oil", q: "A 2015–2016 Drive-E engine uses oil steadily between changes, with no visible leaks and no blue smoke. Volvo's bulletin TJ31216 identifies the repair as:",
    o: ["A revised PCV valve", "New pistons and piston rings", "A reprogrammed engine module", "A thicker oil grade"], a: 1,
    why: "TJ31216 covers engines built from late 2013 to January 2016 and names new pistons and rings as the fix. Later engines got the revised parts in production.", src: ["NHTSA: Volvo TJ31216", "https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2019/MC-10169029-9999.pdf"] },
  { id: "q-e16", area: "eng", rung: 2, item: "exhaust", q: "A steady check-engine light came on the morning after the car was refuelled. Of these, the cause Volvo's manual lists first is:",
    o: ["A failed oxygen sensor", "A loose fuel filler cap, or refuelling with the engine running", "Low oil level", "A worn timing belt"], a: 1,
    why: "Volvo's manual names a loose fuel cap or refuelling with the engine running as triggers. Make sure the cap clicks and drive normally; if the light stays on, read the code.", src: "om" },
  { id: "q-e17", area: "eng", rung: 2, item: "belts", q: "No record exists of a timing belt replacement on a 10-year-old interference engine. The most defensible recommendation is:",
    o: ["Wait for a noise before acting", "Treat the belt as due: inspect, and replace the belt kit if no proof turns up", "Replace the belt only at 200,000 miles", "Switch to a thicker oil to protect the belt"], a: 1,
    why: "Volvo's limit is 150,000 miles or 10 years. On an interference engine a snapped belt usually destroys the engine, so an unproven belt at the age limit is treated as due.", src: "ms" },
  /* ---------- B. Automatic transmission ---------- */
  { id: "q-a1", area: "at", rung: 1, item: "trans", q: "The transmission in a 2016 V60 T5 Drive-E is:",
    o: ["A 6-speed Geartronic automatic", "An 8-speed Aisin TG-81SC automatic", "A dual-clutch automatic", "A continuously variable transmission"], a: 1, why: "Volvo's manual lists the 8-speed automatic made by Aisin, type TG-81SC.", src: "om" },
  { id: "q-a2", area: "at", rung: 1, item: "trans", q: "Technician A says this transmission's fluid should be changed every 30,000 miles. Technician B says Volvo's manual states the fluid does not need changing in normal use. Who is correct?",
    o: ["Technician A only", "Technician B only", "Both A and B", "Neither A nor B"], a: 1, why: "Volvo's manual specifies AW1 fluid, about 7 US quarts, and says it does not need changing under normal driving.", src: "om" },
  { id: "q-a3", area: "at", rung: 1, item: "trans", q: "Which wheels does this transmission drive?",
    o: ["The rear wheels", "All four wheels", "The front wheels only", "The front wheels, with the rear engaging on slip"], a: 2, why: "The T5 Drive-E V60 is front-wheel drive. All-wheel-drive V60s used other engines.", src: "vpic" },
  /* ---------- C. Manual drivetrain & axles ---------- */
  { id: "q-m1", area: "mdt", rung: 1, item: "trans", q: "This car is a front-wheel-drive automatic. Which of these G1 drivetrain tasks has nothing to inspect on it?",
    o: ["Front half-shaft CV boots", "Clutch pedal free play and the manual gearbox", "Wheel bearings", "Driveshaft and CV joint condition"], a: 1, why: "There is no clutch or manual gearbox on this car. The half-shafts, CV joints and bearings are real and can be inspected.", src: "vpic" },
  { id: "q-m2", area: "mdt", rung: 1, item: "trans", q: "On a front-wheel-drive car, the drive to each front wheel goes through:",
    o: ["A long driveshaft to a rear differential", "A half-shaft with a CV joint at each end", "A chain inside the hub", "A transfer case and a rear axle"], a: 1, why: "Front-wheel-drive cars use two half-shafts from the transaxle, each with constant-velocity joints so the shaft can steer and move with the suspension. ASE's G1 task list covers half-shafts and CV joints for front-wheel drive.", src: "aseg1" },
  /* ---------- D. Suspension & steering ---------- */
  { id: "q-s1", area: "sus", rung: 1, item: "tires", q: "The placard for this car's 215/50R17 tires gives 38 psi. When should the pressure be set?",
    o: ["Right after a highway drive, when the tires are warm", "Cold, before driving or after sitting a few hours", "To the maximum printed on the sidewall", "To 32 psi, the general rule for passenger cars"], a: 1, why: "Placard pressures are cold pressures. Driving warms the air inside and raises the reading.", src: "om" },
  { id: "q-s2", area: "sus", rung: 1, item: "tires", q: "After a wheel is refitted, the bolts should be tightened to:",
    o: ["80 lb-ft, in a circle", "103 lb-ft, in a crosswise pattern", "140 lb-ft, in a crosswise pattern", "Hand tight plus a quarter turn"], a: 1, why: "Volvo specifies 103 lb-ft (140 Nm) tightened crosswise. 140 is the figure in newton-metres, not pound-feet.", src: "om" },
  { id: "q-s3", area: "sus", rung: 1, item: "tires", q: "A tire with plenty of tread shows a DOT date code from week 43 of 2017. Per Volvo's manual, the tire:",
    o: ["Is fine until the tread wears to 2/32 in", "Should be replaced: Volvo's limit is 6 years regardless of tread", "Should be moved to the rear", "Needs no action unless it cracks"], a: 1, why: "Volvo says replace tires after 6 years of normal service even with tread left. The last four digits of the DOT code give the week and year of manufacture.", src: "om" },
  { id: "q-s4", area: "sus", rung: 1, item: "tires", q: "Technician A says Volvo requires rotating this car's tires every 5,000 miles. Technician B says if tires are rotated they should move front to rear on the same side only. Who is correct?",
    o: ["Technician A only", "Technician B only", "Both A and B", "Neither A nor B"], a: 1, why: "Volvo says there is no required rotation. If you rotate, move tires front to rear, never side to side.", src: "om" },
  { id: "q-s5", area: "sus", rung: 1, item: "tpms", q: "This car's tire pressure warning system works by:",
    o: ["Pressure sensors inside each wheel", "Comparing wheel speeds through the ABS sensors", "A sensor in the valve cap", "Reading the compressor in the sealing kit"], a: 1, why: "It is an indirect system with no wheel sensors. It compares wheel speeds and must be calibrated after pressures are set.", src: "tpms" },
  { id: "q-s6", area: "sus", rung: 1, item: "tpms", q: "After setting all four tires to the placard pressure, the tire monitor must be calibrated. The correct sequence is:",
    o: ["Drive 50 miles at highway speed and it resets itself", "Engine off, ignition mode II, then MY CAR, Settings, Car settings, Tire monitor", "Disconnect the battery for 10 minutes", "Press and hold the hazard switch for 5 seconds"], a: 1, why: "Volvo's procedure: tires cold at the placard pressure, ignition mode II, then the Tire monitor calibration in the MY CAR settings.", src: "tpms" },
  { id: "q-s7", area: "sus", rung: 2, item: "tpms", q: "The tire pressure light keeps returning after calibration with correct pressures. Volvo's bulletin TJ29818 says to check all of the following EXCEPT:",
    o: ["The body module software level", "Whether the tires match within 5 % rolling circumference", "That the system was recalibrated within the last 10,000 miles", "The battery's state of charge"], a: 3,
    why: "TJ29818 covers false warnings: update the body module software, calibrate, recalibrate at least every 10,000 miles, and match tires within 5 % rolling circumference. The battery is not part of it.", src: "tsb29818" },
  { id: "q-s8", area: "sus", rung: 1, item: "susp", q: "While checking fluids, a technician looks for the power steering reservoir on this car. The correct finding is:",
    o: ["It is beside the brake fluid reservoir", "It is under the air filter box", "There is none: the steering is electrically assisted", "It is only accessible from below"], a: 2, why: "Volvo's four-cylinder engine bay drawing shows no power steering reservoir. The steering assist is electric.", src: "om" },
  { id: "q-s9", area: "sus", rung: 1, item: "susp", q: "The steering suddenly feels heavier and a message appears in the display. The most likely cause is:",
    o: ["A snapped serpentine belt", "Low power steering fluid", "The electric power steering has overheated and reduced assistance while it cools", "A tire has gone flat"], a: 2, why: "Volvo's manual describes reduced steering assistance when the electric steering overheats; it returns as the system cools.", src: "swf" },
  { id: "q-s10", area: "sus", rung: 1, item: "tires", q: "This car has no spare wheel. What does Volvo provide instead?",
    o: ["A run-flat tire set", "A tire sealing system: sealant and a compressor", "A roadside call button only", "A folding spare under the cargo floor"], a: 1, why: "The temporary spare was an accessory. Cars without it carry the Tire Sealing System with sealant and a compressor.", src: "om" },
  /* ---------- E. Brakes ---------- */
  { id: "q-b1", area: "brk", rung: 1, item: "bfluid", q: "This car's brake fluid specification and Volvo's replacement interval are:",
    o: ["DOT 3, every 2 years", "DOT 4, every 3 years or 40,000 miles", "DOT 5 silicone, lifetime", "DOT 4, every 100,000 miles"], a: 1, why: "DOT 4 from a sealed container, replaced every 3 years or 40,000 miles on the 2016 US schedule.", src: "ms" },
  { id: "q-b2", area: "brk", rung: 1, item: "bfluid", q: "The red brake warning is on and the fluid in the reservoir is below MIN. The correct action is:",
    o: ["Top up and drive gently to a shop", "Pump the pedal to restore pressure, then drive", "Do not drive; have the car towed", "Drive only in first gear"], a: 2, why: "Volvo's manual: with the red brake warning and fluid below MIN, do not drive. Have the car towed.", src: "om" },
  { id: "q-b3", area: "brk", rung: 1, item: "parking", q: "The electric parking brake releases by itself only when:",
    o: ["The driver's door is closed", "The engine is running, the seat belt is on, D or R is selected and the accelerator is pressed", "The car is in Park and the brake pedal is pressed", "The ignition is switched off"], a: 1, why: "Automatic release needs the engine running and the belt fastened, then D or R and the accelerator.", src: "pb_rel" },
  { id: "q-b4", area: "brk", rung: 1, item: "parking", q: "A car with a flat 12 V battery has the parking brake applied. Technician A says it can be released by hand with the emergency lever. Technician B says it can neither be applied nor released until a donor battery is connected. Who is correct?",
    o: ["Technician A only", "Technician B only", "Both A and B", "Neither A nor B"], a: 1, why: "With a flat battery the electric parking brake cannot be applied or released. Connect a donor battery first.", src: "pb_gen" },
  { id: "q-b5", area: "brk", rung: 1, item: "parking", q: "Volvo says the rear brake linings on this car must be replaced at a workshop because:",
    o: ["The rear calipers are riveted to the hubs", "The electric parking brake's design requires it", "Rear brakes are sealed units", "A wheel alignment is required afterwards"], a: 1, why: "Volvo's manual says the rear linings must be replaced at a workshop because of the electric parking brake's design.", src: "pb_au" },
  { id: "q-b6", area: "brk", rung: 1, item: "parking", q: "In an emergency, the parking brake can be used while the car is moving by:",
    o: ["Pressing the control once", "Holding the control in; a signal sounds above 6 mph and braking stops when it is released", "Pulling the control twice", "It cannot be used while moving"], a: 1, why: "Hold the control in. A signal sounds above 6 mph, and the braking stops as soon as the control is released.", src: "pb_apply" },
  { id: "q-b7", area: "brk", rung: 2, item: "parking", q: "The display reads \"Park brake not fully released\". The manual's first step is:",
    o: ["Disconnect the battery to reset the module", "Apply and release the brake several times; if the message stays, a workshop", "Drive on; the message clears above 20 mph", "Top up the brake fluid"], a: 1, why: "A fault is blocking the release. Apply and release several times; if it stays, a Volvo workshop. Driving on it can overheat the rear brakes.", src: "pb_sym" },
  { id: "q-b8", area: "brk", rung: 1, item: "bfluid", q: "Where is the brake fluid reservoir on this car, and how is the level checked?",
    o: ["Under the air box; remove the cap and use the dipstick", "At the rear of the bay on the driver's side under a round cover; read it without opening the cap", "Beside the washer filler; squeeze the hose", "Inside the cabin under the pedal"], a: 1, why: "Under a round cover at the rear of the engine bay on the driver's side. Check the level between MIN and MAX without opening the cap.", src: "om" },
  /* ---------- F. Electrical ---------- */
  { id: "q-l1", area: "ele", rung: 1, item: "battery", q: "Which battery type does this car require, and why?",
    o: ["A standard flooded battery; cost", "An AGM battery; required on cars with start/stop", "A lithium starter battery; weight", "Any 12 V battery of the right size"], a: 1, why: "Volvo lists an AGM battery (800 CCA) and requires it on start/stop cars. There is also a second support battery.", src: "om" },
  { id: "q-l2", area: "ele", rung: 1, item: "battery", q: "When jump-starting this car, the negative donor clamp goes on:",
    o: ["The battery's negative terminal", "The outer screw head on top of the right-hand engine mount", "Any bare bolt on the body", "The alternator bracket"], a: 1, why: "Volvo's manual puts the negative clamp on the outer screw head of the right-hand (passenger side) engine mount, not the battery.", src: "om" },
  { id: "q-l3", area: "ele", rung: 1, item: "battery", q: "Technician A says this car has a second support battery for the start/stop system. Technician B says the jump-start ground point is the battery's negative post. Who is correct?",
    o: ["Technician A only", "Technician B only", "Both A and B", "Neither A nor B"], a: 0, why: "The start/stop system uses a second support battery. The jump-start ground is on the engine mount, not the battery.", src: "om" },
  { id: "q-l4", area: "ele", rung: 1, item: "lights", q: "The halogen headlight bulbs fitted to this car are:",
    o: ["H7 low beam, H7 high beam", "H11 low beam (55 W), H9 high beam (65 W)", "H4 dual-filament", "9005 low, 9006 high"], a: 1, why: "Volvo's manual lists H11 55 W for low beam and H9 65 W for high beam.", src: "om" },
  { id: "q-l5", area: "ele", rung: 1, item: "lights", q: "The front turn signal bulb on this car is:",
    o: ["PY21W", "PY24W", "W5W", "P21/5W"], a: 1, why: "PY24W at the front and PY21W at the rear, per Volvo's bulb table.", src: "om" },
  { id: "q-l6", area: "ele", rung: 1, item: "controls", q: "A customer leaves the car in ignition mode II while waiting without the engine running. The risk is:",
    o: ["The parking brake releases", "The battery drains; mode II is for short periods only", "The transmission overheats", "The alarm triggers"], a: 1, why: "Volvo's manual: mode II only for very short periods, or it drains the battery. Heated seats and the rear window need the engine running.", src: "ign" },
  { id: "q-l7", area: "ele", rung: 1, item: "controls", q: "The engine does not catch after three starting attempts. Volvo's manual says:",
    o: ["Try again immediately with the accelerator held down", "Wait 3 minutes so the battery recovers, then try again", "Disconnect the battery for 30 seconds", "Push-start the car"], a: 1, why: "Wait 3 minutes before trying again; the battery recovers and starting capacity improves.", src: "start" },
  { id: "q-l8", area: "ele", rung: 1, item: "port", q: "The OBD-II diagnostic port on this car is located:",
    o: ["Under the hood beside the fuse box", "Under the dashboard on the driver's side", "In the glovebox", "Under the centre armrest"], a: 1, why: "Under the dashboard on the driver's side.", src: "om" },
  { id: "q-l9", area: "ele", rung: 1, item: "port", q: "A generic OBD-II adapter reads engine codes but cannot read the airbag or ABS modules on this car. The reason is:",
    o: ["Those modules have no fault memory", "They use Volvo's own diagnostic protocol, reached with VIDA", "The adapter's battery is too weak", "They are read through a second port in the trunk"], a: 1, why: "Standard OBD-II covers emissions-related engine data. The other modules use Volvo's own diagnostics (VIDA with a DiCE interface).", src: "vida" },
  { id: "q-l10", area: "ele", rung: 1, item: "wipers", q: "To put the wipers in the service position for a blade change:",
    o: ["Switch the wipers on and pull the key while they are upright", "Press START/STOP briefly (mode I), press again to switch off, then within 3 seconds hold the right stalk up", "Hold the washer button for 5 seconds", "Lift the blades off the glass with the ignition on"], a: 1, why: "That is Volvo's service-position sequence. The blades then park upright for changing.", src: "om" },
  { id: "q-l11", area: "ele", rung: 2, item: "controls", q: "The start/stop system does not stop the engine at a light, with no fault shown. The LEAST likely explanation is:",
    o: ["The car has not reached about 5 mph since the last start", "The engine or transmission is not yet warm", "The outside temperature is outside the working range", "The high beam is switched on"], a: 3,
    why: "Volvo lists speed since the last start, engine and transmission temperature and outside temperature among the conditions. Headlights are not one of them.", src: "om" },
  /* ---------- G. Heating & A/C ---------- */
  { id: "q-h1", area: "hvac", rung: 1, item: "coolant", q: "The A/C system on this car uses:",

  { id: "q-h2", area: "hvac", rung: 1, item: "filters", q: "Volvo's schedule replaces the cabin air filter:",
    o: ["Every 10,000 miles", "Every 20,000 miles, and at least once a year", "Every 60,000 miles", "Only if the blower is noisy"], a: 1, why: "Every 20,000 miles, and Volvo suggests at least once a year.", src: "ms" }

```javascript
/* The certification track: progression rebuilt around ASE's G1 test (Auto Maintenance and Light Repair).
   The seven content areas and their scored-question counts come from ASE's G1 study guide (V60_SOURCES.aseg1 in quiz.js).
   Each area is a level with two rungs:
     Owner      every part in the area has its Know and Check chapters closed on the car, and the area's Owner quiz is passed
     Technician every chapter of every part is closed, and the Technician quiz (diagnosis) is passed
   Readiness per area = 40 % hands-on (chapters closed) + 20 % recall (flashcards mastered) + 40 % best quiz score.
   G1 readiness = the areas weighted the way the test is: a Brakes point is worth 11/55, an HVAC point 4/55.
   Quizzes open hands-on first (Kyle, 2026-10-15): an area's quiz is locked until its hands-on work is done.
   Parts (manual items) can belong to two areas: the coolant system is Engine and Heating. Items not on the G1 sit under Owner's work. */
window.V60_TRACK_DATA = {
  test: { id: "g1", n: "ASE G1", full: "Auto Maintenance and Light Repair", scored: 55, total: 65, minutes: 90, recert: { n: 28, minutes: 45 }, pass: 0.7,
    passNote: "ASE does not publish its pass mark; 70 % is this app's bar." },
  areas: [
    { id: "eng", letter: "A", n: "Engine systems", q: 9, items: ["oil", "coolant", "belts", "filters", "plugs", "exhaust", "leaks"],
      d: "Oil, cooling, belts, air and fuel, ignition, exhaust and emissions. The biggest area on your car and the one with the most to check." },
    { id: "at", letter: "B", n: "Automatic transmission", q: 4, items: ["trans"],
      d: "The Aisin 8-speed: fluid, mounts, shift quality, and what Volvo says never needs changing." },
    { id: "mdt", letter: "C", n: "Manual drivetrain & axles", q: 6, items: ["trans"], noCar: "Your car has no manual gearbox or clutch, so those tasks are reading and quiz only. The front axles and CV joints are real.",
      d: "Clutches and gearboxes you don't have, plus the driveshafts and CV joints you do." },
    { id: "sus", letter: "D", n: "Suspension & steering", q: 13, items: ["susp", "tires", "tpms"],
      d: "The largest share of the test: steering, front and rear suspension, alignment, wheels and tires." },
    { id: "brk", letter: "E", n: "Brakes", q: 11, items: ["brakes", "parking", "bfluid"],
      d: "Hydraulics, discs, the electric parking brake, fluid and power assist." },
    { id: "ele", letter: "F", n: "Electrical", q: 8, items: ["battery", "fuses", "lights", "display", "controls", "port", "wipers"],
      d: "Battery, charging, starting, lights, fuses, the driver display and the diagnostic port." },
    { id: "hvac", letter: "G", n: "Heating & A/C", q: 4, items: ["coolant", "filters"],
      d: "The heater side of the cooling loop, the cabin filter and the A/C charge on the hood label." }
  ],

  /* which area each flashcard fact belongs to (recall). Tags give the default; ids override. Anything else is Owner's work. */
  factTag: { Engine: "eng", Maintenance: "eng", Tires: "sus", Steering: "sus", Brakes: "brk", Electrical: "ele", Diagnostics: "ele", Inspection: "eng", "Warning lights": "eng", Fluids: "eng", Drivetrain: "at", Basics: "eng", Safety: "eng" },
  factId: { "f-atf": "at", "f-brakefl": "brk", "f-washer": "own", "f-ac": "hvac", "f-ps": "sus", "f-cabin": "hvac", "f-trans": "at", "f-8speed": "at", "f-drive": "mdt", "f-brakered": "brk", "f-fueldoor": "own", "f-brloc": "brk",
    "f-wiper": "ele", "f-ignmodes": "ele", "f-ignbrake": "ele", "f-start3": "ele", "f-mode2": "ele", "f-waterdepth": "own", "f-citysafety": "own", "f-3g": "own", "f-adapter": "ele", "f-modules": "ele", "f-obd": "ele" }

    if (b.lim && w.b > b.lim) return { s: "maybe", w: "Your build month straddles the cut-off week" };
    return { s: "yes", w: "Inside the production range" };

/* Mastery deck: spaced repetition over V60_FACTS. Boxes 0-5, intervals in days. */
(function () {
  var GAP = [0, 1, 3, 7, 16, 35];
  var NEW_PER_DAY = 10;
  function day() { return Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date().getTimezoneOffset() * 6e4) / 864e5); }
  function data(api) { var d = api.mod("cards"); if (!d) { d = { b: {}, rev: {}, newDay: {} }; api.setMod("cards", d); } return d; }
  function queue(api) {
    var d = data(api), today = day(), due = [], fresh = [];
    var K = window.V60_KNOW;
    window.V60_FACTS.forEach(function (f) { var c = d.b[f.id]; if (!c) { if (!K || K.fact(f)) fresh.push(f); } else if (c[1] <= today) due.push(f); });
    var newLeft = Math.max(0, NEW_PER_DAY - (d.newDay[today] || 0));
    return due.concat(fresh.slice(0, newLeft));
  }
  function mastered(api) { var d = data(api); return Object.keys(d.b).filter(function (k) { return d.b[k][0] >= 4; }).length; }
  var cs = { q: [], i: 0, flip: false, filter: "" };
  function render(api) {
    var $ = api.$, esc = api.esc, d = data(api), F = window.V60_FACTS, m = mastered(api);
    var tags = {}; F.forEach(function (f) { tags[f.tag] = 1; });
    $("cdStats").innerHTML = '<div class="stat"><b>' + m + '</b><span>mastered of ' + F.length + '</span></div><div class="stat"><b>' + queue(api).length + '</b><span>due today</span></div><div class="stat"><b>' + Object.keys(d.b).length + '</b><span>seen</span></div>';
    $("cdMeter").innerHTML = '<i style="width:' + Math.round(100 * m / F.length) + '%"></i>';
    if (!cs.q.length || cs.i >= cs.q.length) {
      var left = queue(api).length;
      $("cdStage").innerHTML = '<div class="fc done"><p class="fc-q">' + (cs.q.length ? "Session done." : (left ? left + " cards are ready." : "Nothing due right now.")) + '</p><p class="status">' + (left ? "About " + Math.max(1, Math.round(left * 0.15)) + " minutes." : "New cards unlock tomorrow. Practice any topic below.") + '</p><div class="row">' + (left ? '<button type="button" id="cdStart">Start today\'s cards</button>' : "") + '</div><div class="tries">' + Object.keys(tags).map(function (t) { return '<button type="button" class="chipq" data-cdtag="' + esc(t) + '">Practice: ' + esc(t) + "</button>"; }).join("") + "</div></div>";
      return;
    }
    var f = cs.q[cs.i], c = d.b[f.id];
    $("cdStage").innerHTML = '<div class="fc' + (cs.flip ? " flipped" : "") + '"><div class="fc-meta"><span class="pill info">' + esc(f.tag) + '</span><span class="status">' + (cs.i + 1) + " of " + cs.q.length + (c ? "" : " · new") + '</span></div><p class="fc-q">' + esc(f.q) + "</p>" + (cs.flip ? '<p class="fc-a">' + esc(f.a) + '</p><div class="fc-grade"><button type="button" class="quiet" data-grade="0">Again</button><button type="button" class="quiet" data-grade="1">Hard</button><button type="button" data-grade="2">Got it</button><button type="button" class="quiet" data-grade="3">Easy</button></div>' : '<button type="button" id="cdFlip" class="flipbtn">Show answer</button>') + "</div>";
  }
  function grade(api, g) {
    var d = data(api), f = cs.q[cs.i], today = day(), c = d.b[f.id];
    if (!c) { d.newDay[today] = (d.newDay[today] || 0) + 1; c = [0, today]; }
    var box = g === 0 ? 0 : (g === 1 ? Math.max(1, c[0]) : (g === 2 ? Math.min(5, c[0] + 1) : Math.min(5, c[0] + 2)));
    d.b[f.id] = [box, today + GAP[box]];
    d.rev[today] = (d.rev[today] || 0) + 1;
    Object.keys(d.newDay).forEach(function (k) { if (+k < today - 3) delete d.newDay[k]; });
    Object.keys(d.rev).forEach(function (k) { if (+k < today - 60) delete d.rev[k]; });
    if (g === 0 && cs.q.length < 60) cs.q.push(f);
    cs.i++; cs.flip = false; api.save(); api.updateHud(); render(api);
  }
  (window.V60_MODULES = window.V60_MODULES || []).push({
    id: "cards",
    tabs: [{ id: "cards", section: "learn", label: "Cards", order: 15, html: '<section><h2>Mastery cards</h2><p class="lede">Every card is a fact about your exact car. Cards you know come back less often; cards you miss come back sooner. A few minutes a day and you can answer anything about your V60.</p><div class="stats" id="cdStats"></div><div class="meter" id="cdMeter" aria-hidden="true"></div></section><div id="cdStage"></div>' }],
    clean: function (v) { return v && typeof v === "object" ? { b: v.b || {}, rev: v.rev || {}, newDay: v.newDay || {} } : null; },
    render: function (api) { render(api); },
    init: function (api) {
      api.$("cdStage").addEventListener("click", function (e) {
        var b = e.target.closest && e.target.closest("button"); if (!b) return;
        if (b.id === "cdStart") { cs.q = queue(api); cs.i = 0; cs.flip = false; render(api); }
        else if (b.id === "cdFlip") { cs.flip = true; render(api); }
        else if (b.hasAttribute("data-grade")) grade(api, +b.getAttribute("data-grade"));
        else if (b.hasAttribute("data-cdtag")) { var t = b.getAttribute("data-cdtag"); cs.q = window.V60_FACTS.filter(function (f) { return f.tag === t; }); cs.i = 0; cs.flip = false; render(api); }
      });
    },
    xp: function (api) { var d = api.mod("cards"); if (!d) return 0; var m = Object.keys(d.b).filter(function (k) { return d.b[k][0] >= 4; }).length; return m * 4 + Object.keys(d.b).length; },
    today: function (api) { var n = queue(api).length; return [{ order: 10, html: '<article class="tcard feature"><h3>Mastery cards</h3><p class="bigline">' + (n ? n + " ready" : "All caught up") + '</p><p class="status">' + mastered(api) + " of " + window.V60_FACTS.length + ' facts mastered</p><button type="button" data-jump="tab:cards">' + (n ? "Review now" : "Practice") + "</button></article>" }]; }
  });
})();

### `src/js/modules/docs.js`

```javascript
/* Documents: drop any paper about the car (a photo or a PDF) and it is read on this phone, sorted by what it is,
   its useful fields pulled out, checked by the owner, then filed where it belongs: receipts into the service log,
   an inspection report into the inspection due date and the odometer, registration and insurance into renewals,
   a service contract into the contract card. Nothing leaves the phone; personal details are blacked out before
   anything is stored. PDFs: pdf.js (jsDelivr, cached by the service worker) reads the text layer, and a page with
   no text is drawn and read by the same text reader as a photo. Saved under api.mod("docs") = { list: [...] }. */
(function () {
  var PDFJS = "3.11.174";
  var PDF_URL = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pdfjs-dist@" + PDFJS + "/legacy/build/pdf.min.js";
  var PDF_WORKER = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/pdfjs-dist@" + PDFJS + "/legacy/build/pdf.worker.min.js";
  var MAX_PAGES = 12, MAX_FILES = 10, EXCERPT = 900;
  var KINDS = [["receipt", "Service receipt"], ["inspection", "Inspection report"], ["registration", "Registration"], ["insurance", "Insurance"], ["warranty", "Service contract or warranty"], ["title", "Title"], ["recall", "Recall letter"], ["history", "Vehicle history report"], ["manual", "Manual page"], ["door", "Door label"], ["tire", "Tire sidewall"], ["other", "Other paper"]];
  var KIND_NAME = {}; KINDS.forEach(function (k) { KIND_NAME[k[0]] = k[1]; });
  var FILE_WHERE = { receipt: "Service log, receipts and costs", inspection: "Inspection due date, odometer, Glovebox", registration: "Registration renewal in Glovebox", insurance: "Insurance renewal in Glovebox", warranty: "Service contract card in Glovebox", title: "Glovebox (title on file)", recall: "Glovebox (recall letter on file)", history: "Odometer history", manual: "Documents", door: "Build month in Bulletins", tire: "Documents", other: "Documents" };

  var API = null, ui = { queue: [], busy: false, status: "", filter: "", q: "" };
  function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }
  function esc(s) { return API.esc(s); }
  function data(api) { var d = api.mod("docs"); if (!d) { d = { list: [] }; api.setMod("docs", d); } if (!Array.isArray(d.list)) d.list = []; return d; }
  function fmtMi(n) { return (+n).toLocaleString() + " mi"; }

  /* ---------- pdf.js ---------- */
  var pdfProm = null;
  function loadPdfJs() {
    if (window.pdfjsLib) return Promise.resolve(window.pdfjsLib);
    if (pdfProm) return pdfProm;
    pdfProm = new Promise(function (res, rej) {
      var sc = document.createElement("script"); sc.src = PDF_URL; sc.async = true;
      sc.onload = function () { if (!window.pdfjsLib) { rej(new Error("The PDF reader did not load.")); return; } window.pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = PDF_WORKER; res(window.pdfjsLib); };
      sc.onerror = function () { pdfProm = null; rej(new Error("The PDF reader could not be downloaded. Check the connection and try again.")); };
      document.head.appendChild(sc);
    });
    return pdfProm;
  }
  function readBuf(file) { return new Promise(function (res, rej) { var r = new FileReader(); r.onload = function () { res(r.result); }; r.onerror = function () { rej(new Error("That file could not be read.")); }; r.readAsArrayBuffer(file); }); }
  function hashBuf(buf) {
    if (window.crypto && crypto.subtle && crypto.subtle.digest) return crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", buf).then(function (h) { return Array.prototype.map.call(new Uint8Array(h), function (b) { return (b < 16 ? "0" : "") + b.toString(16); }).join(""); });
    var a = 0x811c9dc5, u = new Uint8Array(buf); for (var i = 0; i < u.length; i++) { a ^= u[i]; a = (a * 16777619) >>> 0; } return Promise.resolve("w" + a.toString(16) + "-" + u.length);
  }
  /* -> { text, pages, ocrPages } : the text of every page, OCR for pages without a text layer */
  function readPdf(file, progress) {
    var SC = window.V60_SCAN;
    return Promise.all([loadPdfJs(), readBuf(file)]).then(function (r) {
      var lib = r[0], buf = r[1];
      return lib.getDocument({ data: buf, isEvalSupported: false, disableFontFace: true }).promise;
    }).then(function (pdf) {
      var n = Math.min(pdf.numPages, MAX_PAGES), out = [], ocrPages = 0, i = 1;
      function page() {
        if (i > n) return { text: out.join("\n"), pages: pdf.numPages, ocrPages: ocrPages };
        progress("Reading page " + i + " of " + n + "…");
        var num = i++;
        return pdf.getPage(num).then(function (pg) {
          return pg.getTextContent().then(function (tc) {
            var lines = [], last = null, cur = [];
            (tc.items || []).forEach(function (it) {
              if (!it.str && !it.hasEOL) return;
              var y = it.transform ? Math.round(it.transform[5]) : 0;
              if (last != null && Math.abs(y - last) > 2) { lines.push(cur.join(" ")); cur = []; }
              if (it.str) cur.push(it.str); last = y;
              if (it.hasEOL) { lines.push(cur.join(" ")); cur = []; last = null; }
            });
            if (cur.length) lines.push(cur.join(" "));
            var text = lines.join("\n").replace(/[ \t]+/g, " ").trim();
            if (text.replace(/\s/g, "").length >= 40 || !SC) { out.push(text); return; }
            /* a scanned page: draw it and read the picture */
            progress("Page " + num + " is a picture. Reading it on this phone…"); ocrPages++;
            var vp = pg.getViewport({ scale: 1.6 }), c = document.createElement("canvas"); c.width = Math.round(vp.width); c.height = Math.round(vp.height);
            return pg.render({ canvasContext: c.getContext("2d"), viewport: vp }).promise.then(function () { return SC.ocrText(c); }).then(function (t) { out.push(t || ""); });
          });
        }).then(page);
      }
      return page();
    });
  }

  /* ---------- the review ---------- */
  function kindOf(raw) { var SC = window.V60_SCAN, k = SC ? SC.classify(raw) : "photo"; return k === "photo" ? "other" : k; }
  function fieldsFor(raw, safe, kind) { var SC = window.V60_SCAN; return SC ? SC.parse(raw, safe, kind) : {}; }
  function titleFor(doc) {
    var f = doc.fields || {};
    return f.shop || f.station || f.provider || f.subject || (f.campaign ? "Campaign " + f.campaign : "") || doc.name || KIND_NAME[doc.kind] || "Document";
  }
  function fieldRows(kind, f) {
    var r = [];
    function add(k, l, v, t) { if (v == null || v === "") return; r.push({ k: k, l: l, v: v, t: t || "text" }); }
    if (kind === "receipt") { add("date", "Date", f.date, "date"); add("miles", "Odometer", f.miles, "number"); add("shop", "Shop", f.shop); add("total", "Total $", f.total, "number"); (f.items || []).slice(0, 8).forEach(function (it, n) { add("item" + n, "Work", it.desc); }); }
    else if (kind === "inspection") { add("date", "Test date", f.date, "date"); add("miles", "Odometer", f.miles, "number"); add("result", "Result", f.result); add("station", "Station", f.station); add("type", "Test type", f.type); add("codes", "Codes on file", (f.codes || []).join(", ")); }
    else if (kind === "registration") { add("expires", "Expires", f.expires, "date"); }
    else if (kind === "insurance") { add("expires", "Renews", f.expires, "date"); add("company", "Company", f.company); }
    else if (kind === "warranty") { add("provider", "Provider", f.provider); add("start", "Start date", f.start, "date"); add("months", "Months", f.months, "number"); add("miles", "Miles", f.miles, "number"); add("deductible", "Deductible $", f.deductible, "number"); add("expires", "Ends", f.expires, "date"); }
    else if (kind === "title") { add("issued", "Issued", f.issued, "date"); add("state", "State", f.state); add("lien", "Lienholder listed", f.lien ? "yes" : "no"); }
    else if (kind === "recall") { add("campaign", "NHTSA campaign", f.campaign); add("volvo", "Volvo recall", f.volvo); add("subject", "Subject", f.subject); add("date", "Letter date", f.date, "date"); }
    else if (kind === "history") { add("owners", "Owners", f.owners, "number"); add("points", "Odometer readings", (f.points || []).map(function (p) { return p.date + " " + p.miles; }).join("; ")); }
    else if (kind === "door") { add("build", "Build month", f.build); }
    else if (kind === "tire") { add("dot", "DOT date code", f.dot); add("size", "Size", f.size); }
    if (!r.length) r.push({ k: "note", l: "Note", v: f.note || "", t: "text" });
    return r;
  }
  function readFields(kind, idx) {
    var f = {}, box = $("dcRev" + idx); if (!box) return f;
    box.querySelectorAll("[data-f]").forEach(function (inp) {
      var k = inp.getAttribute("data-f"), v = inp.value.trim();
      if (!v) return;
      if (/^item\d+$/.test(k)) { (f.items = f.items || []).push({ desc: v }); return; }
      if (k === "codes") { f.codes = v.split(/[,\s]+/).filter(Boolean).map(function (c) { return c.toUpperCase(); }); return; }
      if (k === "points") { f.points = v.split(";").map(function (s) { var m = s.trim().match(/^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\s+(\d+)$/); return m ? { date: m[1], miles: +m[2] } : null; }).filter(Boolean); return; }
      if (k === "lien") { f.lien = /^y/i.test(v); return; }
      f[k] = inp.type === "number" ? +v : v;
    });
    return f;

      var got = earned(api).length;

      return out;
    }

})();

### `src/js/modules/glovebox.js`

```javascript
/* Glovebox: receipts (Claude-read or manual), documents with renewal alerts, service contract/warranty, tool inventory. */
(function () {
  /* [id, name, what it is for, tier]. Ids are used by DIY jobs (tools: [...]); keep them stable. Prices live in data/toolprices.js. */
  var TIERS = [
    { id: "t1", n: "Tier 1 · Checking", d: "Everything a monthly look-over needs: pressures, tread, fluids, lights." },
    { id: "t2", n: "Tier 2 · First jobs", d: "Small jobs that keep you out from under the car: bulbs, filters, trim, battery terminals." },
    { id: "t3", n: "Tier 3 · Wheels off", d: "Only when you change a wheel or need to get under the car. Stands every time." }
  ];
  var TOOLS = [
    ["gauge", "Tire pressure gauge", "Tire checks, monthly", "t1"], ["tdg", "Tread depth gauge", "A reading in 32nds instead of the coin test", "t1"], ["quarter", "A US quarter", "Quick 4/32 tread test", "t1"],
    ["inflator", "12V tire inflator", "Set pressures at home from the car's power outlet", "t1"], ["light", "Bright flashlight or headlamp", "Every under-hood check", "t1"],
    ["gloves", "Nitrile gloves", "Anything with fluids", "t1"], ["towels", "Shop towels", "Wiping caps and spills before they reach paint", "t1"], ["obd", "OBDLink CX adapter", "Codes, live data, readiness", "t1"],
    ["torx", "Torx bit set (T20, T25, T30)", "Headlight cover (T20), trim, filters", "t2"], ["sockets", "3/8 in socket set with extension", "Battery clamp, general work", "t2"],
    ["drivers", "Screwdriver set", "Clips, hose clamps, small covers", "t2"], ["pliers", "Needle-nose pliers", "Clips and connectors", "t2"], ["trim", "Plastic trim removal tools", "Covers and panels without scratches", "t2"],
    ["brush", "Battery terminal brush", "Corrosion on the posts and clamps", "t2"], ["funnel", "Funnel", "Topping up oil or washer fluid", "t2"], ["meter", "Digital multimeter", "Battery voltage, fuses, circuits", "t2"],
    ["charger", "Smart battery charger with AGM mode", "Keeping the AGM battery healthy", "t2"], ["cables", "Jumper cables or a jump pack", "Dead battery", "t2"],
    ["jack", "Floor jack, low profile", "Lifting the car onto stands", "t3"], ["stands", "Jack stands, pair, rated 2 tons or more", "Anything under the car. Never trust a jack alone", "t3"],
    ["chocks", "Wheel chocks, pair", "Blocking the wheels that stay on the ground", "t3"], ["torque", "Torque wrench covering 103 lb-ft", "Wheels to Volvo's 103 lb-ft", "t3"],
    ["breaker", "Breaker bar and lug socket", "Loosening wheel bolts. Check the socket size on your bolts before buying", "t3"]
  ];
  window.V60_TOOLS = TOOLS;
  function data(api) { var d = api.mod("glove"); if (!d) { d = { docs: {}, contract: {}, tools: {}, price: {}, receipts: [] }; api.setMod("glove", d); } if (!d.price) d.price = {}; return d; }
  var gb = { pending: null, busy: false };
  function daysTo(dateStr) { if (!dateStr) return null; return Math.round((new Date(dateStr + "T12:00:00") - Date.now()) / 864e5); }
  function itemOptions(api, sel) { return '<option value="">Other work</option>' + api.ITEMS.map(function (i) { return '<option value="' + i.key + '"' + (sel === i.key ? " selected" : "") + ">" + api.esc(i.name) + "</option>"; }).join(""); }
  /* ---------- tools: tiers, sourced prices, the owner's own price ---------- */
  function priceOf(id) { var P = window.V60_TOOL_PRICES; return (P && P.items && P.items[id]) || []; }
  function money(n) { return "$" + (Math.round(n * 100) / 100).toFixed(n % 1 ? 2 : 0); }
  function shortDate(iso) { var m = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.exec(iso || ""); return m ? ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"][+m[2] - 1] + " " + (+m[3]) + ", " + m[1] : ""; }
  /* the price used for totals: the owner's, else the cheapest sourced one, else null */
  function usePrice(d, id) { if (id === "quarter") return 0.25; if (d.price && d.price[id] != null) return d.price[id]; var o = priceOf(id).filter(function (x) { return x.price != null; }); return o.length ? Math.min.apply(null, o.map(function (x) { return x.price; })) : null; }
  function renderTools(api, d) {
    var $ = api.$, esc = api.esc, P = window.V60_TOOL_PRICES || {}, owned = 0, needLo = 0, unpriced = 0;
    $("gbTools").innerHTML = TIERS.map(function (tr) {
      var list = TOOLS.filter(function (t) { return t[3] === tr.id; }), left = 0, sum = 0, nop = 0;
      var rows = list.map(function (t) {
        var id = t[0], have = !!d.tools[id], mine = d.price && d.price[id] != null ? d.price[id] : null, opts = priceOf(id).filter(function (x) { return x.price != null; }).sort(function (a, b) { return a.price - b.price; }), up = usePrice(d, id);
        if (have) owned++; else { left++; if (up == null) nop++; else sum += up; }
        var sumTxt = mine != null ? money(mine) + " · your price" : opts.length ? money(opts[0].price) + (opts.length > 1 ? "–" + money(opts[opts.length - 1].price) + " · " + opts.length + " options" : " · " + esc(opts[0].store)) : id === "quarter" ? "25¢" : "No price checked";
        var body = opts.map(function (x) { return '<li><a href="' + esc(x.url) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">' + esc(x.name) + "</a><span class=\"status\"> " + esc(x.store) + ", " + money(x.price) + (x.note ? ". " + esc(x.note) : "") + "</span></li>"; }).join("");
        var src = opts.length ? '<ul class="tpsrc">' + body + '</ul><p class="status">Checked ' + esc(shortDate(P.checked)) + ". Store prices change; type what you paid or saw to replace it.</p>" : '<p class="status">No store price checked for this one. Type one in to count it in the totals.</p>';
        return '<div class="tool' + (have ? " have" : "") + '"><label class="tcheck"><input type="checkbox" data-tool="' + id + '"' + (have ? " checked" : "") + "><span><b>" + esc(t[1]) + "</b><small>" + esc(t[2]) + "</small></span></label>" +
          (id === "quarter" || (have && mine == null && !opts.length) ? "" : '<details class="tprice" data-tp="' + id + '"' + (gb.openPrice === id ? " open" : "") + '><summary><span class="mono">' + sumTxt + "</span></summary>" + src +
          '<div class="row tpmine"><div class="field"><label for="gbTP-' + id + '">Your price ($)</label><input id="gbTP-' + id + '" type="number" inputmode="decimal" min="0" step="0.01" data-tprice="' + id + '" value="' + (mine != null ? mine : "") + '"></div>' + (mine != null ? '<button type="button" class="quiet" data-tpclear="' + id + '">Use the store price</button>' : "") + "</div></details>") + "</div>";
      }).join("");
      needLo += sum; unpriced += nop;
      var head = left ? "still need " + left + (sum ? " · about $" + Math.round(sum) : "") + (nop ? (sum ? " + " : " · ") + nop + " unpriced" : "") : "all set";
      return '<section class="ttier"><h4>' + esc(tr.n) + ' <span class="status">' + head + '</span></h4><p class="status">' + esc(tr.d) + '</p><div class="tools">' + rows + "</div></section>";
    }).join("");
    $("gbToolStat").textContent = owned + " of " + TOOLS.length + " owned" + (needLo ? " · about $" + Math.round(needLo) + " to finish" : "");
  }
  function render(api) {
    var $ = api.$, esc = api.esc, d = data(api), D = d.docs, C = d.contract;
    $("gbAI").hidden = !(window.V60_SCAN || (api.sample() && api.assets()));
    // pending receipt preview
    if (gb.pending) {
      var p = gb.pending;

### `src/js/modules/guide.js`

```javascript
/* Guided mode: strong help at the start that steps back as the owner shows they can do things.
   - Three levels per area (under the hood, the adapter, records and papers, tires, reading data):
     0 Guided: the next objective opens a full-screen walkthrough, one step per screen, with a safety check
       before hands-on work and an "I'm stuck" ladder (hint, then the lesson, then log it as a known risk).
     1 Assisted: the case board as usual, with a "Walk me through it" button.
     2 On your own: no prompting beyond what is due.
   - Levels rise from proof: steps finished in the walkthrough without "I'm stuck", right answers in case debriefs,
     and things logged without being led there. They drop after two "stuck" in a row, or after 45 days away.
   - Changes are announced on Today with a "Keep guiding me" undo (Kyle chose "just do it", 2026-10-11).
   - New tabs get a one-time intro line while guidance is on. A "Guide me" button in the header opens the walkthrough. */
(function () {
  var API = null, checked = false;
  var AREA = { safe: "hood", signal: "adapter", belt: "records", thirst: "hood", light: "tires", paper: "records", baseline: "adapter", wrench: "hood", sense: "data" };
  var AREAS = ["hood", "adapter", "records", "tires", "data"];
  var AREA_NAME = { hood: "under-the-hood steps", adapter: "the adapter", records: "records and papers", tires: "tire steps", data: "reading the car's data" };
  var UP = [4, 10]; /* score needed for level 1 and level 2 */
  var CAR = /open the hood|landmarks|find the port|connect in bluefy|oil level check|record all four|tread|set 38|drive 15|door-pillar|baseline drive|three real drives|air filter|first diy job/i;
  var HANDS = /open the hood|landmarks|oil level check|record all four|tread|set 38|air filter|first diy job/i;
  var INTRO = {
    engine: "The engine bay map. Tap a part to see what it is, where it sits and how to check it.",
    live: "Live link talks to the adapter. Connect in Bluefy, run a health check, and save it to the Garage.",
    records: "The service log. Each oil check and service logged here turns guessed due dates into real ones.",
    health: "The Health score. Each item says what is due and what to do next.",
    bay: "The whole-car map. Tap an area to see its parts and their condition.",
    glove: "Glovebox: receipts, papers and tools. Photograph a receipt and the form fills itself in for you to check.",
    diy: "DIY jobs: step-by-step cards from the owner's manual, with tools, time and cost.",
    bulletins: "Volvo's service bulletins for this car, with a check for whether each one applies to yours.",
    fuel: "Fuel and costs: log fill-ups to see your real mileage and spending.",
    my: "My V60: recalls and the details of your car.",
    lab: "Data lab: saved drives side by side, so a change stands out.",
    cards: "Flashcards: a few cards a day about your car. Cards you know come back less often.",
    skills: "The skill tree. Skills are earned from real work, and some unlock tools in the app.",
    trouble: "Troubleshoot: answer a few questions about a symptom to narrow down the cause.",
    kb: "The Library: articles about your car, with sources.",
    exam: "The V60 Master exam. Practice by topic, then take the full exam."
  };

  function today() { return API.todayStr(); }
  function G() {
    var d = API.mod("guide");
    if (!d) { d = { sc: {}, lvl: {}, keep: {}, run: {}, seen: {}, cnt: null, last: null, note: null, at: null, quiz: 0 }; boot(d); API.setMod("guide", d); }
    return d;
  }
  /* someone already part-way through the story should not start back at fully guided */
  function boot(d) {
    var S = window.V60_STORY; if (!S) return;
    S.cases.forEach(function (c) { var st = S.status(c).st; if (st === "closed" || st === "risk") { var a = AREA[c.id]; d.sc[a] = (d.sc[a] || 0) + 3; } });
    AREAS.forEach(function (a) { d.lvl[a] = lvlFor(d.sc[a] || 0); });
  }
  /* coming back after a long gap: each area steps back one level, with a recap on Today (once per app start) */
  function visit() {
    if (checked || !API || !API.ready || !API.ready()) return;
    checked = true; var d = G(), t = today();
    if (d.last && (new Date(t) - new Date(d.last)) / 864e5 >= 45) { AREAS.forEach(function (a) { if (d.lvl[a]) d.lvl[a]--; }); d.back = t; }
    if (d.last !== t) { d.last = t; API.save(); }
  }
  function lvlFor(sc) { return sc >= UP[1] ? 2 : (sc >= UP[0] ? 1 : 0); }
  function areaOf(caseId) { return AREA[caseId] || "records"; }
  function level(caseId) { if (!API) return 2; var d = G(), a = areaOf(caseId); return d.keep[a] ? 0 : (d.lvl[a] || 0); }
  function addScore(a, n, why) {
    var d = G(); d.sc[a] = Math.max(0, (d.sc[a] || 0) + n);
    var was = d.lvl[a] || 0, now = lvlFor(d.sc[a]);
    if (now > was && !d.keep[a]) { d.lvl[a] = now; d.note = { a: a, up: true, to: now, date: today() }; }
    else if (now < was) d.lvl[a] = now;
  }
  function dropLevel(a, reason) {
    var d = G(), was = d.lvl[a] || 0; if (was === 0) return;
    d.lvl[a] = was - 1; d.sc[a] = d.lvl[a] ? UP[d.lvl[a] - 1] : 0; d.note = { a: a, up: false, to: d.lvl[a], date: today(), reason: reason };
  }
  /* things done without being led there count as proof too */
  function counts() {
    var st = API.state, live = API.mod("live") || {}, glove = API.mod("glove") || {}, sq = (API.mod("story") || {}).quiz || {};
    var right = Object.keys(sq).filter(function (k) { return String(sq[k]).indexOf("r") === 0; });
    return { oil: (st.oil || []).length, log: (st.log || []).length, rc: (glove.receipts || []).length, scan: (live.scans || []).filter(function (x) { return !x.sim; }).length, runs: (st.runs || []).length, quiz: right };
  }
  function watch() {
    var d = G(), c = counts(), p = d.cnt;
    d.cnt = { oil: c.oil, log: c.log, rc: c.rc, scan: c.scan, runs: c.runs, quiz: c.quiz.length };
    if (!p || W.open || W.away) return; /* first look, or the walkthrough led it */
    if (c.oil > p.oil) addScore("hood", Math.min(2, c.oil - p.oil));
    if (c.log + c.rc > p.log + p.rc) addScore("records", Math.min(2, c.log + c.rc - p.log - p.rc));
    if (c.scan > p.scan) addScore("adapter", Math.min(2, c.scan - p.scan));
    if (c.runs > p.runs) addScore("data", Math.min(2, c.runs - p.runs));

/* Library: offline knowledge base + Ask. Answers come from V60_FACTS and V60_ARTICLES without any AI call.

(function () {
  var STOP = "a an the is are was were be to of in on for and or my your it its do does did how what when where which who why can i me you with at by from this that there than then about much many should would could will".split(" ");
  var SYN = { gas: "fuel", petrol: "fuel", octane: "fuel octane", mpg: "mpg economy", mileage: "mpg miles", psi: "pressure tire", tyre: "tire", tires: "tire", wheel: "wheel tire", lug: "lug bolt torque", torque: "torque", hp: "horsepower power", horsepower: "horsepower power hp", quart: "quarts capacity", quarts: "quarts capacity", liters: "capacity", litres: "capacity", much: "capacity", antifreeze: "coolant", tpms: "tpms tire monitor", cel: "check engine", mil: "check engine mil", cambelt: "timing belt", belt: "belt timing", battery: "battery", jump: "jump start", recall: "recall", recalls: "recall", bulb: "bulb", headlight: "headlight bulb", wiper: "wiper", wipers: "wiper", brake: "brake", brakes: "brake", oil: "oil", trans: "transmission", gearbox: "transmission", made: "built plant", built: "built plant", weigh: "weight", heavy: "weight", tow: "towing tow", spark: "spark plugs", plugs: "spark plugs", filter: "filter", ac: "ac refrigerant", aircon: "ac refrigerant", freon: "ac refrigerant", inspection: "inspection emissions", emissions: "emissions inspection", fuse: "fuse", flat: "flat spare repair", spare: "spare flat" };

    var arts = window.V60_ARTICLES.map(function (a) { return { a: a, s: scoreArt(a, qt) }; }).filter(function (x) { return x.s > 1; }).sort(function (a, b) { return b.s - a.s; });
    return { facts: facts, arts: arts, qt: qt };
  }

  }
  function bodyHTML(api, lines) {
    var out = [], inList = false;
    lines.forEach(function (l) {
      if (l.indexOf("- ") === 0) { if (!inList) { out.push('<ul class="plain">'); inList = true; } out.push("<li>" + api.esc(l.slice(2)) + "</li>"); return; }
      if (inList) { out.push("</ul>"); inList = false; }

    });

    return out.join("");
  }
  var kb = { view: "home", q: "", art: null, ctl: null };
  /* the part page renders an article inline with this */

  }

Tap Copy and paste it into the chat.</p>\n      <textarea class=\"log\" id=\"lk-log\" readonly rows=\"10\" spellcheck=\"false\" aria-label=\"Adapter log\"></textarea>\n      <div class=\"row\" style=\"margin-top:8px\"><button type=\"button\" class=\"quiet\" id=\"lk-btnCopyLog\">Copy log</button><button type=\"button\" class=\"quiet\" id=\"lk-btnShareLog\" hidden>Share log</button><button type=\"button\" class=\"quiet\" id=\"lk-btnDlLog\">Save as a file</button><button type=\"button\" class=\"quiet\" id=\"lk-btnClearLog\">Clear log</button></div>\n      <p class=\"lede\" style=\"margin:6px 0 0\" id=\"lk-logHelp\">If Copy does nothing, use Share (to Messages, Notes or this chat), or press and hold inside the log, choose Select All, then Copy.</p>\n    </details>\n    <details>\n      <summary>Before you connect</summary>\n      <ol style=\"margin:8px 0 0;padding-left:20px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px\">\n        <li>Plug the adapter into the OBD-II port under the dashboard on the driver's side.</li>\n        <li>Turn the ignition on.
