```javascript
  var FF = [[0x04, "Engine load", function (A) { return Math.round(A * 100 / 255) + " %"; }], [0x05, "Coolant", function (A) { return (A - 40) + " °C / " + Math.round((A - 40) * 1.8 + 32) + " °F"; }],
    [0x06, "Short-term trim", function (A) { return ((A - 128) * 100 / 128).toFixed(1) + " %"; }], [0x07, "Long-term trim", function (A) { return ((A - 128) * 100 / 128).toFixed(1) + " %"; }],
    [0x0B, "Intake pressure", function (A) { return A + " kPa"; }], [0x0C, "RPM", function (A, B) { return Math.round((256 * A + B) / 4) + " rpm"; }],
    [0x0D, "Speed", function (A) { return A + " km/h / " + Math.round(A * 0.621371) + " mph"; }], [0x11, "Throttle", function (A) { return Math.round(A * 100 / 255) + " %"; }]];
  function runScan() {
    var R = { date: new Date().toISOString(), adapter: link.name, codes: [], vin: null, mil: null, monitors: [], freeze: null, since: {} };
    $("btnScan").disabled = true; $("scanStatus").textContent = "Reading VIN...";
    return query("0902", 6000).then(function (res) {
      var p = res.filter(function (x) { return x.data; })[0];
      if (p) { var s = p.data.slice(3).filter(function (b) { return b >= 0x30 && b <= 0x5A; }).map(function (b) { return String.fromCharCode(b); }).join(""); if (s.length >= 17) R.vin = s.slice(-17); }
    }).catch(function () {}).then(function () {
      $("scanStatus").textContent = "Reading light and readiness...";
      return query("0101");
    }).then(function (res) {
      var p = res.filter(function (x) { return x.data && x.data[1] === 0x01 && (x.ecu === "7E8" || x.ecu === "ECU"); })[0] || res.filter(function (x) { return x.data; })[0];
      if (p) {
        var A = p.data[2], B = p.data[3], C = p.data[4], D = p.data[5];
        R.mil = !!(A & 0x80); R.count = A & 0x7F; R.diesel = !!(B & 0x08);
        MON_CONT.forEach(function (m) { if (B & (1 << m[1])) R.monitors.push({ n: m[0], ready: !(B & (0x10 << m[1])) }); });
        if (!R.diesel) MON_SPARK.forEach(function (m) { if (C & (1 << m[1])) R.monitors.push({ n: m[0], ready: !(D & (1 << m[1])) }); });
      }
      $("scanStatus").textContent = "Reading codes...";
      var kinds = [["03", "stored"], ["07", "pending"], ["0A", "permanent"]];
      return kinds.reduce(function (pp, k) { return pp.then(function () { return query(k[0], 6000).then(function (res2) { dtcsFrom(res2).forEach(function (d) { R.codes.push({ code: d.code, kind: k[1], ecu: ecuName(d.ecu) }); }); }).catch(function () {}); }); }, Promise.resolve());
    }).then(function () {
      $("scanStatus").textContent = "Reading freeze frame...";
      return query("020200").then(function (res) {
        var p = res.filter(function (x) { return x.data && x.data.length >= 5; })[0];
        if (!p || (p.data[3] === 0 && p.data[4] === 0)) return;
        R.freeze = { dtc: decodeDTC(p.data[3], p.data[4]), values: [] };
        return FF.reduce(function (pp, f) {
          if (!pidSupported(f[0])) return pp;
          return pp.then(function () { return query("02" + hex2(f[0]) + "00").then(function (r2) { var q = r2.filter(function (x) { return x.data && x.data[1] === f[0]; })[0]; if (q) R.freeze.values.push([f[1], f[2](q.data[3], q.data[4])]); }).catch(function () {}); });
        }, Promise.resolve());
      }).catch(function () {});
    }).then(function () {
      $("scanStatus").textContent = "Reading history counters...";
      var counters = [[0x31, "distSinceClear", function (d) { return 256 * d[0] + d[1]; }], [0x30, "warmupsSinceClear", function (d) { return d[0]; }], [0x21, "distWithMil", function (d) { return 256 * d[0] + d[1]; }], [0x4E, "minSinceClear", function (d) { return 256 * d[0] + d[1]; }]];
      return counters.reduce(function (pp, c) { if (!pidSupported(c[0])) return pp; return pp.then(function () { return readPid(c[0]).then(function (d) { if (d) R.since[c[1]] = c[2](d); }).catch(function () {}); }); }, Promise.resolve());
    }).then(function () {
      report = R; renderReport(); renderCoach(); $("scanStatus").textContent = "Done " + new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
      armClear();
    }).catch(function (e) { $("scanStatus").textContent = "Stopped: " + ((e && e.message) || e); })
      .then(function () { $("btnScan").disabled = !link; });
  }
  var CODE_HINTS = { P0171: "System too lean, bank 1", P0172: "System too rich, bank 1", P0420: "Catalyst efficiency below threshold, bank 1", P0300: "Random or multiple misfire", P0301: "Misfire, cylinder 1", P0302: "Misfire, cylinder 2", P0303: "Misfire, cylinder 3", P0304: "Misfire, cylinder 4", P0700: "Transmission control system fault requested the light", P0128: "Coolant below thermostat regulating temperature", P0455: "Evaporative system large leak", P0456: "Evaporative system very small leak", P0442: "Evaporative system small leak", P0011: "Intake camshaft timing over-advanced, bank 1", P0016: "Crank and cam position correlation, bank 1", P0101: "Air flow sensor range or performance", P0299: "Turbo underboost", P0507: "Idle speed higher than expected", P2187: "Lean at idle, bank 1", P0141: "Downstream oxygen sensor heater circuit" };
  function renderReport() {
    var R = report; $("scanOut").hidden = false;
    var stored = R.codes.filter(function (c) { return c.kind === "stored"; }).length, pend = R.codes.filter(function (c) { return c.kind === "pending"; }).length;
    var notReady = R.monitors.filter(function (m) { return !m.ready; }).length;
    var s = [];
    s.push(R.mil ? ["bad", "Check-engine light is ON", "The engine computer reports " + (R.count || 0) + " emissions-related code" + (R.count === 1 ? "" : "s") + " behind it."] : ["ok", "Check-engine light is off", ""]);
    s.push(stored + pend ? [stored ? "bad" : "watch", stored + " stored and " + pend + " pending code" + (stored + pend === 1 ? "" : "s"), "Pending means seen once but not confirmed. It may set the light if it repeats."] : ["ok", "No stored or pending codes", ""]);
    if (R.monitors.length) s.push(notReady ? ["watch", notReady + " of " + R.monitors.length + " readiness monitors not ready", "Normal for a few days after codes are cleared or the battery is disconnected. Mixed driving completes them."] : ["ok", "All " + R.monitors.length + " readiness monitors are ready", ""]);
    if (R.monitors.length || R.mil != null) {
      var fail = R.mil || notReady > 1;
      s.push(fail ? ["bad", "Emissions inspection: likely FAIL right now", (R.mil ? "The check-engine light is on with a stored code. " : "") + (notReady > 1 ? notReady + " monitors are not ready, and federal rules allow at most one on a 2001 or newer car. " : "") + "Fix the cause, then drive normally until the monitors finish before testing."] : ["ok", "Emissions inspection: readiness looks passable", "No light, and " + (notReady ? "only one monitor" : "no monitors") + " not ready (the federal limit for 2001 and newer cars is one). This is a readiness check, not a full test."]);
    }
    if (R.vin) s.push(["info", "VIN " + R.vin, "Check open recalls for this VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls."]);
    $("summary").innerHTML = s.map(function (x) { return '<li><span class="pill ' + x[0] + '">' + ({ ok: "Good", watch: "Watch", bad: "Act", info: "Info" })[x[0]] + "</span><b>" + esc(x[1]) + "</b>" + (x[2] ? '<span class="d">' + (x[0] === "info" ? 'Check open recalls for this VIN at <a href="https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls" target="_blank" rel="noopener">nhtsa.gov/recalls</a>.' : esc(x[2])) + "</span>" : "") + "</li>"; }).join("");
    $("codes").innerHTML = R.codes.length ? R.codes.map(function (c) {
      var lvl = c.kind === "pending" ? "watch" : "bad";
      return '<li><span class="pill ' + lvl + '">' + esc(c.kind) + '</span><span><span class="code">' + esc(c.code) + "</span> · " + esc(c.ecu) + '</span><span class="d">' + (window.V60_CB ? window.V60_CB.codeHint(c.code, CODE_HINTS[c.code] || "Look this code up in V60 Garage's Diagnose tab.") : esc(CODE_HINTS[c.code] || "Look this code up in V60 Garage's Diagnose tab.")) + (c.kind === "permanent" ? " Permanent codes cannot be cleared with a tool. They erase themselves after the car confirms the fix over several drives." : "") + "</span></li>";
    }).join("") : '<li><span class="pill ok">None</span><span>No codes reported by any module that answered.</span></li>';
    $("freeze").innerHTML = R.freeze ? "<dt>Triggered by</dt><dd>" + esc(R.freeze.dtc) + "</dd>" + R.freeze.values.map(function (v) { return "<dt>" + esc(v[0]) + "</dt><dd>" + esc(v[1]) + "</dd>"; }).join("") : "<dt>None</dt><dd>No freeze frame stored.</dd>";
    $("monitors").innerHTML = R.monitors.length ? R.monitors.map(function (m) { return "<div><span>" + cbl("mon:" + m.n, m.n) + '</span><span class="pill ' + (m.ready ? "ok" : "watch") + '">' + (m.ready ? "ready" : "not ready") + "</span></div>"; }).join("") : '<div><span>No readiness data returned</span></div>';
    var sv = R.since, rows = [];
    if (isNum(sv.distSinceClear)) rows.push(["Since codes cleared", Math.round(sv.distSinceClear * 0.621371) + " mi" + (isNum(sv.warmupsSinceClear) ? ", " + sv.warmupsSinceClear + " warm-ups" : "")]);
    if (isNum(sv.distWithMil)) rows.push(["Driven with light on", Math.round(sv.distWithMil * 0.621371) + " mi"]);
    $("since").innerHTML = rows.map(function (r) { return "<dt>" + esc(r[0]) + "</dt><dd>" + esc(r[1]) + "</dd>"; }).join("");
  }
  $("btnScan").addEventListener("click", runScan);

  /* ---------------- export helpers ---------------- */
  function fileFor(name, text, type) { return new File([text], name, { type: type }); }
  function download(name, text, type) {
    if (window.V60_FILE) { window.V60_FILE.save(name, text, type).catch(function () {}); return; }
    var url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([text], { type: type })), a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url; a.download = name; document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
    setTimeout(function () { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); }, 4000);
  }
  function canShareFiles() { try { return !!(navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare({ files: [fileFor("x.txt", "x", "text/plain")] })); } catch (e) { return false; } }
  /* Bluefy's share sheet has delivered only the file name, not the file. Pass the content as text too, so the receiving app gets it either way. */
  function share(name, text, type) {
    var data = { title: name, text: text };
    if (canShareFiles()) data.files = [fileFor(name, text, type)];
    return navigator.share(data);
  }
  function stamp() { var d = new Date(); return d.getFullYear() + "-" + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0") + "_" + String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, "0") + String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0"); }
  function reportJSON() {
    var r = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(report)); delete r.vin;
    return JSON.stringify({ source: "v60-link", version: 1, report: r }, null, 2);
  }
  $("btnReport").addEventListener("click", function () {
    if (!report) return;
    var r = JSON.parse(reportJSON()).report, added = api.importLinkReport(r);
    saveScan(r);
    $("reportStatus").textContent = "Saved to your Garage. " + (added ? added + " new code" + (added === 1 ? "" : "s") + " added to the Diagnose log." : "No new active codes.") + " Readiness updated in Health.";
    $("ck1").checked = true; armClear(); renderHistory(); renderCoach();
  });
  $("btnDlReport").addEventListener("click", function () {
    if (!report) return;
    download("v60-health-" + stamp() + ".json", reportJSON(), "application/json");
    $("reportStatus").textContent = "Downloaded. Another copy of the Garage can load it in Diagnose, under Import a V60 Link report.";
  });
  if (navigator.share) { $("btnShareReport").hidden = false; $("btnShareCsv").hidden = false; }
  $("btnShareReport").addEventListener("click", function () { if (!report) return; share("v60-health-" + stamp() + ".json", reportJSON(), "application/json").then(function () { $("ck1").checked = true; armClear(); }).catch(function () {}); });

  /* ---------------- live data ---------------- */
  var live = { on: false, rows: [], t0: 0, sel: {} };
  PIDS.forEach(function (p) { live.sel[p.pid] = p.on; });
  function renderPicks() {
    $("picks").innerHTML = PIDS.map(function (p) {
      var ok = pidSupported(p.pid);
      return '<label class="' + (ok ? "" : "na") + '"><input type="checkbox" data-pid="' + p.pid + '"' + (live.sel[p.pid] && ok ? " checked" : "") + (ok ? "" : " disabled") + "> " + cbl("pid:" + hex2(p.pid), p.n) + (ok ? "" : " (not supported)") + "</label>";
    }).join("");
    renderCluster();
    $("tiles").innerHTML = PIDS.filter(function (p) { return live.sel[p.pid] && pidSupported(p.pid); }).map(function (p) { return '<div class="tile"><div class="k">' + cbl("pid:" + hex2(p.pid), p.n) + '</div><div><span class="v" id="lk-tv' + p.pid + '">--</span><span class="u">' + esc(p.us === "F" ? "°F" : (p.us === "mph" ? "mph" : p.u)) + "</span></div></div>"; }).join("");
  }
  $("picks").addEventListener("change", function (e) { var pid = +e.target.getAttribute("data-pid"); if (pid) { live.sel[pid] = e.target.checked; if (!live.on) renderPicks(); } });
  function shown(p, v) { if (p.us === "F") return Math.round(v * 1.8 + 32); if (p.us === "mph") return Math.round(v * 0.621371); return v.toFixed(p.d); }
  function stopLive() { var was = live.on; live.on = false; $("btnLive").textContent = "Start recording"; wake(false); zero.armed = false; zero.running = false; $("zArm").textContent = "Arm 0–60"; if (was) trip.finish(); }
  function loop() {
    var pids = PIDS.filter(function (p) { return live.sel[p.pid] && pidSupported(p.pid); });
    if (!pids.length) { stopLive(); $("liveStatus").textContent = "Pick at least one supported channel."; return; }
    (function pass() {
      if (!live.on || !link) { stopLive(); return; }
      var row = { t: (Date.now() - live.t0) / 1000 };
      pids.reduce(function (p, pd) { return p.then(function () { if (!live.on) return; return readPid(pd.pid).then(function (d) { if (d) { var v = pd.f(d[0], d[1]); row[pd.pid] = v; var el = $("tv" + pd.pid); if (el) el.textContent = shown(pd, v); onValue(pd.pid, v); } }).catch(function () {}); }); }, Promise.resolve())
        .then(function () {
          live.rows.push(row); trip.add(row); updateDials(row);
          var dur = row.t, rate = live.rows.length / Math.max(dur, 0.1);
          $("liveStatus").textContent = live.rows.length + " samples, " + Math.floor(dur / 60) + ":" + String(Math.floor(dur % 60)).padStart(2, "0") + ", " + rate.toFixed(1) + " per second";
          $("btnCsv").disabled = $("btnDlCsv").disabled = live.rows.length < 5;
          if (live.rows.length > 30000) { stopLive(); $("liveStatus").textContent += ". Stopped at the 30,000-sample limit. Save the CSV."; return; }
          setTimeout(pass, 0);
        });
    })();
  }
  $("btnLive").addEventListener("click", function () {
    if (live.on) { stopLive(); return; }
    if (live.rows.length && !window.__keepRows) live.rows = [];
    renderPicks(); live.on = true; live.t0 = Date.now(); $("btnLive").textContent = "Stop recording"; $("btnCsv").disabled = $("btnDlCsv").disabled = true; trip.reset(); wake(true); loop();
  });
  function csv() {
    var used = PIDS.filter(function (p) { return live.rows.some(function (r) { return isNum(r[p.pid]); }); });
    var lines = ["Time (s)," + used.map(function (p) { return p.col; }).join(",")];
    live.rows.forEach(function (r) { lines.push(r.t.toFixed(2) + "," + used.map(function (p) { return isNum(r[p.pid]) ? +r[p.pid].toFixed(3) : ""; }).join(",")); });
    return lines.join("\n");
  }
  $("btnCsv").addEventListener("click", function () { try { api.loadDataset(api.parseCSV(csv()), "Live recording " + stamp()); api.go("lab"); } catch (e) { $("liveStatus").textContent = (e && e.message) || "Could not open the recording."; } });
  $("btnDlCsv").addEventListener("click", function () { download("v60-log-" + stamp() + ".csv", csv(), "text/csv"); });
  $("btnShareCsv").addEventListener("click", function () { if (live.rows.length >= 5) share("v60-log-" + stamp() + ".csv", csv(), "text/csv").catch(function () {}); });

  /* ---------------- Garage additions: saved data ---------------- */
  function data() { var d = api.mod("live"); if (!d) { d = { trips: [], scans: [], runs: [] }; api.setMod("live", d); } return d; }
  function saveScan(r) {
    var d = data();
    d.scans.push({ date: r.date, mil: !!r.mil, codes: (r.codes || []).slice(0, 40), monitors: (r.monitors || []).slice(0, 12), freeze: r.freeze || null, since: r.since || {}, sim: !!(link && link.name === "Simulated V60") });
    if (d.scans.length > 30) d.scans.shift();
    api.save(); api.updateHud();
  }
  function fmtDur(s) { s = Math.round(s); return Math.floor(s / 60) + ":" + String(s % 60).padStart(2, "0"); }
  function renderHistory() {
    var d = data();
    $("trips").innerHTML = d.trips.length ? d.trips.slice().reverse().slice(0, 8).map(function (t) {
      return '<li><span class="pill info">' + esc(String(t.date).slice(5, 10)) + "</span><b>" + t.mi.toFixed(1) + " mi in " + fmtDur(t.dur) + (t.sim ? " (simulated)" : "") + '</b><span class="d">Top ' + Math.round(t.maxMph) + " mph · moving average " + Math.round(t.avgMph) + " mph · idling " + Math.round(t.idlePct) + "%" + (isNum(t.maxCoolF) ? " · coolant peak " + Math.round(t.maxCoolF) + " °F" : "") + (isNum(t.ltft) ? " · long-term trim " + t.ltft.toFixed(1) + "%" : "") + "</span></li>";
    }).join("") : '<li><span class="pill info">None</span><span>Record a drive to log a trip.</span></li>';
    $("scans").innerHTML = d.scans.length ? d.scans.slice().reverse().slice(0, 8).map(function (s) {
      var nr = (s.monitors || []).filter(function (m) { return !m.ready; }).length, codes = (s.codes || []).map(function (c) { return c.code + " (" + c.kind + ")"; });
      return '<li><span class="pill ' + (s.mil ? "bad" : (codes.length ? "watch" : "ok")) + '">' + (s.mil ? "Light on" : (codes.length ? "Codes" : "Clean")) + "</span><b>" + esc(String(s.date).slice(0, 10)) + (s.sim ? " (simulated)" : "") + '</b><span class="d">' + (codes.length ? esc(codes.join(", ")) : "No codes") + " · " + nr + " monitor" + (nr === 1 ? "" : "s") + " not ready" + (s.freeze ? " · freeze frame from " + esc(s.freeze.dtc) + ": " + esc(s.freeze.values.map(function (v) { return v[0] + " " + v[1]; }).join(", ")) : "") + "</span></li>";
    }).join("") : '<li><span class="pill info">None</span><span>Save a health check to start the history.</span></li>';
  }

  /* ---------------- gauge cluster ---------------- */
  var DIALS = [
    { k: "rpm", n: "RPM", pids: [0x0C], lo: 0, hi: 7000, hot: 6000, v: function (r) { return r[0x0C]; }, f: function (v) { return Math.round(v / 10) * 10; } },
    { k: "spd", n: "mph", pids: [0x0D], lo: 0, hi: 130, v: function (r) { return isNum(r[0x0D]) ? r[0x0D] * 0.621371 : null; }, f: function (v) { return Math.round(v); } },
    { k: "boost", n: "boost psi", pids: [0x0B, 0x33], lo: -15, hi: 22, v: function (r) { return isNum(r[0x0B]) && isNum(lastBaro) ? (r[0x0B] - lastBaro) * 0.145038 : null; }, f: function (v) { return v.toFixed(1); } },
    { k: "cool", n: "coolant °F", pids: [0x05], lo: 100, hi: 260, hot: 230, v: function (r) { return isNum(r[0x05]) ? r[0x05] * 1.8 + 32 : null; }, f: function (v) { return Math.round(v); } },
    { k: "volt", n: "volts", pids: [0x42], lo: 10, hi: 16, v: function (r) { return r[0x42]; }, f: function (v) { return v.toFixed(1); } },
    { k: "ltft", n: "LT fuel trim %", pids: [0x07], lo: -25, hi: 25, hot: 10, abs: true, v: function (r) { return r[0x07]; }, f: function (v) { return (v > 0 ? "+" : "") + v.toFixed(1); } }
  ];
  var lastBaro = null;
  function activeDials() { return DIALS.filter(function (g) { return g.pids.every(function (p) { return live.sel[p] && pidSupported(p); }); }); }
  function renderCluster() {
    var ds = activeDials();
    $("cluster").innerHTML = ds.length ? ds.map(function (g) {
      return '<div class="dial"><svg viewBox="0 0 120 92" aria-hidden="true"><path class="dtrack" d="M17 84 A50 50 0 1 1 103 84" pathLength="100"/><path class="dfill" id="lk-df-' + g.k + '" d="M17 84 A50 50 0 1 1 103 84" pathLength="100" stroke-dasharray="0 100"/></svg><div class="dv" id="lk-dv-' + g.k + '">--</div><div class="dl">' + esc(g.pids.length === 1 && window.V60_CB && !window.V60_CB.decoded("pid:" + hex2(g.pids[0])) ? "PID " + hex2(g.pids[0]) : g.n) + "</div></div>";
    }).join("") : '<p class="status">Connect and pick channels such as RPM, speed, coolant or intake pressure to see gauges.</p>';
  }
  function updateDials(row) {
    driveUpdate(row);
    activeDials().forEach(function (g) {
      var v = g.v(row); if (!isNum(v)) return;
      var pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (v - g.lo) / (g.hi - g.lo) * 100)), f = $("df-" + g.k), t = $("dv-" + g.k);
      if (f) { f.setAttribute("stroke-dasharray", pct.toFixed(1) + " 100"); f.classList.toggle("hot", g.hot != null && (g.abs ? Math.abs(v) >= g.hot : v >= g.hot)); }
      if (t) t.textContent = g.f(v);
    });
  }

  /* ---------------- the dashboard's own start button: the gauges fill only while live data is being read ----------------
     It drives the same recording as Live data's Start recording, so the two always agree (a MutationObserver keeps the label in step). */
  function dashSync() {
    var go = $("dashGo"); if (!go) return;
    go.disabled = !link; go.textContent = live.on ? "Stop gauges" : "Start gauges";
    $("driveSt").textContent = !link ? "Connect the adapter first." : (live.on ? "Reading the car." : "Connected. Tap Start gauges.");
    if (drive && drive.el && !drive.el.hidden) $("dvMsg").textContent = !link ? "Not connected. Exit, connect the adapter, then open Drive mode again." : (live.on ? "" : "Starting...");
  }
  function startGauges(chans) {
    if (!link || live.on) return;
    (chans || []).forEach(function (p) { if (pidSupported(p)) live.sel[p] = true; });
    renderCluster(); $("btnLive").click();
  }
  $("dashGo").addEventListener("click", function () { if (live.on) $("btnLive").click(); else startGauges(); });
```

```javascript
    else if (s.upg) { var u = upgrade(s.upg); o.kind = "Upgrade"; o.t = o.t || ("Decide: " + (u ? u.t : s.upg)); o.go = o.go || "tab:upgrades"; o.done = !!((mod(api, "upg", { want: {} }).want || {})[s.upg]); }
    else if (s.recall) { o.kind = "Recalls"; o.go = o.go || "tab:my"; var rs = api.state.recalls || {}; o.done = (api.RECALLS || []).every(function (r) { return rs[r.id] && rs[r.id] !== "unknown"; }); }

  /* ---------- open, closed, status ---------- */
  var cache = null;

  function compute(api) {
    if (cache) return cache;

    CHLIST.forEach(function (c) { closed[c.id] = c.steps.every(function (s, i) { return s.optional || info(api, c, i).done; }); });
    /* the path decides what is open: every step up to the first one not done (or set aside) */

    STAGES.forEach(function (s) {

    if (s.kind === "g1") return "Study: " + s.t;
```

### `src/js/modules/scan.js`

```javascript
/* Auto-read uploads with privacy redaction.
   Every photo added to the app passes through V60_SCAN.process(file, kind) before it is stored or synced:
   1. resize (re-encoding through a canvas drops EXIF and GPS data),
   2. read the text on this device with Tesseract.js (nothing is uploaded to read it),
   3. find personal details (VIN, plate, names after labels, addresses, phone numbers, email, card numbers,
      and the owner's own "always hide" words) and cover them with black boxes,
   4. let the owner tap boxes to show or hide them, or drag to hide anything else,
   5. decode what the photo is (receipt, door-pillar label, registration, insurance card, inspection report)
      and offer the values it read, marked unconfirmed.
   Only the redacted image is returned. The original is never stored.
   First version from Gemini (2026-10-11); rewritten by Claude for multi-word matching, a clean saved image,
   drawing boxes by hand, a pinned Tesseract version, and document decoding. */
(function () {
```

```javascript
  /* ---------- status, availability and what the app reveals ---------- */
  function status(api, c) {
    var d = D(api), cl = d.closed[c.id];
    var done = c.steps.map(function (s) { try { return s.manual ? man(api, s.manual) : !!s.ok(api); } catch (e) { return false; } });
    if (cl) return { st: cl.how === "reason" ? "risk" : "closed", done: done, rec: cl };
    var ev = c.steps.some(function (s, i) { return done[i] && s.stage === "evidence" && !s.optional; }), ld = done.some(function (x, i) { return x && !c.steps[i].optional; }) || done.some(Boolean);
    return { st: ev ? "evidence" : (ld ? "lead" : "unknown"), done: done };
  }
  function actClosed(api, n) { var d = D(api); return CASES.filter(function (c) { return c.act === n; }).every(function (c) { return d.closed[c.id]; }); }
  function available(api, c) {
    var d = D(api); if (d.closed[c.id]) return true;
    var n = +c.act; if (n > 1 && !actClosed(api, String(n - 1))) return false;
    var inAct = CASES.filter(function (x) { return x.act === c.act; }), i = inAct.indexOf(c);
    if (i === 0) return true;
    var prev = inAct[i - 1]; return !!d.closed[prev.id] || status(api, prev).st !== "unknown";
  }
  function finaleReady(api) { var d = D(api); return !!(window.V60_TRACK && window.V60_TRACK.passedG1()) && CRIT.every(function (id) { return d.closed[id]; }); }
  var ALLTABS = null, gcache = null, gtime = 0;
  function revealedSet(api) { var now = Date.now(); if (gcache && now - gtime < 150) return gcache; gcache = computeSet(api); gtime = now; return gcache; }
```

### `src/js/modules/track.js`

```javascript
/* Shared UI helpers: the car pulse strip in the header (warning lights, oil, service), and read-aloud for any element
   marked with data-speak="<css selector>". No tab of its own. */
(function () {
  var API = null, speaking = null;

  /* One way out for every file the app makes. Bluefy on iPhone cannot download (a link with a download attribute does
     nothing) and its share sheet drops attached files, passing only the title, so the content always goes as text too.
     Order: Claude's own save (inside the artifact), the share sheet, a plain download. Resolves with the route used. */
  var UA = navigator.userAgent || "", IOS = /iPhone|iPad|iPod/.test(UA), BLUEFY = /Bluefy/i.test(UA);
  function fileFor(name, text, type) { try { return new File([text], name, { type: type }); } catch (e) { return null; } }
  function anchorDownload(name, text, type) {
    var url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([text], { type: type })), a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url; a.download = name; document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove(); setTimeout(function () { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); }, 4000);
  }
  function saveFile(name, text, type) {
    type = type || "text/plain";
    var viaClaude = API && API.claudeUse ? API.claudeUse("downloads").catch(function () { return null; }) : Promise.resolve(null);
    return viaClaude.then(function (d) {
      if (d) return d.save({ filename: name, data: text }).then(function () { return "claude"; });
      if (navigator.share) {
        var data = { title: name, text: text }, f = fileFor(name, text, type);
        if (f && navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare({ files: [f] })) data.files = [f];
        return navigator.share(data).then(function () { return "share"; }, function (e) { if (e && e.name === "AbortError") throw e; anchorDownload(name, text, type); return "download"; });
      }
      anchorDownload(name, text, type); return "download";
    });
  }
  function textOf(el) {
    /* a plain-text copy of a rendered section, for phones that cannot print */
    var out = [], walk = function (n) {
      if (n.nodeType === 3) { out.push(n.nodeValue); return; }
      if (n.nodeType !== 1 || n.hidden || /^(SCRIPT|STYLE|BUTTON|SVG)$/.test(n.tagName)) return;
      var block = /^(H1|H2|H3|H4|P|LI|DT|DD|DIV|SECTION|ARTICLE|TR|FIGCAPTION|SUMMARY)$/.test(n.tagName);
      if (/^(H1|H2|H3)$/.test(n.tagName)) out.push("\n\n");
      if (n.tagName === "LI") out.push("\n- ");
      else if (n.tagName === "DT") out.push("\n");
      else if (n.tagName === "DD") out.push(": ");
      else if (block) out.push("\n");
      for (var c = n.firstChild; c; c = c.nextSibling) walk(c);
      if (/^(TD|TH)$/.test(n.tagName)) out.push("  ");
    };
    walk(el);
    return out.join("").replace(/[ \t]+\n/g, "\n").replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n").replace(/\n[ \t]+/g, "\n").trim();
  }
  window.V60_FILE = { save: saveFile, textOf: textOf, ios: IOS, bluefy: BLUEFY, canPrint: !IOS };

  /* Tables on an upright phone: every cell gets its column name (data-label) so the CSS can stack each row as a small
     card instead of a 600 px table scrolling sideways. Re-run whenever a page redraws a table. */
  function labelTables() {
    document.querySelectorAll(".scroll table").forEach(function (t) {
      var head = t.tHead && t.tHead.rows[0]; if (!head) return;
      var names = Array.prototype.map.call(head.cells, function (c) { return c.textContent.trim(); });
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(t.tBodies, function (tb) {
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(tb.rows, function (tr) {
          var col = 0;
          Array.prototype.forEach.call(tr.cells, function (td) {
            if (td.colSpan > 1) td.setAttribute("data-wide", ""); else if (!td.hasAttribute("data-label")) td.setAttribute("data-label", names[col] || "");
            col += td.colSpan || 1;
          });
        });
      });
    });
  }
  var tq = 0;
  function queueTables() { if (tq) return; tq = requestAnimationFrame(function () { tq = 0; labelTables(); }); }
  if (window.MutationObserver) new MutationObserver(queueTables).observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  queueTables();
  function daysSince(d) { if (!d) return null; return Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(String(d).slice(0, 10) + "T12:00:00").getTime()) / 864e5); }
  function pulse(api) {
    var el = document.getElementById("pulse"); if (!el) return;
    var st = api.state, items = [];
    var active = (st.codes || []).filter(function (c) { return c.status === "active"; }).length, ls = st.lastScan;
    items.push(active ? ["concern", "Codes", active + " active", "tab:diag"] : (ls ? (ls.mil ? ["concern", "Light", "On", "tab:live"] : ["ok", "Light", "No codes", "tab:live"]) : ["none", "Light", "Not scanned", "tab:live"]));
    var oil = (st.oil || []).slice().sort(function (a, b) { return a.date < b.date ? 1 : -1; })[0], od = oil ? daysSince(oil.date) : null;
    items.push(oil ? [od > 35 ? "watch" : "ok", "Oil", od === 0 ? "Checked today" : "Checked " + od + "d ago", "tab:records"] : ["none", "Oil", "No checks", "tab:records"]);
    var worst = null, rank = { over: 3, soon: 2, ok: 1, none: 0 };
    (api.ITEMS || []).forEach(function (it) { var s = api.statusFor(it); if (s && s.cls !== "none" && (!worst || rank[s.cls] > rank[worst.s.cls])) worst = { it: it, s: s }; });
    items.push(worst ? [worst.s.cls === "over" ? "concern" : (worst.s.cls === "soon" ? "watch" : "ok"), "Service", worst.s.cls === "ok" ? "On track" : (worst.s.cls === "over" ? "Overdue: " : "Soon: ") + worst.it.name, "tab:health"] : ["none", "Service", "No records", "tab:health"]);
    el.innerHTML = items.map(function (x) { return '<button type="button" class="pdot ' + x[0] + '" data-jump="' + x[3] + '"><i aria-hidden="true"></i><span><b>' + api.esc(x[1]) + "</b> " + api.esc(x[2]) + "</span></button>"; }).join("");
  }
  function speak(sel, btn) {
    try {
      if (!window.speechSynthesis) return;
      if (speaking === sel) { window.speechSynthesis.cancel(); speaking = null; btn.textContent = "Listen"; return; }
      var el = document.querySelector(sel); if (!el) return;
      var clone = el.cloneNode(true); clone.querySelectorAll("button, summary, .status a").forEach(function (b) { b.remove(); });
      var text = (clone.innerText || clone.textContent || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim(); if (!text) return;
      window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
      var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text.slice(0, 4000)); u.rate = 1;
      u.onend = function () { speaking = null; btn.textContent = "Listen"; };
      speaking = sel; btn.textContent = "Stop"; window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
    } catch (e) {}
  }
  (window.V60_MODULES = window.V60_MODULES || []).push({
    id: "ui",
    init: function (api) {
      API = api;
      document.addEventListener("click", function (e) { var b = e.target.closest && e.target.closest("[data-speak]"); if (!b) return; e.preventDefault(); speak(b.getAttribute("data-speak"), b); });
      if (!window.speechSynthesis) document.documentElement.classList.add("nospeech");
    },
    refresh: function (api) { pulse(api); }
  });
})();
```

### `tools/apply_handoff.py`

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Apply a handoff Markdown file (from Gemini or Claude) to this repo.

Usage: python3 tools/apply_handoff.py HANDOFF.md [--dry-run]

- Every "### `path`" heading followed by a fenced code block is written to that path (full-file replacement).
- "### `path` (base64)" blocks are decoded as binary.
- Bullets under "## Deleted files" are removed.
- "## 1/2/3" sections replace docs/HANDOFF_STATE.md.
- "## Edits to apply" is printed for manual or Claude-applied find-and-replace; nothing there is applied automatically.
Paths must stay inside the repo; build outputs (index.html at root, js/, dist-artifact/, sw.js, link.html) are refused because tools/build.py owns them.
"""
import base64, os, re, sys

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
REFUSE = re.compile(r"^(index\.html|version\.json|app\.css|sw\.js|link\.html|manifest\.webmanifest|js/|dist-artifact/)")

def scan(md):
    """Walk the file line by line. Returns (files, outside) where files are (path, is_base64, body) for every
    '### `path`' heading followed by a fenced block, and outside is the text that is not inside any code block."""
    lines = md.split("\n")
    files, outside, i, pending = [], [], 0, None
    head = re.compile(r"^### `([^`]+)`( \(base64\))?")
    while i < len(lines):
        ln = lines[i]
        m = re.match(r"^(`{3,})", ln)
        if m:
            fence, body, i = m.group(1), [], i + 1
            while i < len(lines) and not (lines[i].startswith(fence) and lines[i].strip("`") == ""):
                body.append(lines[i]); i += 1
            if i >= len(lines): raise SystemExit("Unclosed code block" + (" for " + pending[0] if pending else ""))
            if pending:
                text = "\n".join(body)
                files.append((pending[0], pending[1], text if (pending[1] or not body) else text + "\n"))
                pending = None
            i += 1
            continue
        h = head.match(ln)
        if h: pending = (h.group(1), bool(h.group(2)))
        outside.append(ln); i += 1
    return files, "\n".join(outside)

def section(text, title):
    m = re.search(r"^## " + re.escape(title) + r"[^\n]*\n(.*?)(?=^## |\Z)", text, re.M | re.S)
    return m.group(0).strip() if m else None

def main():
    if len(sys.argv) < 2: raise SystemExit(__doc__)
    md = open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8").read().replace("\r\n", "\n")
    dry = "--dry-run" in sys.argv
    changed, same, refused = [], [], []
    found, outside = scan(md)
    for path, b64, body in found:
        norm = os.path.normpath(path).replace(os.sep, "/")
        if norm.startswith("..") or os.path.isabs(norm) or REFUSE.match(norm):
            refused.append(path); continue
        if norm == "docs/HANDOFF_STATE.md": continue
        data = base64.b64decode("".join(body.split())) if b64 else body.encode("utf-8")
        fp = os.path.join(ROOT, norm)
        old = open(fp, "rb").read() if os.path.isfile(fp) else None
        if old == data: same.append(norm); continue
        changed.append((norm, "new" if old is None else "%+d bytes" % (len(data) - len(old))))
        if not dry:
            os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(fp) or ROOT, exist_ok=True)
            open(fp, "wb").write(data)
    deleted = []
    dsec = section(outside, "Deleted files")
    if dsec:
        for p in re.findall(r"^- `([^`]+)`", dsec, re.M):
            fp = os.path.join(ROOT, os.path.normpath(p))
            if os.path.isfile(fp) and not REFUSE.match(p):
                deleted.append(p)
                if not dry: os.remove(fp)
    parts = [section(outside, t) for t in ("1. Current Active Objective", "2. Immediate Next Steps", "3. Pending Logic & Blockers")]
    if all(parts) and not dry:
        open(os.path.join(ROOT, "docs", "HANDOFF_STATE.md"), "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n").write("\n\n".join(parts) + "\n")
    print(("DRY RUN: " if dry else "") + "%d changed, %d identical, %d refused, %d deleted" % (len(changed), len(same), len(refused), len(deleted)))
    for c in changed: print("  changed", c[0], c[1])
    for r in refused: print("  refused (build output or outside repo)", r)
    for d in deleted: print("  deleted", d)
    edits = section(md, "Edits to apply") if section(outside, "Edits to apply") else None
    if edits: print("\nManual edits requested:\n" + edits)
    if all(parts): print("Handoff state sections " + ("found" if dry else "written to docs/HANDOFF_STATE.md"))
    print("Next: python3 tools/build.py, then run the tests in CLAUDE.md.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

### `tools/build.py`

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build V60 Garage from src/ into:
  - repo root (GitHub Pages PWA): index.html, app.css, js/*.js, sw.js, manifest.webmanifest, icons/
  - dist-artifact/ (Claude artifact): garage.html plus the same css/js, listed in files.json
Add a feature: drop a file in src/js/modules/ (it registers itself on window.V60_MODULES) and add it to MODULES below.
"""
import json, os, re, shutil, time, hashlib

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
SRC = os.path.join(ROOT, "src")

DATA = sorted(f for f in os.listdir(os.path.join(SRC, "js", "data")) if f.endswith(".js"))
MODULES = [
    "today.js", "kb.js", "cards.js", "story.js", "manual.js", "track.js", "fuel.js", "glovebox.js", "docs.js",
    "diy.js", "trees.js", "bulletins.js", "upgrades.js", "live.js", "extras.js", "sync.js", "ui.js", "scan.js", "guide.js",
]

def read(*p):
    with open(os.path.join(SRC, *p), encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return f.read()

def write(path, text):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as f:
        f.write(text)

def main():
    stamp = time.strftime("%Y.%m.%d-%H%M", time.gmtime())  # UTC, so a build here and the GitHub build read the same; the header shows it in the phone's time
    mods = [m for m in MODULES if os.path.exists(os.path.join(SRC, "js", "modules", m))]
    js_files = ["js/data/" + d for d in DATA] + ["js/modules/" + m for m in mods] + ["js/core.js"]
    css = "\n".join(read("css", c) for c in ["app.css"] + sorted(f for f in os.listdir(os.path.join(SRC, "css")) if f.endswith(".css") and f != "app.css"))
    body = read("body.html")
    fonts = read("fonts.html").strip()
    h = hashlib.sha1((css + body + "".join(read("js", *f.split("/")[1:]) for f in js_files)).encode()).hexdigest()[:8]
    ver = stamp + "-" + h

    # copy assets
    for f in js_files:
        write(os.path.join(ROOT, *f.split("/")), read("js", *f.split("/")[1:]))
    write(os.path.join(ROOT, "app.css"), css)
    write(os.path.join(ROOT, "link.html"), read("link-legacy.html"))

    scripts = "\n".join('<script src="%s?v=%s"></script>' % (f, h) for f in js_files)
    verjs = '<script>window.V60_VERSION="%s";</script>' % ver

    pwa_head = """<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>V60 Garage</title>
<meta name="description" content="A workshop, classroom and logbook for one 2016 Volvo V60 T5.">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#13232e">
<link rel="manifest" href="manifest.webmanifest">
<link rel="icon" href="icons/icon-192.png">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="icons/icon-180.png">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="V60 Garage">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="default">
%s
<link rel="stylesheet" href="app.css?v=%s">
</head>
<body>
""" % (fonts, h)
    # Update notice. Bluefy (and other iOS browsers built on WKWebView) has no service worker, so the bar must not depend
    # on one: the page also compares its own version with version.json whenever it is opened or comes back to the front.
    sw_reg = """<script>
(function () {
  var bar = document.getElementById("updateBar"), waiting = null, reloaded = false;
  function offer(w) { if (w) waiting = w; if (!bar) return; bar.hidden = false; bar.querySelector("button").onclick = refresh; }
  function refresh() {
    if (waiting) { waiting.postMessage("skip"); setTimeout(hard, 1500); return; }
    hard();
  }
  /* a fresh address skips the 10-minute browser cache GitHub Pages allows on index.html */
  function hard() { if (reloaded) return; reloaded = true; location.replace(location.pathname + "?u=" + Date.now() + location.hash); }
  try { if (/[?&]u=\\d+/.test(location.search)) history.replaceState(null, "", location.pathname + location.hash); } catch (e) {}
  /* the header's Version chip: when this copy was built, in the phone's own time; tap it to check now */
  var chip = document.getElementById("verChip");
  function when(v) {
    var m = /^(\\d{4})\\.(\\d{2})\\.(\\d{2})-(\\d{2})(\\d{2})/.exec(v || ""); if (!m) return v || "";
    var d = new Date(Date.UTC(+m[1], +m[2] - 1, +m[3], +m[4], +m[5]));
    try { return d.toLocaleString(undefined, { month: "short", day: "numeric", hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit" }); } catch (e) { return d.toString(); }
  }
  function label(t) { if (chip) chip.textContent = t; }
  var mineTxt = "Version " + when(window.V60_VERSION);
  /* Kyle's choice (2026-10-15): update by itself when the app is opened, never in the middle of something.
     "Opened" = the first seconds after loading with no tap or key yet, or coming back after 5+ minutes away.
     Never while the adapter is connected, Drive mode or the photo review is open, or a field is being typed in.
     One try per version: if the reload still serves the old page (a cache), the bar is offered instead of looping. */
  var hiddenAt = 0, opening = true;
  ["pointerdown", "keydown"].forEach(function (t) { window.addEventListener(t, function () { opening = false; }, true); });
  setTimeout(function () { opening = false; }, 12000);
  function busy() {
    var q = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); }, a = document.activeElement;
    if (q("lk-btnDisconnect") && !q("lk-btnDisconnect").disabled) return true;
    if ((q("lk-drive") && !q("lk-drive").hidden) || (q("scanOv") && !q("scanOv").hidden)) return true;
    return !!(a && /^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(a.tagName) && a.type !== "checkbox" && a.type !== "radio");
  }
  function tried(v) { try { return sessionStorage.getItem("v60-autoupd") === v; } catch (e) { return true; } }
  function autoUpdate(v) {
    if (!opening || busy() || tried(v)) return false;
    try { sessionStorage.setItem("v60-autoupd", v); } catch (e) { return false; }
    label("Updating to " + when(v) + "..."); hard(); return true;
  }
  var last = 0;
  function check(force, tell) {
    if (!/^https?:$/.test(location.protocol) || !window.V60_VERSION) return;
    var now = Date.now(); if (!force && now - last < 60000) return; last = now;
    if (tell) label("Checking...");
    fetch("version.json?t=" + now, { cache: "no-store" }).then(function (r) { return r.ok ? r.json() : null; }).then(function (j) {
      if (j && j.v && j.v !== window.V60_VERSION) { if (tell || !autoUpdate(j.v)) { offer(); label("New version ready: " + when(j.v)); } }
      else if (tell) { label("Up to date · " + when(window.V60_VERSION)); setTimeout(function () { label(mineTxt); }, 4000); }
    }).catch(function () { if (tell) { label("Could not check. Offline?"); setTimeout(function () { label(mineTxt); }, 4000); } });
  }
  window.__v60CheckUpdate = check;
  if (chip && /^https?:$/.test(location.protocol) && window.V60_VERSION) {
    label(mineTxt); chip.hidden = false;
    chip.addEventListener("click", function () { if (bar && !bar.hidden) { refresh(); return; } check(true, true); });
  }
  setTimeout(function () { check(true); }, 2000);
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", function () {
    if (document.visibilityState === "hidden") { hiddenAt = Date.now(); return; }
    if (hiddenAt && Date.now() - hiddenAt >= 5 * 60 * 1000) { opening = true; setTimeout(function () { opening = false; }, 12000); check(true); } else check();
    hiddenAt = 0;
  });
  window.addEventListener("pageshow", function (e) { if (e.persisted) check(true); });
  window.addEventListener("focus", function () { check(); });
  setInterval(function () { check(true); }, 10 * 60 * 1000);
  if ("serviceWorker" in navigator && location.protocol === "https:") {
    navigator.serviceWorker.register("sw.js").then(function (reg) {
      if (reg.waiting && navigator.serviceWorker.controller) offer(reg.waiting);
      reg.addEventListener("updatefound", function () { var w = reg.installing; w.addEventListener("statechange", function () { if (w.state === "installed" && navigator.serviceWorker.controller) offer(w); }); });
      setInterval(function () { reg.update().catch(function () {}); }, 30 * 60 * 1000);
    }).catch(function () {});
    navigator.serviceWorker.addEventListener("controllerchange", function () { if (reloaded) return; reloaded = true; location.reload(); });
  }
})();
</script>"""
    write(os.path.join(ROOT, "index.html"), pwa_head + body + "\n" + verjs + "\n" + scripts + "\n" + sw_reg + "\n</body>\n</html>\n")
    write(os.path.join(ROOT, "version.json"), json.dumps({"v": ver}) + "\n")

    shell = ["./", "index.html", "app.css", "manifest.webmanifest", "icons/icon-192.png", "icons/icon-512.png", "icons/icon-180.png"] + js_files
    sw = """/* V60 Garage service worker, version %s */
var CACHE = "v60-garage-%s";
var SHELL = %s;
self.addEventListener("install", function (e) { e.waitUntil(caches.open(CACHE).then(function (c) { return c.addAll(SHELL.map(function (u) { return new Request(u, { cache: "reload" }); })); })); });
self.addEventListener("activate", function (e) { e.waitUntil(caches.keys().then(function (ks) { return Promise.all(ks.filter(function (k) { return k !== CACHE && k.indexOf("v60-garage-") === 0; }).map(function (k) { return caches.delete(k); })); }).then(function () { return self.clients.claim(); })); });
self.addEventListener("message", function (e) { if (e.data === "skip") self.skipWaiting(); });
self.addEventListener("fetch", function (e) {
  var req = e.request; if (req.method !== "GET") return;
  var url = new URL(req.url);
  if (req.mode === "navigate") { e.respondWith(fetch(req).then(function (r) { var cp = r.clone(); caches.open(CACHE).then(function (c) { c.put("index.html", cp); }); return r; }).catch(function () { return caches.match("index.html"); })); return; }
  if (url.origin === location.origin) { e.respondWith(caches.match(req, { ignoreSearch: true }).then(function (hit) { return hit || fetch(req); })); return; }
  if (url.hostname === "cdn.jsdelivr.net" && /tesseract|pdfjs-dist/.test(url.pathname)) {
    e.respondWith(caches.open("v60-ocr").then(function (c) { return c.match(req).then(function (hit) { return hit || fetch(req).then(function (r) { if (r.ok) c.put(req, r.clone()); return r; }); }); }));
    return;
  }
  if (/fonts\\.(googleapis|gstatic)\\.com$/.test(url.hostname)) {
    e.respondWith(caches.open(CACHE + "-fonts").then(function (c) { return c.match(req).then(function (hit) { var net = fetch(req).then(function (r) { c.put(req, r.clone()); return r; }).catch(function () { return hit; }); return hit || net; }); }));
  }
});
""" % (ver, ver, json.dumps(shell))
    write(os.path.join(ROOT, "sw.js"), sw)

    manifest = {
        "name": "V60 Garage", "short_name": "V60 Garage", "start_url": "./", "scope": "./", "display": "standalone",
        "background_color": "#edf1f4", "theme_color": "#13232e", "description": "A workshop, classroom and logbook for one 2016 Volvo V60 T5.",
        "icons": [{"src": "icons/icon-192.png", "sizes": "192x192", "type": "image/png"}, {"src": "icons/icon-512.png", "sizes": "512x512", "type": "image/png"}, {"src": "icons/icon-512.png", "sizes": "512x512", "type": "image/png", "purpose": "maskable"}],
    }
    write(os.path.join(ROOT, "manifest.webmanifest"), json.dumps(manifest, indent=2))

    # artifact variant: title first, no doctype, same relative assets
    art = os.path.join(ROOT, "dist-artifact")
    if os.path.isdir(art): shutil.rmtree(art)
    write(os.path.join(art, "garage.html"), "<title>V60 Garage</title>\n" + fonts + '\n<link rel="stylesheet" href="app.css">\n' + body + "\n" + verjs + "\n" + "\n".join('<script src="%s"></script>' % f for f in js_files) + "\n")
    write(os.path.join(art, "app.css"), css)
    files = {"app.css": "dist-artifact/app.css"}
    for f in js_files:
        write(os.path.join(art, *f.split("/")), read("js", *f.split("/")[1:]))
        files[f] = "dist-artifact/" + f
    write(os.path.join(art, "files.json"), json.dumps(files, indent=1))
    print("built", ver, "modules:", ", ".join(mods), "data:", ", ".join(DATA))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

### `tools/handoff.py`

````python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate HANDOFF.md: a single, complete Markdown package of the V60 Garage project for another AI (Claude <-> Gemini).

Usage: python3 tools/handoff.py [output_path]      (default: HANDOFF.md in the repo root, gitignored)

Sections 1-3 come from docs/HANDOFF_STATE.md (update it before running). Section 4 is every source file, written
out by this script byte for byte, so nothing can be truncated. Build outputs (root index.html, js/, dist-artifact/,
link.html, sw.js) are left out on purpose: tools/build.py regenerates them from src/, and including both copies
invites edits to the wrong one.
"""
import base64, datetime, hashlib, os, re, subprocess, sys

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
TEXT_DIRS = ["src", "tools", "tests", "docs", ".github"]
TEXT_TOP = ["CLAUDE.md", "README.md", ".gitignore", ".nojekyll"]
BINARY = ["icons/icon-180.png", "icons/icon-192.png", "icons/icon-512.png"]
LANG = {".js": "javascript", ".css": "css", ".html": "html", ".py": "python", ".md": "markdown", ".yml": "yaml", ".json": "json"}

def sh(*a):
    try: return subprocess.check_output(a, cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip()
    except Exception: return "unknown"

def files():
    out = []
    for top in TEXT_TOP:
        if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(ROOT, top)): out.append(top)
    for d in TEXT_DIRS:
        for base, dirs, fs in os.walk(os.path.join(ROOT, d)):
            dirs[:] = sorted(x for x in dirs if x not in ("shots", "__pycache__", "node_modules"))
            for f in sorted(fs):
                p = os.path.relpath(os.path.join(base, f), ROOT).replace(os.sep, "/")
                if p == "docs/HANDOFF_STATE.md": continue  # already inlined as sections 1-3
                out.append(p)
    return out

def fence_for(text):
    longest = max([len(m) for m in re.findall(r"`+", text)] + [2])
    return "`" * max(3, longest + 1)

def main():
    dest = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else os.path.join(ROOT, "HANDOFF.md")
    state = open(os.path.join(ROOT, "docs", "HANDOFF_STATE.md"), encoding="utf-8").read().strip()
    fl = files()
    rows, blocks, total = [], [], 0
    extra_bins = []
    for p in fl:
        data = open(os.path.join(ROOT, p), "rb").read()
        try:
            text = data.decode("utf-8")
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            extra_bins.append(p)  # a binary under a text folder (a PDF test fixture, say) goes out as base64 below
            continue
        total += len(data)
        rows.append("| `%s` | %d | %d | `%s` |" % (p, text.count("\n") + (0 if text.endswith("\n") or not text else 1), len(data), hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()[:12]))
        f = fence_for(text)
        blocks.append("### `%s`\n\n%s%s\n%s%s%s\n" % (p, f, LANG.get(os.path.splitext(p)[1], ""), text, "" if text.endswith("\n") or not text else "\n", f))
    bins = []
    for p in BINARY + extra_bins:
        fp = os.path.join(ROOT, p)
        if not os.path.isfile(fp): continue
        data = open(fp, "rb").read()
        rows.append("| `%s` (binary, base64) | - | %d | `%s` |" % (p, len(data), hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()[:12]))
        bins.append("### `%s` (base64)\n\n```base64\n%s\n```\n" % (p, "\n".join(re.findall(".{1,100}", base64.b64encode(data).decode()))))
    now = datetime.datetime.now().astimezone().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z")
    doc = """# V60 Garage — Handoff Package

Generated %s from commit `%s` (%s). Version live at that commit: `%s`.

- Repo (source of truth): https://github.com/bmcdoorz94/V60-Link (branch `main`)
- Live app: https://bmcdoorz94.github.io/V60-Link/
- Files in section 4: %d text files and %d binary files, %s bytes of text. Each file has a SHA-256 prefix in the manifest so the receiver can confirm it is complete.

## 0. Rules for the receiving AI
1. Read `CLAUDE.md` in section 4 first. It holds the project rules: sourcing, accuracy, file layout, UI conventions and the privacy rule (never write the VIN, plate or chassis number into any file).
2. Kyle directs the work and does not write code. Explain changes in plain words, ask him clarifying questions before or while working, and cite real sources for any car fact.
3. Edit only source files: `src/`, `tools/`, `tests/`, `docs/`, `CLAUDE.md`. The live site's `index.html`, `js/`, `sw.js` and `dist-artifact/` are generated by `python3 tools/build.py`. A GitHub Action (`.github/workflows/build.yml`) runs that build automatically when `src/` or `tools/` change on `main`.
4. `src/js/modules/live.js` is generated by `python3 tools/gen/mklive.py` from `tools/gen/live_extra.js` and `src/link-legacy.html`. Edit those, not live.js.
5. New features go in a new file in `src/js/modules/` (see the module contract in CLAUDE.md), added to `MODULES` in `tools/build.py`.

## Return format (when handing back)
Produce one Markdown file containing:
- Updated sections 1, 2 and 3 using the same headings.
- Under `## 4. Complete Codebase`, every file you created or changed, each as `### \\`path/from/repo/root\\`` followed by one fenced code block with the **entire** file. Never truncate, never write "unchanged" or "rest of file", never use placeholders.
- Files you did not touch may be left out of a return package. `tools/apply_handoff.py` overlays the files present onto the repo. To delete a file, list it under `## Deleted files` as a bullet with its path in backticks.
- If a full copy of a very large file (such as `src/js/core.js`) will not fit in your output, do not send a partial file. Instead list exact find-and-replace edits under `## Edits to apply` (file, exact old text, exact new text).

%s

## 4. Complete Codebase

### Manifest

| File | Lines | Bytes | SHA-256 (first 12) |
|---|---|---|---|
%s

%s
### Binary files

These are the app icons, unchanged unless noted. `tools/apply_handoff.py` decodes them.

%s
""" % (now, sh("git", "rev-parse", "--short", "HEAD"), sh("git", "log", "-1", "--format=%cs %s"), version(), len(fl), len(bins), format(total, ","), state, "\n".join(rows), "\n".join(blocks), "\n".join(bins))
    with open(dest, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as fh: fh.write(doc)
    print("wrote", dest, format(len(doc.encode()), ","), "bytes,", len(fl), "text files,", len(bins), "binary")

def version():
    try:
        m = re.search(r'V60_VERSION="([^"]+)"', open(os.path.join(ROOT, "index.html"), encoding="utf-8").read())
        return m.group(1) if m else "unknown"
    except Exception: return "unknown"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
````

### `tools/gen/cipher.py`

```python
"""Cipher hooks for Live link: raw adapter labels stay raw until decoded in the Codebook (story.js owns window.V60_CB).
Applied by mklive.py to the legacy V60 Link script. Each replacement must match exactly once."""

PAIRS = [
    ('"> " + esc(p.n) + (ok ? "" : " (not supported)") + "</label>";',
     '"> " + cbl("pid:" + hex2(p.pid), p.n) + (ok ? "" : " (not supported)") + "</label>";'),
    ("'<div class=\"tile\"><div class=\"k\">' + esc(p.n) + '</div>",
     "'<div class=\"tile\"><div class=\"k\">' + cbl(\"pid:\" + hex2(p.pid), p.n) + '</div>"),
    ("\"<div><span>\" + esc(m.n) + '</span>",
     "\"<div><span>\" + cbl(\"mon:\" + m.n, m.n) + '</span>"),
    ("esc(CODE_HINTS[c.code] || \"Look this code up in V60 Garage's Diagnose tab.\")",
     "(window.V60_CB ? window.V60_CB.codeHint(c.code, CODE_HINTS[c.code] || \"Look this code up in V60 Garage's Diagnose tab.\") : esc(CODE_HINTS[c.code] || \"Look this code up in V60 Garage's Diagnose tab.\"))"),
    ("  function hex2(n) {",
     "  function cbl(k, name) { return window.V60_CB ? window.V60_CB.label(k, name) : esc(name); }\n  function hex2(n) {"),
]

def apply(s):
    for old, new in PAIRS:
        n = s.count(old)
        if n != 1:
            raise SystemExit("cipher hook did not match exactly once (%d): %s" % (n, old[:70]))
        s = s.replace(old, new)
    return s
```

### `tools/gen/g1merge.py`

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Merge researched G1 study entries (JSON arrays from the research briefs) into src/js/data/g1entries.js.
   python3 tools/gen/g1merge.py entries1.json entries2.json ...
Each file holds a JSON array of {id, body[], car, src[[title,url]], qs[{q,o[4],a,why,src[title,url]}]}.
Checks every entry: the id exists in g1tasks.js, every source is https and not from a banned domain, every question has four
options and a valid answer index. Bad entries are reported and skipped; good ones replace what is in the file."""
import json, os, re, sys

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
TASKS = os.path.join(ROOT, "src", "js", "data", "g1tasks.js")
ENTRIES = os.path.join(ROOT, "src", "js", "data", "g1entries.js")
BANNED = ("wikipedia.org", "reddit.com", "youtube.com", "youtu.be", "quora.com", "facebook.com", "swedespeed", "volvoforums", "matthewsvolvosite",
          "carsdirect", "carparts.com/blog", "repairsmith", "yourmechanic", "mechanicbase", "autozone.com/diy", "wikihow", "ehow", "quizlet", "studocu",
          "ase-practice", "practicetestgeeks", "open-exam-prep", "careeremployer", "study.com")

HEAD = """/* Study entries for the G1 task list (data/g1tasks.js), written area by area from fetched sources only.
   V60_G1_ENTRIES[taskId] = { body: [lines], car: "how it applies to the V60" | null, src: [[title, url], ...],
     qs: [{ q, o: [4 options], a: index, why, src: [title, url] }, ...] }
   A task with no entry yet shows "No sourced entry yet" in the app. Never write an entry from memory: fetch the source first.
   Merge researched entries with tools/gen/g1merge.py; it validates ids, sources and questions. */
window.V60_G1_ENTRIES = """

def load_js_object(path, prefix):
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        s = f.read()
    i = s.index(prefix) + len(prefix)
    j = s.rindex("}") + 1
    return json.loads(s[i:j])

def task_ids():
    with open(TASKS, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        s = f.read()
    return set(re.findall(r'\{ id: "([A-G]\d+)"', s))

def check_src(src, where, errs):
    if not isinstance(src, list) or len(src) != 2 or not all(isinstance(x, str) for x in src):
        errs.append(where + ": source must be [title, url]"); return False
    t, u = src
    if not u.startswith("https://") and not u.startswith("http://"):
        errs.append(where + ": not a URL: " + u); return False
    if any(b in u.lower() for b in BANNED):
        errs.append(where + ": banned source " + u); return False
    if not t.strip():
        errs.append(where + ": empty source title"); return False
    return True

def validate(e, ids):
    errs = []
    tid = e.get("id")
    if tid not in ids:
        return ["unknown task id " + str(tid)]
    body = e.get("body")
    if not isinstance(body, list) or not body or not all(isinstance(l, str) and l.strip() for l in body):
        errs.append(tid + ": body must be a non-empty list of lines")
    car = e.get("car")
    if car is not None and not isinstance(car, str):
        errs.append(tid + ": car must be a string or null")
    srcs = e.get("src") or []
    if not isinstance(srcs, list) or not srcs:
        errs.append(tid + ": no sources")
    else:
        for s in srcs:
            check_src(s, tid, errs)
    qs = e.get("qs") or []
    good_qs = []
    for n, q in enumerate(qs):
        where = tid + " q" + str(n + 1)
        if not isinstance(q, dict) or not isinstance(q.get("q"), str) or not q["q"].strip():
            errs.append(where + ": no question text"); continue
        o = q.get("o")
        if not isinstance(o, list) or len(o) != 4 or not all(isinstance(x, str) and x.strip() for x in o):
            errs.append(where + ": needs exactly four options"); continue
        if len(set(x.strip().lower() for x in o)) != 4:
            errs.append(where + ": duplicate options"); continue
        a = q.get("a")
        if not isinstance(a, int) or a < 0 or a > 3:
            errs.append(where + ": answer index must be 0-3"); continue
        if not isinstance(q.get("why"), str) or not q["why"].strip():
            errs.append(where + ": no explanation"); continue
        if not check_src(q.get("src"), where, errs):
            continue
        good_qs.append({"q": q["q"].strip(), "o": [x.strip() for x in o], "a": a, "why": q["why"].strip(), "src": [q["src"][0].strip(), q["src"][1].strip()]})
    return errs, good_qs

def main(files):
    ids = task_ids()
    current = load_js_object(ENTRIES, "window.V60_G1_ENTRIES = ")
    added, skipped, report = 0, 0, []
    for path in files:
        with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
            raw = f.read()
        # tolerate a code fence or stray text around the array
        m = re.search(r"\[\s*\{.*\}\s*\]", raw, re.S)
        if not m:
            report.append(path + ": no JSON array found"); continue
        try:
            arr = json.loads(m.group(0))
        except json.JSONDecodeError as ex:
            report.append(path + ": bad JSON: " + str(ex)); continue
        for e in arr:
            res = validate(e, ids)
            if isinstance(res, list):
                report.extend(res); skipped += 1; continue
            errs, good_qs = res
            hard = [x for x in errs if " q" not in x]
            if hard:
                report.extend(hard); skipped += 1; continue
            report.extend(errs)  # question-level problems: the question is dropped, the entry stays
            current[e["id"]] = {"body": [l.strip() for l in e["body"]], "car": (e.get("car") or None), "src": [[s[0].strip(), s[1].strip()] for s in e["src"]], "qs": good_qs}
            added += 1
    ordered = {k: current[k] for k in sorted(current, key=lambda k: (k[0], int(k[1:])))}
    with open(ENTRIES, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as f:
        f.write(HEAD + json.dumps(ordered, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1) + ";\n")
    nq = sum(len(v["qs"]) for v in ordered.values())
    print("entries: %d merged, %d skipped; file now holds %d entries, %d questions" % (added, skipped, len(ordered), nq))
    for r in report:
        print(" ! " + r)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print(__doc__); sys.exit(2)
    main(sys.argv[1:])
```

### `tools/gen/live_extra.js`

```javascript
/* Live link over a mocked Web Bluetooth adapter: the first link drops right after notifications start
   (as the OBDLink CX can while iOS finishes pairing); connect() must retry once and then talk to the car. */
const { chromium } = require(process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_PATH || 'playwright');
const path = require('path'); const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
function ok(c, m) { if (!c) { console.log('FAIL', m); process.exitCode = 1; } else console.log(' ok', m); }
(async () => {
  const b = await chromium.launch(process.env.CHROMIUM_PATH ? { executablePath: process.env.CHROMIUM_PATH } : {});
  for (const mode of ['drop-once', 'drop-always', 'drop-after-atz']) {
    const ctx = await b.newContext({ viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 } });
    await ctx.addInitScript(m => {
      window.__V60_TEST = true;
      let connects = 0;
      const enc = new TextEncoder(), dec = new TextDecoder();
      function makeDevice() {
        const dev = new EventTarget(); dev.name = 'OBDLink CX';
        const gatt = { connected: false };
        let notify = null;
        const rx = { uuid: '0000fff1-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb', properties: { notify: true }, addEventListener: (t, f) => { notify = f; }, startNotifications: () => {
          if (m === 'drop-always' || (m === 'drop-once' && connects === 1)) setTimeout(() => { gatt.connected = false; dev.dispatchEvent(new Event('gattserverdisconnected')); }, 30);
          return Promise.resolve(); } };
        /* live values like Kyle's car at idle on 2026-10-15: 915 rpm, 5 km/h, coolant 83 °C, long-term trim +14.8 %, 14.3 V */
        const LIVE = { '010C': '7E8 04 41 0C 0E 4C', '010D': '7E8 03 41 0D 05', '0105': '7E8 03 41 05 7B', '0107': '7E8 03 41 07 93', '0142': '7E8 04 41 42 37 DC', '0120': '7E8 06 41 20 00 00 00 01', '0140': '7E8 06 41 40 40 00 00 00' };
        const reply = cmd => {
          if (/^0100/.test(cmd)) return '7E8 06 41 00 BE 3F A8 13 00\r\r>';
          if (/^ATDPN/.test(cmd)) return 'A6\r\r>';
          if (LIVE[cmd.slice(0, 4)]) return LIVE[cmd.slice(0, 4)] + '\r\r>';
          if (/^01/.test(cmd)) return 'NO DATA\r\r>';
          return 'OK\r\r>';
        };
        const tx = { uuid: '0000fff2-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb', properties: { write: true, writeWithoutResponse: true }, writeValue: v => send(v), writeValueWithResponse: v => send(v) };
        let buf = '';
        function send(v) {
          if (!gatt.connected) { const e = new Error('GATT Server is disconnected.'); e.name = 'NetworkError'; return Promise.reject(e); }
          buf += dec.decode(v); if (buf.indexOf('\r') >= 0) { const c = buf.trim(); buf = ''; if (m === 'drop-after-atz' && c === 'ATZ') { setTimeout(() => { gatt.connected = false; dev.dispatchEvent(new Event('gattserverdisconnected')); }, 10); return Promise.resolve(); } setTimeout(() => notify && notify({ target: { value: new DataView(enc.encode(reply(c)).buffer) } }), 5); }
          return Promise.resolve();
        }
        const svc = { uuid: '0000FFF0-0000-1000-8000-00805F9B34FB', getCharacteristics: () => Promise.resolve([rx, tx]) };
        /* the CX also exposes a firmware-update service (FEF5) whose characteristics notify and write but never answer; Bluefy lists it first */
        const dead = { uuid: '0000FEF5-0000-1000-8000-00805F9B34FB', getCharacteristics: () => Promise.resolve([
          { uuid: '5F78DF94-798C-46F5-990A-B3EB6A065C88', properties: { notify: true, read: true }, addEventListener: () => {}, startNotifications: () => Promise.resolve() },
          { uuid: '8082CAA8-41A6-4021-91C6-56F9B954CC34', properties: { write: true }, writeValue: () => Promise.reject(new Error('')), writeValueWithResponse: () => Promise.reject(new Error('')) }]) };
        const info = { uuid: '0000180A-0000-1000-8000-00805F9B34FB', getCharacteristics: () => Promise.resolve([{ uuid: '00002A29-0000-1000-8000-00805F9B34FB', properties: { read: true } }]) };
        gatt.connect = () => { connects++; gatt.connected = true; return Promise.resolve({ getPrimaryServices: () => Promise.resolve([dead, info, svc]) }); };
        gatt.disconnect = () => { gatt.connected = false; };
        dev.gatt = gatt; return dev;
      }
      Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'bluetooth', { value: { requestDevice: () => Promise.resolve(makeDevice()), getAvailability: () => Promise.resolve(true) } });
      window.__connects = () => connects;
    }, mode);
    const p = await ctx.newPage(); const errs = []; p.on('pageerror', e => errs.push(e.message));
    await p.goto('file://' + ROOT + '/index.html'); await p.waitForTimeout(400);
    await p.evaluate(() => __v60.go('live'));
    await p.click('#lk-btnConnect');
    if (mode === 'drop-once') {
      await p.waitForFunction(() => /Connected to/.test(document.getElementById('lk-connText').textContent), null, { timeout: 30000 }).catch(() => {});
      const txt = await p.textContent('#lk-connText'), log = await p.inputValue('#lk-log');
      ok(/Connected to OBDLink CX/.test(txt), 'drop right after connecting: retried and connected (' + txt + ')');
      ok(/retrying once/.test(log) && /GATT reconnected/.test(log), 'log shows the drop and the retry');
      ok(/using known service fff0: notify fff1, write fff2/.test(log) && /service fef5:/.test(log), 'picked the CX serial service over the firmware-update one, whatever the letter case: ' + (log.match(/using [^\n]*/) || [''])[0]);
      ok(await p.evaluate(() => window.__connects()) === 2, 'reconnected without a second picker');
      /* the dashboard has its own start button and its gauges fill with the car's numbers */
      ok(await p.evaluate(() => { const g = document.getElementById('lk-dashGo'); return !g.disabled && /Start gauges/.test(g.textContent); }), 'Start gauges is ready once connected');
      await p.click('#lk-dashGo');
      const dials = await p.waitForFunction(() => { const v = id => (document.getElementById('lk-dv-' + id) || {}).textContent; return /\d/.test(v('rpm')) && /\d/.test(v('cool')) && /\d/.test(v('ltft')) ? { rpm: v('rpm'), spd: v('spd'), cool: v('cool'), volt: v('volt'), ltft: v('ltft') } : null; }, null, { timeout: 15000 }).then(h => h.jsonValue()).catch(() => null);
      ok(dials && dials.rpm === '920' && dials.cool === '181' && dials.ltft === '+14.8' && dials.spd === '3', 'gauges show the car: ' + JSON.stringify(dials));
      ok(/Stop gauges/.test(await p.textContent('#lk-dashGo')) && /Stop recording/.test(await p.textContent('#lk-btnLive')), 'Dashboard and Live data agree that it is reading');
      await p.click('#lk-dashGo'); await p.waitForTimeout(300);
      ok(/Start gauges/.test(await p.textContent('#lk-dashGo')) && /Start recording/.test(await p.textContent('#lk-btnLive')), 'Stop gauges stops the reading');
      /* drive mode opens for everyone, starts the gauges itself, and stops them on exit */
      await p.click('#lk-driveBtn');
      ok(await p.isVisible('#lk-drive'), 'Drive mode opens (no skill needed)');
      const big = await p.waitForFunction(() => { const v = id => document.getElementById('lk-dv2-' + id).textContent; return /\d/.test(v('rpm')) && /\d/.test(v('spd')) ? { spd: v('spd'), rpm: v('rpm'), cool: v('cool'), volt: v('volt') } : null; }, null, { timeout: 15000 }).then(h => h.jsonValue()).catch(() => null);
      ok(big && big.rpm === '920' && big.spd === '3' && big.cool === '181' && big.volt === '14.3', 'Drive mode fills its big numbers by itself: ' + JSON.stringify(big));
      await p.click('#lk-driveX'); await p.waitForTimeout(300);
      ok(!(await p.isVisible('#lk-drive')) && /Start recording/.test(await p.textContent('#lk-btnLive')), 'leaving Drive mode stops the reading it started');
    } else if (mode === 'drop-after-atz') {
      const t0 = Date.now();
      await p.waitForFunction(() => /Connected to/.test(document.getElementById('lk-connText').textContent), null, { timeout: 30000 }).catch(() => {});
      const txt = await p.textContent('#lk-connText'), log = await p.inputValue('#lk-log');
      ok(/Connected to OBDLink CX/.test(txt), 'drop after the ATZ reset: retried with a warm start and connected (' + txt + ')');
      ok(/last command sent: ATZ/.test(log) && /ATWS/.test(log), 'log names the command before the drop and the warm start'); if (!/last command sent: ATZ/.test(log)) console.log(log);
      ok(Date.now() - t0 < 5000, 'no 6-second wait for a reply that cannot come (' + (Date.now() - t0) + ' ms)');
    } else {
      await p.waitForFunction(() => /Close the OBDLink|answered but|permission|pair with/i.test(document.getElementById('lk-connText').textContent), null, { timeout: 40000 }).catch(() => {});
      const txt = await p.textContent('#lk-connText');
      ok(/Close the OBDLink app/.test(txt), 'keeps dropping: plain advice shown (' + txt + ')'); if (!/Close the OBDLink/.test(txt)) console.log(await p.inputValue('#lk-log'));
      ok(!(await p.evaluate(() => document.getElementById('lk-connFail').hidden)), 'copy-the-log button shown after the failure');
      ok(await p.evaluate(() => document.getElementById('lk-dashGo').disabled), 'Start gauges stays off while not connected');
      await p.click('#lk-driveBtn');
      ok(await p.isVisible('#lk-drive') && /Not connected/.test(await p.textContent('#lk-dvMsg')), 'Drive mode without a connection says so on the big screen');
      await p.click('#lk-driveX');
      await p.reload(); await p.waitForTimeout(600); await p.evaluate(() => __v60.go('live'));
      const kept = await p.inputValue('#lk-log');
      ok(/connect failed/.test(kept) && /page loaded/.test(kept), 'adapter log survives a reload');
    }
    ok(errs.length === 0, 'no page errors ' + JSON.stringify(errs));
    await ctx.close();
  }
  await b.close();
})();
```

```javascript
/* Documents: three PDFs (inspection report, receipt, insurance card) go in, are sorted and read, the owner files them,
   and the right places fill in. Needs jsDelivr reachable (pdf.js is loaded from it). */
const { chromium } = require(process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_PATH || 'playwright');
const path = require('path'), fs = require('fs');
const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..'), SH = path.join(ROOT, 'tests', 'shots') + '/'; fs.mkdirSync(SH, { recursive: true });
const FX = (n) => path.join(ROOT, 'tests', 'fixtures', n);
function ok(c, m) { if (!c) { console.log('FAIL', m); process.exitCode = 1; } else console.log(' ok', m); }
(async () => {
  const b = await chromium.launch(process.env.CHROMIUM_PATH ? { executablePath: process.env.CHROMIUM_PATH } : {});
  const ctx = await b.newContext({ viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 } });
  await ctx.addInitScript(() => { window.__V60_TEST = true; });
  const p = await ctx.newPage(); const errs = [];
  p.on('pageerror', e => errs.push('PE ' + e.message)); p.on('console', m => { if (m.type() === 'error') errs.push(m.text()); });
  await p.goto('file://' + ROOT + '/index.html'); await p.waitForTimeout(500);
  await p.evaluate(() => { const s = V60.mod('story'); s.all = true; V60.setMod('story', s); V60.save(); __v60.go('glove'); });
  ok(await p.isVisible('#dcGloveCard'), 'Glovebox shows the Documents card');

  await p.setInputFiles('#dcFile', [FX('inspection.pdf'), FX('receipt.pdf'), FX('insurance.pdf')]);
  await p.waitForFunction(() => /read/.test(document.getElementById('dcStatus').textContent) && document.querySelectorAll('.dc-rev').length === 3, null, { timeout: 60000 });
  await p.screenshot({ path: SH + 'docs-review.png', fullPage: true });

  const v = (sel) => p.inputValue(sel);
  ok(await v('#dcF0date') === '2026-05-16' && await v('#dcF0miles') === '89617' && await v('#dcF0result') === 'pass' && /SAMPLE LUBE/.test(await v('#dcF0station')) && await v('#dcF0codes') === 'P0455', 'inspection fields read: date, odometer, result, station, code');
  ok(await v('#dcF1date') === '2026-09-02' && await v('#dcF1miles') === '94210' && await v('#dcF1total') === '171.82' && /SAMPLE AUTO/.test(await v('#dcF1shop')), 'receipt fields read: date, odometer, total, shop');
  ok(await v('#dcF2expires') === '2026-10-01', 'insurance expiry read: ' + await v('#dcF2expires'));
  const ex = await p.evaluate(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('.dc-rev .dc-ex')].map(x => x.textContent).join('\n'));
  ok(ex.indexOf('1HGBH41JXMN109186') < 0 && ex.indexOf('ABC1234') < 0 && ex.indexOf('555-0100') < 0 && ex.indexOf('Jane') < 0, 'VIN, plate, phone and name are blacked out of what is kept');
  ok(/Pass/.test(ex) && /P0455/.test(ex), 'the useful text stays readable');
  // file the inspection
  await p.click('[data-dcfile="0"]'); await p.waitForTimeout(200);
  const g = await p.evaluate(() => V60.mod('glove').docs);
  ok(g.inspDue === '2027-05-16', 'inspection filed: next emissions test due ' + g.inspDue);
  ok(await p.evaluate(() => V60.state.odo) >= 89617, 'odometer bumped from the inspection');
  // file the insurance (now index 1)
  await p.click('[data-dcfile="1"]'); await p.waitForTimeout(200);
  ok((await p.evaluate(() => V60.mod('glove').docs)).insRenew === '2026-10-01', 'insurance filed: renewal date set');

  console.log(' errs', errs); if (errs.length) process.exitCode = 1;
  await ctx.close(); await b.close();
})();
```
