### `tests/engine.js`

```javascript
// Preloaded by tests/run.js (node -r). With V60_ENGINE=webkit, every test's `chromium` becomes WebKit
// dressed as an iPhone (Safari user agent, touch, 3x screen), because Bluefy on iOS runs on WebKit.
// Each test keeps its own viewport and colour scheme, and its screenshots get an "-iphone" suffix.
// WebKit blocks some requests from file:// pages (never the case on GitHub Pages), so the repo is served
// at http://127.0.0.1 and file:// URLs given to page.goto are rewritten to it. Service workers stay off,
// as they are in the Chromium runs. With no V60_ENGINE the tests run unchanged.
const Module = require('module');
if (process.env.V60_ENGINE === 'webkit') {
  const http = require('http'), fs = require('fs'), path = require('path');
  const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
  const TYPES = { '.html': 'text/html', '.js': 'text/javascript', '.css': 'text/css', '.json': 'application/json', '.webmanifest': 'application/manifest+json', '.png': 'image/png', '.jpg': 'image/jpeg', '.svg': 'image/svg+xml', '.pdf': 'application/pdf' };
  const server = http.createServer((q, r) => {
    const f = path.join(ROOT, decodeURIComponent(q.url.split('?')[0]));
    if (!f.startsWith(ROOT)) { r.writeHead(403); return r.end(); }
    fs.readFile(f, (e, d) => {
      if (e) { r.writeHead(404); return r.end(); }
      r.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': TYPES[path.extname(f)] || 'application/octet-stream' }); r.end(d);
    });
  }).listen(0, '127.0.0.1');
  server.unref();
  // the tests build 'file://' + ROOT + '/index.html', which on Windows is file://C:\...\index.html
  const toHttp = (u) => {
    if (typeof u !== 'string' || !u.startsWith('file://')) return u;
    const f = path.resolve(decodeURIComponent(u.slice(7).replace(/^\/(?=[a-z]:)/i, '')));
    const rel = path.relative(ROOT, f);
    return rel.startsWith('..') ? u : 'http://127.0.0.1:' + server.address().port + '/' + rel.split(path.sep).join('/');
  };

  const load = Module._load;
  Module._load = function (req) {
    const pw = load.apply(this, arguments);
    if (!/(^|[\\/])playwright$/.test(req) || !pw.webkit) return pw;
    const { viewport, ...phone } = pw.devices['iPhone 13'];
    // Each context is a persistent profile in a temp folder, like Safari or Bluefy on the phone. WebKit's
    // throwaway (private) contexts refuse to store Blobs in IndexedDB, which would fail every photo test.
    const os = require('os');
    const chromium = {
      ...pw.chromium,
      launch: async () => {
        const open = [];
        const b = {
          newContext: async (o = {}) => {
            const dir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'v60-webkit-'));
            const c = await pw.webkit.launchPersistentContext(dir, { ...phone, serviceWorkers: 'block', ...o, viewport: o.viewport || viewport });
            open.push([c, dir]);
            c.on('page', (p) => {
              const goto = p.goto.bind(p), shot = p.screenshot.bind(p);
              p.goto = (u, ...a) => goto(toHttp(u), ...a);
              p.screenshot = (s = {}) => shot(s.path ? { ...s, path: s.path.replace(/\.png$/, '-iphone.png') } : s);
            });
            const close = c.close.bind(c);
            c.close = async () => { await close(); fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }); };
            return c;
          },
          newPage: async (o) => (await b.newContext(o)).newPage(),
          close: async () => { for (const [c] of open.splice(0)) await c.close().catch(() => {}); },
        };
        return b;
      },
    };
    return { ...pw, chromium };
  };
}
```

### `tests/figshot.js`

```javascript
/* Screenshots of every view's figure (light and dark) into tests/shots/fig-<view>-<scheme>.png, for checking drawings.
   Not a pass/fail test: run it directly, node tests/figshot.js [view ...]. */
const { chromium } = require(process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_PATH || 'playwright');
const path = require('path'), fs = require('fs'); const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..'); const SH = path.join(ROOT, 'tests', 'shots'); fs.mkdirSync(SH, { recursive: true });
const want = process.argv.slice(2);
(async () => {
  const b = await chromium.launch(process.env.CHROMIUM_PATH ? { executablePath: process.env.CHROMIUM_PATH } : {});
  for (const scheme of ['light', 'dark']) {
    const ctx = await b.newContext({ viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 }, colorScheme: scheme, deviceScaleFactor: 2 }); await ctx.addInitScript(() => { window.__V60_TEST = true; });
    const p = await ctx.newPage(); await p.goto('file://' + ROOT + '/index.html'); await p.waitForTimeout(500);
    const views = await p.evaluate(() => V60_MANUAL.data.views.map(v => v.id));
    for (const v of views.filter(v => !want.length || want.includes(v))) {
      await p.evaluate(v => { V60.state.showAll = true; V60_MANUAL.go('view', v); }, v); await p.waitForTimeout(150);
      const fig = await p.$('#mnView .mn-figwrap'); if (fig) await fig.screenshot({ path: path.join(SH, 'fig-' + v + '-' + scheme + '.png') });
    }
    if (!want.length || want.includes('engine')) { /* the Engine bay explorer in core.js */
      await p.setViewportSize({ width: 390, height: 1600 }); /* keep the bottom bar clear of the map */
      await p.evaluate(() => __v60.go('engine')); await p.waitForTimeout(150);
      const st = await p.$('#ebStage'); if (st) await st.screenshot({ path: path.join(SH, 'fig-engine-' + scheme + '.png') });
    }
    await ctx.close();
  }
  await b.close();
})();
```

### `tests/guide.js`

```javascript
/* Guided mode (since the path, 2026-10-15, opened from code only: the path's Next card is the way forward): walkthrough, at-the-car question, safety check, I'm stuck ladder, levels rising and the
   "Keep guiding me" undo, unprompted proof, tab intros and the welcome-back recap. */
const { chromium } = require(process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_PATH || 'playwright');
const path = require('path'), fs = require('fs'); const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..'); const SH = path.join(ROOT, 'tests', 'shots') + '/'; fs.mkdirSync(SH, { recursive: true });
function ok(c, m) { if (!c) { console.log('FAIL', m); process.exitCode = 1; } else console.log(' ok', m); }
(async () => {
  const b = await chromium.launch(process.env.CHROMIUM_PATH ? { executablePath: process.env.CHROMIUM_PATH } : {});
  for (const [nm, vp, sch] of [['phone', { width: 390, height: 844 }, 'light'], ['dark', { width: 390, height: 844 }, 'dark']]) {
    console.log(nm);
    const ctx = await b.newContext({ viewport: vp, colorScheme: sch }); await ctx.addInitScript(() => { window.__V60_TEST = true; });
    const p = await ctx.newPage(); const errs = []; p.on('pageerror', e => errs.push('PE ' + e.message)); p.on('console', m => { if (m.type() === 'error') errs.push(m.text()); });
    await p.goto('file://' + ROOT + '/index.html'); await p.waitForTimeout(500);
    const h2 = () => p.textContent('#gwH');
    await p.evaluate(() => __v60.go('story'));
    ok(/your path/.test(await p.textContent('#stV-cases .nextc')) && !(await p.$('#stV-cases .nextc [data-guide]')), 'the case board points at the path instead of its own next objective');
    ok(await p.isHidden('#guideBtn'), 'no Guide me button in the header');
    await p.evaluate(() => V60_GUIDE.start(null));
    ok(/at the car/.test(await h2()), 'asks whether you are at the car');
    await p.click('[data-gw="car-no"]');
    ok(/four jobs/.test(await h2()), 'first step: ' + await h2());
    await p.screenshot({ path: SH + 'g-step-' + nm + '.png' });
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) await p.click('[data-gw="stuck"]');
    ok(await p.locator('.gwstuck').count() === 1 && await p.locator('[data-gw="risk"]').count() === 1, 'stuck ladder: hint, lesson, then known risk');
    await p.click('.gwbig [data-gw="go"]');
    ok(await p.isHidden('#gwOv') && await p.isVisible('#gwPill'), 'lesson opens with a pill back to the walkthrough');
    ok(/Back to the case/.test(await p.textContent('#p-academy')), 'lesson knows which case it serves');
    await p.evaluate(() => { const A = V60.acad(); A.done['m-sys'] = { date: '2026-10-11', outcome: 'good' }; V60.save(); V60.renderAll(); });
    ok(/Step done/.test(await p.textContent('#gwPill')), 'pill says the step is done');
    await p.click('#gwPill');
    ok(/safety rules/.test(await h2()) && await p.locator('.gwprev').count() === 1, 'next step, with the finished one acknowledged');
    await p.evaluate(() => { const A = V60.acad(); A.done['m-safe'] = { date: '2026-10-11', outcome: 'good' }; V60.save(); V60.renderAll(); });
    await p.click('[data-gw="close"]');
    await p.evaluate(() => V60_GUIDE.start(null));
    ok(/box can and can't hear/.test(await h2()), 'not at the car: skips car steps (' + await h2() + ')');
    ok(await p.evaluate(() => V60.mod('guide').sc.hood) === 1, 'a step finished without "stuck" counts; the stuck one does not');
    await p.click('[data-gw="close"]');
    // at the car: the safety check comes first
    await p.evaluate(() => { V60.mod('guide').at = { date: V60.todayStr(), car: true }; V60.save(); });
    await p.evaluate(() => V60_GUIDE.start('safe'));
    ok(/Before touching/.test(await h2()) && await p.isDisabled('[data-gw="gate"]'), 'safety check before hands-on steps');
    for (const c of await p.$$('[data-gwgate]')) await c.check();
    await p.click('[data-gw="gate"]');
    ok(/Open the hood/.test(await h2()), 'then the hands-on step');
    await p.screenshot({ path: SH + 'g-hood-' + nm + '.png' });
    // proof raises the level, announced with an undo
    await p.evaluate(() => { V60.mod('guide').sc.hood = 3; V60.save(); const A = V60.acad(); A.done['m-hood'] = { date: '2026-10-11', outcome: 'good' }; V60.save(); V60.renderAll(); });
    await p.click('[data-gw="close"]');
    await p.evaluate(() => V60_GUIDE.start('safe'));
    await p.click('[data-gw="close"]');
    ok(await p.evaluate(() => V60.mod('guide').lvl.hood) === 1, 'hood guidance stepped back to assisted');
    await p.evaluate(() => { __v60.go('today'); });
    ok(/Less hand-holding for under-the-hood/.test(await p.textContent('#tdCards')), 'Today announces it');
    await p.evaluate(() => __v60.go('today')); await p.click('[data-gkeep="hood"]');
    ok(await p.evaluate(() => V60_GUIDE.level('safe')) === 0, 'Keep guiding me puts it back');
    // unprompted proof
    const before = await p.evaluate(() => V60.mod('guide').sc.hood);
    await p.evaluate(() => { V60.state.oil.push({ id: 'x1', date: V60.todayStr(), miles: 95100, level: 'full' }); V60.save(); V60.renderAll(); });
    ok(await p.evaluate(() => V60.mod('guide').sc.hood) > before, 'an oil check logged on your own counts');
    // tab intro, once
    await p.evaluate(() => __v60.go('engine'));
    ok(await p.locator('#p-engine .gintro').count() === 1, 'new tab shows a one-line intro');
    await p.click('#p-engine [data-gintro]');
    await p.evaluate(() => { __v60.go('today'); __v60.go('engine'); });
    ok(await p.locator('#p-engine .gintro').count() === 0, 'intro does not come back');
    // welcome back after a long gap
    await p.evaluate(() => { const d = V60.mod('guide'); d.last = '2026-01-01'; d.lvl.records = 2; V60.save(); });
    await p.reload(); await p.waitForTimeout(500); await p.evaluate(() => __v60.go('today'));
    ok(/Welcome back/.test(await p.textContent('#tdCards')), 'welcome-back recap after 45+ days');
    ok(await p.evaluate(() => V60.mod('guide').lvl.records) === 1, 'each area steps back one level');
    ok(await p.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth), 'no sideways scroll');
    ok(errs.length === 0, 'no errors ' + JSON.stringify(errs));
    await ctx.close();
  }
  await b.close();
})();
```

```javascript
/* The workshop manual: chapters opening in path order, the two markers (glow until opened, dot where you left off), the gate that
   opens old pages only once a chapter needs them, the Go/back crumb, and a photo as a view with pinned points. */
const { chromium } = require(process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_PATH || 'playwright');
const path = require('path'); const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
function ok(c, m) { if (!c) { console.log('FAIL', m); process.exitCode = 1; } else console.log(' ok', m); }
(async () => {
  const b = await chromium.launch(process.env.CHROMIUM_PATH ? { executablePath: process.env.CHROMIUM_PATH } : {});
  const ctx = await b.newContext({ viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 } }); await ctx.addInitScript(() => { window.__V60_TEST = true; window.__V60_NOSCAN = true; });
  const p = await ctx.newPage(); const errs = []; p.on('pageerror', e => errs.push(e.message)); p.on('console', m => { if (m.type() === 'error') errs.push(m.text()); });
  await p.goto('file://' + ROOT + '/index.html'); await p.waitForTimeout(700);
  const st = id => p.evaluate(id => V60_MANUAL.status(id), id);
  ok(await p.evaluate(() => V60.state && document.querySelector('#p-car') && !document.querySelector('#p-car').hidden), 'home is The car');
  ok(await st('0') === 'new' && await st('1.1.1') === 'locked' && await st('2.1.1') === 'locked', 'start: chapter 0 new, everything else locked ' + [await st('0'), await st('1.1.1')]);
  ok(await p.evaluate(() => document.querySelectorAll('#rail button').length === 3 && document.querySelectorAll('#rail button.locked').length === 0), 'the bar has three roots, Glovebox and Link always open');
  ok(await p.evaluate(() => !V60_GATE.visible('diy') && !V60_GATE.visible('kb')), 'old pages are not visible before a chapter needs them');
  /* open chapter 0: glow stops, it becomes the resume point */
  await p.evaluate(() => V60_MANUAL.go('ch', '0')); await p.waitForTimeout(100);
  ok(await st('0') === 'resume', 'opening chapter 0 ends its glow and marks it as where you left off');
  ok(await p.evaluate(() => V60_GATE.visible('academy')), 'Training is reachable because chapter 0 needs it');
  /* chapter 0 is a part page; its first step opened in place with the lesson inside it */
  ok(await p.evaluate(() => !document.querySelector('#p-item').hidden && !!document.querySelector('#mnItem #ch-0 details.mn-stepx[open] .mn-train .mission')), 'the chapter is a section on the part page and the lesson renders inside the open step');
  await p.evaluate(() => { const m = V60.CHAPTERS[0].missions.filter(x => x.id === 'm-sys')[0]; m.quiz.forEach((q, i) => { document.querySelector('#mnItem input[name="q' + i + '"][value="' + q.a + '"]').checked = true; }); });
  await p.click('#mnItem #ch-0 details.mn-stepx[open] #quizGo'); await p.waitForTimeout(250);
  ok(await p.evaluate(() => { const x = V60.acad().done['m-sys']; return !!(x && x.outcome === 'good') && !!document.querySelector('#mnItem #ch-0 details.mn-stepx.done'); }), 'finishing the lesson in place ticks the step');
  ok(await p.evaluate(() => document.querySelector('#p-academy').hidden), 'Training stayed on the part page');
  /* finish the preface: the evidence is the four Training missions */
  await p.evaluate(() => { const A = V60.acad(); ['m-sys', 'm-safe', 'm-hood', 'm-five'].forEach(m => { A.done[m] = { date: V60.todayStr(), outcome: 'good' }; }); V60.save(); V60_MANUAL.bust(); __v60.go('car'); });
  await p.waitForTimeout(200);
  ok(await st('0') === 'closed' && await st('3.1.1') === 'new' && await st('3.1.2') === 'locked' && await st('1.1.1') === 'locked', 'closing 0 opens step 2 of the path (3.1.1) and nothing else ' + [await st('0'), await st('3.1.1'), await st('3.1.2'), await st('1.1.1')]);
  ok(await p.evaluate(() => /0 Before you touch anything closed/.test(document.querySelector('#mnHome .mn-toast') ? document.querySelector('#mnHome .mn-toast').textContent : '') && /Next on your path: step 2/.test(document.querySelector('#mnHome .mn-toast').textContent)), 'home announces the closure and the next step');
  ok(await p.evaluate(() => document.querySelector('#mnHome .mn-hs[data-hs="cabin"]').classList.contains('new') && document.querySelector('#mnHome .mn-hs[data-hs="bay"]').classList.contains('closed') === false), 'the cabin point glows');
  ok(await p.evaluate(() => V60_GATE.visible('kb')), 'the Library opened with 3.1.1');
  /* a story case no longer opens anything early: the path decides */
  ok(await st('3.3.1') === 'locked', 'The Signal does not open 3.3.1 early ' + await st('3.3.1'));
  /* finish 3.1.1 (the warning-lights lesson and article): 3.1.2 opens, 3.2.1 stays locked */
  await p.evaluate(() => { const A = V60.acad(); A.done['m-warn'] = { date: V60.todayStr(), outcome: 'good' }; V60_KNOW.discover('a', 'a-lights'); V60.save(); V60_MANUAL.bust(); });
  ok(await st('3.1.1') === 'closed' && await st('3.1.2') === 'new' && await st('3.2.1') === 'locked', '3.1.1 closed, only 3.1.2 opened ' + [await st('3.1.1'), await st('3.1.2'), await st('3.2.1')]);
  /* a step that leads to a workbench page keeps a Go button and the crumb leads back to the part */
  await p.evaluate(() => V60_MANUAL.go('ch', '3.1.2')); await p.waitForTimeout(150);
  ok(await p.evaluate(() => V60_MANUAL.resume() && V60_MANUAL.resume().id === '3.1.2'), 'the last chapter opened is where you pick up');
  ok(await p.evaluate(() => !!document.querySelector('#mnItem #ch-3\\.1\\.2 details.mn-stepx[open] [data-go="tab:my"]')), 'arriving at 3.1.2 opens its first undone step (the photo, with a Go button)');
  await p.click('#mnItem #ch-3\\.1\\.2 details.mn-stepx[open] [data-go="tab:my"]'); await p.waitForTimeout(150);
  ok(await p.evaluate(() => !document.querySelector('#p-my').hidden && !document.getElementById('crumb').hidden), 'Go opens My V60 with a way back');
  await p.click('#crumb [data-back]'); await p.waitForTimeout(100);
  ok(await p.evaluate(() => !document.querySelector('#p-item').hidden && /Driver display/.test(document.querySelector('#mnItem .mn-h1').textContent)), 'the crumb leads back to the part');
  /* the article is inside the Know step (3.1.1 is closed, its steps still open) */
  await p.evaluate(() => V60_MANUAL.go('ch', '3.1.1')); await p.waitForTimeout(150);
  await p.click('#mnItem #ch-3\\.1\\.1 details.mn-stepx:nth-of-type(2) summary'); await p.waitForTimeout(150);
  ok(await p.evaluate(() => !!document.querySelector('#mnItem #ch-3\\.1\\.1 details.mn-stepx:nth-of-type(2)[open] .kbart h4')), 'opening an article step shows the article in place');
  /* the troubleshooter walks in place and marks the step on an outcome (Show everything opens 1.1.4 for this) */
  await p.evaluate(() => { const st = V60.mod('story'); st.all = true; V60.setMod('story', st); V60.save(); V60_MANUAL.bust(); V60_MANUAL.go('ch', '1.1.4'); }); await p.waitForTimeout(150);
  ok(await p.evaluate(() => !!document.querySelector('#mnItem #ch-1\\.1\\.4 details.mn-stepx:nth-of-type(1)[open] .mn-tree [data-tree]')), 'the troubleshooter opens in place');
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = await p.$('#mnItem #ch-1\\.1\\.4 .mn-tree [data-tree$=":n"]'); if (!b) break; await b.click(); await p.waitForTimeout(120); }
  ok(await p.evaluate(() => !!V60.mod('manual').went['1.1.4:0'] && !!document.querySelector('#mnItem #ch-1\\.1\\.4 .mn-note')), 'reaching an outcome marks the troubleshooter step done');
  await p.evaluate(() => { const st = V60.mod('story'); st.all = false; V60.setMod('story', st); V60.save(); V60_MANUAL.bust(); V60_MANUAL.go('ch', '3.1.2'); }); await p.waitForTimeout(150);

  /* a photo as the view, with pins seeded from the drawing and movable */
  await p.evaluate(() => { V60.state.photos = (V60.state.photos || []).concat([{ id: 'ph1', asset: 'x', url: 'data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAIBRAA7', local: false, date: V60.todayStr(), kind: 'bay', part: null, note: '', ai: null }]); V60.save(); V60_MANUAL.go('view', 'bay'); });
  await p.waitForTimeout(100); await p.click('#mnView [data-fm="photo"]'); await p.waitForTimeout(100);

  await p.click('#mnView [data-usephoto="ph1"]'); await p.waitForTimeout(150);

  ok(pins === 9 && await p.evaluate(() => !!document.querySelector('#mnView .mn-fig.photo img')), 'the photo is the figure and every item got a starting point ' + pins);
  const box = await p.$('#mnView .mn-fig'); const bb = await box.boundingBox(); const pin = await p.$('#mnView .mn-hs[data-hs="oil"]'); const pb = await pin.boundingBox();
  await p.mouse.move(pb.x + pb.width / 2, pb.y + pb.height / 2); await p.mouse.down(); await p.mouse.move(bb.x + bb.width * 0.8, bb.y + bb.height * 0.8, { steps: 5 }); await p.mouse.up(); await p.waitForTimeout(100);
  const moved = await p.evaluate(() => V60.mod('manual').views.bay.pins.oil);
  ok(moved && moved[0] > 0.7 && moved[1] > 0.7, 'dragging a point saves its new place ' + JSON.stringify(moved));
  await p.click('#mnView [data-arrange]'); await p.waitForTimeout(50); await p.click('#mnView .mn-hs[data-hs="coolant"]'); await p.waitForTimeout(100);
  ok(await p.evaluate(() => /Coolant/.test(document.querySelector('#mnView .mn-sheet h3').textContent)), 'after moving, tapping a point selects it again');
  ok(errs.length === 0, 'no errors ' + JSON.stringify(errs));
  await b.close();
})();
```

### `tests/nav.js`

```javascript
/* Navigation: every page has a way in and a way back.
   - the hood view offers the engine bay map, and the crumb leads back to the hood view
   - the map stays a drawing (the owner's photo is optional)
   - with Show everything on, every page is linked from somewhere other than itself
   - The car's index, and the see-also strips on Glovebox, Link and Cases, only list pages the story has opened
   - Back retraces a path two pages deep, and a root clears it */
const { chromium } = require(process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_PATH || 'playwright');
const path = require('path'); const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
function ok(c, m) { if (!c) { console.log('FAIL', m); process.exitCode = 1; } else console.log(' ok', m); }
(async () => {
  const b = await chromium.launch(process.env.CHROMIUM_PATH ? { executablePath: process.env.CHROMIUM_PATH } : {});
  const ctx = await b.newContext({ viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 } }); await ctx.addInitScript(() => { window.__V60_TEST = true; });
  const p = await ctx.newPage(); const errs = []; p.on('pageerror', e => errs.push(e.message)); p.on('console', m => { if (m.type() === 'error') errs.push(m.text()); });
  await p.goto('file://' + ROOT + '/index.html'); await p.waitForTimeout(600);
  const tab = () => p.evaluate(() => { const v = [...document.querySelectorAll('main > .panel')].filter(x => !x.hidden)[0]; return v && v.id.slice(2); });
  const crumb = () => p.evaluate(() => { const c = document.getElementById('crumb'); return c && !c.hidden ? c.textContent.trim() : ''; });

  /* fresh start: the engine bay map is open from the start (Safe to Touch) and sits under the hood drawing */
  await p.evaluate(() => V60_MANUAL.go('view', 'bay')); await p.waitForTimeout(100);
  ok(await p.isVisible('#mnView .mn-mapbtn'), 'the hood view has an Engine bay map button');
  await p.click('#mnView .mn-mapbtn'); await p.waitForTimeout(150);
  ok(await tab() === 'engine', 'it opens the engine bay map');
  ok(await p.evaluate(() => !!document.querySelector('#ebStage svg.ebsvg')), 'the map is the drawing, not a photo');
  ok(/Back to Engine bay/.test(await crumb()), 'the crumb leads back to the hood view (' + await crumb() + ')');
  await p.click('#crumb [data-back]'); await p.waitForTimeout(150);
  ok(await tab() === 'view' && await p.isVisible('#mnView .mn-mapbtn'), 'Back returns to the hood view');
  await p.evaluate(() => __v60.go('engine')); await p.waitForTimeout(100);
  const ori = await p.evaluate(() => { const y = s => { const t = [...document.querySelectorAll('#ebStage .edge')].filter(e => e.textContent.indexOf(s) === 0)[0]; return t ? +t.getAttribute('y') : null; }; const c = document.querySelector('[data-bi="catch"] rect'); return { wind: y('Windshield'), bump: y('Front bumper'), catchY: c ? +c.getAttribute('y') : null }; });
  ok(ori.wind < 60 && ori.bump > 380 && ori.catchY > 300, 'map seen from the bumper: windshield on top, hood catch at the bottom ' + JSON.stringify(ori));

  /* fresh start: nothing locked is offered (the index page is the back of the book) */
  await p.evaluate(() => __v60.go('car')); await p.waitForTimeout(150);
  ok(await p.evaluate(() => !!document.querySelector('#mnHome [data-jump="tab:index"]') && !document.querySelector('#mnHome .mn-also')), 'the home carries one Index button instead of the page lists');
  await p.evaluate(() => __v60.go('index')); await p.waitForTimeout(150);
  const offered = await p.evaluate(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('#mnIndex .mn-also [data-jump]')].map(e => e.getAttribute('data-jump').slice(4)));
  const allOpen = await p.evaluate(o => o.every(t => V60_GATE.visible(t)), offered);
  ok(offered.length > 0 && allOpen, 'the index lists only opened pages at the start (' + offered.join(',') + ')');
  ok(!offered.includes('fuel') && !offered.includes('upgrades'), 'pages the story has not reached stay hidden');

  /* Show everything: every page has a way in */
  await p.evaluate(() => { __v60.go('story'); }); await p.waitForTimeout(150);
  await p.evaluate(() => { const o = document.getElementById('stOpts'); if (o) o.open = true; }); await p.check('#stAll'); await p.waitForTimeout(200);
  const tabs = await p.evaluate(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('main > .panel')].map(x => x.id.slice(2)));
  const into = {};
  for (const t of tabs) {
    await p.evaluate(t => __v60.go(t), t); await p.waitForTimeout(60);
    const outs = await p.evaluate(() => { const v = [...document.querySelectorAll('main > .panel')].filter(x => !x.hidden)[0]; return [...v.querySelectorAll('[data-jump^="tab:"],[data-tab]')].map(e => e.getAttribute('data-jump') ? e.getAttribute('data-jump').slice(4) : e.getAttribute('data-tab')); });
    outs.forEach(o => { if (o !== t) (into[o] = into[o] || new Set()).add(t); });
  }
  const navTabs = await p.evaluate(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('#rail [data-tab]')].map(e => e.getAttribute('data-tab')));
  navTabs.forEach(o => (into[o] = into[o] || new Set()).add('bar'));
  const orphans = tabs.filter(t => !['view', 'item'].includes(t) && !into[t]);
  ok(orphans.length === 0, 'every page is linked from another page or the bar' + (orphans.length ? ' (missing: ' + orphans.join(',') + ')' : ''));
  const broken = Object.keys(into).filter(t => !tabs.includes(t));
  ok(broken.length === 0, 'no link points at a page that does not exist ' + JSON.stringify(broken));
  for (const r of ['glove', 'live', 'story']) {
    await p.evaluate(r => __v60.go(r), r); await p.waitForTimeout(100);
    ok(await p.evaluate(r => document.querySelectorAll('#also-' + r + ' [data-jump]').length > 0, r), 'see-also on ' + r);
  }

  /* Back retraces two pages, a root clears the trail */
  await p.evaluate(() => __v60.go('glove')); await p.waitForTimeout(100);
  await p.click('#also-glove [data-jump="tab:records"]'); await p.waitForTimeout(100);
  ok(await tab() === 'records' && /Back to Glovebox/.test(await crumb()), 'Glovebox → Service log shows Back to Glovebox');
  await p.evaluate(() => V60.jump('tab:kb')); await p.waitForTimeout(100);
  ok(/Back to Service log/.test(await crumb()), 'a second hop shows Back to Service log (' + await crumb() + ')');
  await p.click('#crumb [data-back]'); await p.waitForTimeout(100);
  ok(await tab() === 'records' && /Back to Glovebox/.test(await crumb()), 'Back once: Service log, still offering Glovebox');
  await p.click('#crumb [data-back]'); await p.waitForTimeout(100);
  ok(await tab() === 'glove' && !(await crumb()), 'Back twice: Glovebox, no crumb on a root');

  ok(errs.length === 0, 'no errors ' + JSON.stringify(errs));
  await b.close();
})();
```

### `tests/odo.js`

```javascript
/* Saved data must survive reloads. Regression: the Story sweep saved an empty copy while the page started, overwriting the
   saved data (and syncing it), so the number showed once and was gone on the next load. Also: typed-but-not-blurred odometer. */
const { chromium } = require(process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_PATH || 'playwright');
const path = require('path'); const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
function ok(c, m) { if (!c) { console.log('FAIL', m); process.exitCode = 1; } else console.log(' ok', m); }
(async () => {
  const b = await chromium.launch(process.env.CHROMIUM_PATH ? { executablePath: process.env.CHROMIUM_PATH } : {});
  const ctx = await b.newContext({ viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 } }); await ctx.addInitScript(() => { window.__V60_TEST = true; });
  const p = await ctx.newPage(); const errs = []; p.on('pageerror', e => errs.push(e.message));
  await p.goto('file://' + ROOT + '/index.html'); await p.waitForTimeout(400);
  await p.fill('#odo', '95321');            // fill fires input but not change, like leaving the page mid-edit
  await p.waitForTimeout(100);
  for (let i = 1; i <= 4; i++) { await p.reload(); await p.waitForTimeout(500); ok(await p.inputValue('#odo') === '95321', 'odometer still there after reload ' + i); }
  const stored = await p.evaluate(() => (JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('v60-garage-v1') || '{}')).odo);
  ok(stored === 95321, 'storage holds the odometer, not an empty copy (' + stored + ')');
  await p.evaluate(() => { const d = V60.mod('story'); d.all = true; V60.save(); });
  for (let i = 1; i <= 2; i++) { await p.reload(); await p.waitForTimeout(500); }
  ok(await p.evaluate(() => !!(V60.mod('story') || {}).all), 'Show everything stays on after reloads');
  ok(await p.inputValue('#odo') === '95321', 'odometer survives with Show everything on');
  ok(errs.length === 0, 'no errors ' + JSON.stringify(errs));
  await b.close();
})();
```

### `tests/path.js`

```javascript
/* The path: one strict line through every chapter, the G1 study and the quizzes (Kyle, 2026-10-15).
   Checks the data (every chapter and G1 task once, quizzes after what they test), that only the current step is open,
   the home's one Next card, setting a step aside, a study step, the path page, and that a case cannot jump ahead. */
const { chromium } = require(process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_PATH || 'playwright');
const path = require('path'), fs = require('fs'); const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..'); const SH = path.join(ROOT, 'tests', 'shots') + '/'; fs.mkdirSync(SH, { recursive: true });
function ok(c, m) { if (!c) { console.log('FAIL', m); process.exitCode = 1; } else console.log(' ok', m); }
(async () => {
  const b = await chromium.launch(process.env.CHROMIUM_PATH ? { executablePath: process.env.CHROMIUM_PATH } : {});
  const ctx = await b.newContext({ viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 } }); await ctx.addInitScript(() => { window.__V60_TEST = true; window.__V60_NOSCAN = true; });
  const p = await ctx.newPage(); const errs = []; p.on('pageerror', e => errs.push(e.message)); p.on('console', m => { if (m.type() === 'error') errs.push(m.text()); });
  await p.goto('file://' + ROOT + '/index.html'); await p.waitForTimeout(700);

  /* the data */
  const shape = await p.evaluate(() => {
    const S = V60_PATH.stages, chs = Object.keys(V60_MANUAL.chapters), seenC = {}, seenT = {}, pos = {};
    S.forEach(s => { if (s.kind === 'ch') { seenC[s.ch] = (seenC[s.ch] || 0) + 1; pos['ch' + s.ch] = s.n; } if (s.kind === 'g1') s.tasks.forEach(t => { seenT[t] = (seenT[t] || 0) + 1; pos['t' + t] = s.n; }); if (s.kind === 'quiz') pos['q' + s.area + s.rung] = s.n; });
    const badC = chs.filter(c => seenC[c] !== 1), badT = V60_G1_TASKS.map(t => t.id).filter(t => seenT[t] !== 1), order = [];
    V60_TRACK_DATA.areas.forEach(a => {
      const q1 = pos['q' + a.id + 1], q2 = pos['q' + a.id + 2];
      if (!q1 || !q2 || q2 < q1) order.push(a.id + ' quizzes');
      a.items.forEach(id => V60_MANUAL.data.items.filter(it => it.id === id)[0].chapters.forEach(c => { if (!a.noCar && (c.tier === 'K' || c.tier === 'C') && pos['ch' + c.id] > q1) order.push(c.id + ' after ' + a.id + ' Owner'); if (pos['ch' + c.id] > q2) order.push(c.id + ' after ' + a.id + ' Technician'); }));
      V60_G1_TASKS.filter(t => t.area === a.id).forEach(t => { if (pos['t' + t.id] > q1) order.push(t.id + ' after its quiz'); });
    });
    return { n: S.length, units: V60_PATH.units.length, badC, badT, order, last: S[S.length - 1].kind, first: S[0].key };
  });
  ok(shape.badC.length === 0, 'every chapter is on the path exactly once ' + JSON.stringify(shape.badC));
  ok(shape.badT.length === 0, 'every G1 task is studied exactly once ' + JSON.stringify(shape.badT));
  ok(shape.order.length === 0, 'each quiz comes after the hands-on chapters and the tasks it tests ' + JSON.stringify(shape.order));
  ok(shape.first === 'ch:0' && shape.last === 'mock', 'safety first, the mock G1 last (' + shape.n + ' steps in ' + shape.units + ' units)');

  /* strict: only the first step is open */
  ok(await p.evaluate(() => Object.keys(V60_MANUAL.chapters).filter(id => V60_MANUAL.open(id)).join() === '0'), 'at the start only chapter 0 is open');
  ok(await p.evaluate(() => !V60_PATH.taskReached('D1') && !V60_PATH.reached('quiz:sus:1') && !V60_PATH.reached('mock')), 'G1 tasks, quizzes and the mock are locked until the path reaches them');

  /* the home: one Next card with a progress bar, then the car, the Index and the red list; nothing else */
  const home = await p.evaluate(() => { const h = document.getElementById('mnHome'); return { cards: h.querySelectorAll('.mn-next').length, ctas: h.querySelectorAll('.mn-cta').length, strip: !!h.querySelector('.tk-strip'), now: [...h.querySelectorAll('.mn-kick span')].some(s => s.textContent === 'NOW'), bar: !!h.querySelector('.mn-next .mn-pbar'), title: h.querySelector('.mn-next h3').textContent, first: h.firstElementChild.className, sos: !!h.querySelector('.mn-sos'), ix: !!h.querySelector('[data-jump="tab:index"]') }; });
  ok(home.cards === 1 && home.ctas === 1 && home.bar && !home.strip && !home.now, 'the home has one Next card with one button and a progress bar ' + JSON.stringify(home));
  ok(/mn-next/.test(home.first) && /Before you touch anything/.test(home.title), 'the Next card comes first and names step 1');
  ok(home.sos && home.ix, 'the red list and the Index stay on the home');
  await p.screenshot({ path: SH + 'path-home-iphone.png', fullPage: true });
  /* a locked view says when it opens */
  await p.click('#mnHome .mn-hs[data-hs="under"]'); await p.waitForTimeout(100);
  ok(/Underside is not open yet\. Step \d+ of your path/.test(await p.textContent('#mnHome')), 'tapping a locked view says which step opens it');
  await p.click('#mnHome .mn-next .mn-cta'); await p.waitForTimeout(200);
  ok(await p.evaluate(() => !document.querySelector('#p-item').hidden && !!document.querySelector('#mnItem #ch-0')), 'Start opens the step: chapter 0 on its page');

  /* finishing a step moves the path on by one */
  await p.evaluate(() => { const A = V60.acad(); ['m-sys', 'm-safe', 'm-hood', 'm-five'].forEach(m => { A.done[m] = { date: V60.todayStr(), outcome: 'good' }; }); V60.save(); V60_MANUAL.bust(); __v60.go('car'); });
  await p.waitForTimeout(200);
  ok(await p.evaluate(() => V60_PATH.current().key === 'ch:3.1.1' && V60_PATH.done() === 1), 'chapter 0 done: the path is on step 2, 3.1.1');
  ok(/STEP 2 OF/.test(await p.textContent('#mnHome .mn-next')), 'the Next card follows');

  /* setting a step aside: only steps marked for it (a shop, a purchase, a dealer) offer it */
  ok(!(await p.$('#mnHome .mn-park')), 'an ordinary step cannot be set aside');
  await p.evaluate(() => { V60_PATH.current().park = 'A test reason.'; __v60.go('car'); });
  await p.click('#mnHome .mn-park summary'); await p.click('#mnHome [data-park]'); await p.waitForTimeout(150);
  ok(await p.evaluate(() => V60_PATH.current().key === 'ch:3.1.2' && V60_PATH.state('ch:3.1.1') === 'parked' && V60_MANUAL.settled('3.1.1') && !V60_MANUAL.closed('3.1.1')), 'a step set aside: the path moves on, the step counts as settled, not closed');
  ok(/Set aside: Step 2/.test(await p.textContent('#mnHome .mn-next')), 'the Next card lists what was set aside');
  await p.evaluate(() => { const A = V60.acad(); A.done['m-warn'] = { date: V60.todayStr(), outcome: 'good' }; V60_KNOW.discover('a', 'a-lights'); V60.save(); V60_MANUAL.bust(); __v60.go('car'); });
  ok(await p.evaluate(() => V60_PATH.state('ch:3.1.1') === 'done' && !/Set aside/.test(document.querySelector('#mnHome .mn-next').textContent)), 'a set-aside step closes by itself once its evidence comes in');

  /* the whole path page: done units folded, the current unit open, later units locked */
  await p.evaluate(() => __v60.go('path')); await p.waitForTimeout(150);
  const pg = await p.evaluate(() => ({ units: document.querySelectorAll('#mnPath .mn-unitx').length, open: [...document.querySelectorAll('#mnPath .mn-unitx[open] .t')].map(x => x.textContent), locked: document.querySelectorAll('#mnPath .mn-unitx.locked').length, now: !!document.querySelector('#mnPath .mn-ix.resume') }));
  ok(pg.units === shape.units && pg.open.length === 1 && /What the car is telling you/.test(pg.open[0]) && pg.locked === shape.units - 2 && pg.now, 'the path page: every unit, the current one open, later ones locked ' + JSON.stringify(pg));
  await p.screenshot({ path: SH + 'path-page-iphone.png', fullPage: true });

  /* a case cannot jump ahead of the path: its step shows the path step instead of Go */
  await p.evaluate(() => { __v60.go('story'); }); await p.waitForTimeout(100);
  const nc = await p.evaluate(() => { return [...document.querySelectorAll('#stV-cases .nextc')].map(e => e.textContent).join(' | '); }); ok(/your path, step 3/i.test(nc), 'the case board points at the path\'s current step: ' + nc);
  await p.evaluate(() => V60.jump('case:signal')); await p.waitForTimeout(150);
  ok(await p.evaluate(() => /PATH STEP \d+/.test(document.querySelector('#stV-cases').textContent)), 'a case step past the current one shows its path step, not a Go button');

  /* a study step: the tasks of one range, each opened in place, then Next step */
  await p.evaluate(() => { const st = V60.mod('story'); st.all = true; V60.setMod('story', st); V60.save(); V60_MANUAL.bust(); V60.jump('study:G1-G7'); }); await p.waitForTimeout(200);
  ok(await p.evaluate(() => !document.querySelector('#p-track').hidden && document.querySelectorAll('#tkBody details.tk-task').length === 7), 'a study step lists its seven tasks');
  for (const d of await p.$$('#tkBody details.tk-task summary')) { await d.click(); await p.waitForTimeout(40); }
  await p.waitForTimeout(150);
  ok(await p.evaluate(() => ['G1', 'G2', 'G3', 'G4', 'G5', 'G6', 'G7'].every(id => !!V60.mod('track').read[id]) && !!document.querySelector('#tkBody [data-jump="path:next"]')), 'opening every task studies it and offers the next step');
  await p.evaluate(() => { const st = V60.mod('story'); st.all = false; V60.setMod('story', st); V60.save(); V60_MANUAL.bust(); V60.jump('study:D1-D13'); }); await p.waitForTimeout(150);
  ok(await p.evaluate(() => document.querySelectorAll('#tkBody .tk-task.locked').length === 13), 'a study step the path has not reached shows its tasks locked');
  ok(await p.evaluate(() => V60_PATH.current().key === 'ch:3.1.2'), 'studying ahead (with Show everything) does not move the path past an open chapter');

  ok(errs.length === 0, 'no errors ' + JSON.stringify(errs));
  await b.close();
})();
```

### `tests/photos.js`

```javascript
/* Photos saved on this device must survive reloads (record in saved state, picture in IndexedDB), and a second synced device must receive them. */
const { chromium } = require(process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_PATH || 'playwright');
const path = require('path'), fs = require('fs'), zlib = require('zlib'); const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
function ok(c, m) { if (!c) { console.log('FAIL', m); process.exitCode = 1; } else console.log(' ok', m); }
function png(mode) { // 64x48 PNG, no dependencies; mode changes the picture
  const w = 64, h = 48, raw = Buffer.alloc((w * 3 + 1) * h); for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) { raw[y * (w * 3 + 1)] = 0; for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) { const o = y * (w * 3 + 1) + 1 + x * 3; const v = mode === 1 ? (x % 16 < 8 ? 240 : 10) : mode === 2 ? (y % 12 < 6 ? 240 : 10) : mode === 3 ? (x < 32 ? 230 : 20) : 160 + (x % 32); raw[o] = mode ? v : 90; raw[o + 1] = mode ? v : 120; raw[o + 2] = mode ? 255 - v : 160 + (x % 32); } }
  const crc = b => { let c, t = [], n; for (n = 0; n < 256; n++) { c = n; for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) c = c & 1 ? 0xEDB88320 ^ (c >>> 1) : c >>> 1; t[n] = c >>> 0; } let r = 0xFFFFFFFF; for (const x of b) r = t[(r ^ x) & 255] ^ (r >>> 8); return (r ^ 0xFFFFFFFF) >>> 0; };
  const chunk = (t, d) => { const l = Buffer.alloc(4); l.writeUInt32BE(d.length); const td = Buffer.concat([Buffer.from(t), d]); const c = Buffer.alloc(4); c.writeUInt32BE(crc(td)); return Buffer.concat([l, td, c]); };
  const ihdr = Buffer.alloc(13); ihdr.writeUInt32BE(w, 0); ihdr.writeUInt32BE(h, 4); ihdr[8] = 8; ihdr[9] = 2;
  return Buffer.concat([Buffer.from([137, 80, 78, 71, 13, 10, 26, 10]), chunk('IHDR', ihdr), chunk('IDAT', zlib.deflateSync(raw)), chunk('IEND', Buffer.alloc(0))]);
}
(async () => {
  const b = await chromium.launch(process.env.CHROMIUM_PATH ? { executablePath: process.env.CHROMIUM_PATH } : {});
  const ctx = await b.newContext({ viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 } }); await ctx.addInitScript(() => { window.__V60_TEST = true; window.__V60_NOSCAN = true; });
  const p = await ctx.newPage(); const errs = []; p.on('pageerror', e => errs.push(e.message));
  await p.goto('file://' + ROOT + '/index.html'); await p.waitForTimeout(500);
  await p.evaluate(() => __v60.go('my')); await p.waitForTimeout(200);
  ok(await p.isVisible('#phTake'), 'photo form is available');
  await p.selectOption('#phKind', 'bay');
  await p.setInputFiles('#phFile', { name: 'bay.png', mimeType: 'image/png', buffer: png() });
  await p.waitForFunction(() => (V60.state.photos || []).length === 1, null, { timeout: 15000 });
  for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
    await p.reload(); await p.waitForTimeout(800);
    const r = await p.evaluate(async () => { const ph = V60.state.photos || []; const id = ph[0] && ph[0].asset; const blob = id ? await new Promise(res => { const rq = indexedDB.open('v60-garage', 1); rq.onsuccess = () => { const g = rq.result.transaction('blobs').objectStore('blobs').get(id); g.onsuccess = () => res(g.result ? g.result.size : 0); g.onerror = () => res(-1); }; rq.onerror = () => res(-2); }) : -3; return { n: ph.length, kind: ph[0] && ph[0].kind, size: blob }; });
    ok(r.n === 1 && r.kind === 'bay' && r.size > 0, 'photo record and picture still there after reload ' + i + ' ' + JSON.stringify(r));
  }
  /* duplicates: the same picture picked again is not added */
  await p.reload(); await p.waitForTimeout(600); await p.evaluate(() => __v60.go('my')); await p.waitForTimeout(200);
  await p.setInputFiles('#phFile', { name: 'again.png', mimeType: 'image/png', buffer: png() });
  await p.waitForFunction(() => /Already saved/.test(document.getElementById('phStatus').textContent), null, { timeout: 15000 });
  ok(await p.evaluate(() => V60.state.photos.length) === 1, 'same photo picked again is not added');
  /* batch: three files, one of them the saved photo again, plus a copy of a new one */
  await p.setInputFiles('#phFile', [
    { name: 'a.png', mimeType: 'image/png', buffer: png() },
    { name: 'b.png', mimeType: 'image/png', buffer: png(1) },
    { name: 'b2.png', mimeType: 'image/png', buffer: png(1) },
    { name: 'c.png', mimeType: 'image/png', buffer: png(2) }
  ]);
  await p.waitForSelector('#phBatch:not([hidden]) .phbl li', { timeout: 15000 });
  const rows = await p.evaluate(() => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#phBatch .phbl li')).map(li => ({ dup: li.classList.contains('dup'), txt: li.textContent })));
  ok(rows.length === 4 && rows[0].dup && rows[1].dup === false && rows[2].dup && rows[3].dup === false, 'batch marks the saved photo and the repeat inside the batch ' + JSON.stringify(rows.map(r => r.dup)));
  await p.selectOption('#phBatch select[data-bk="1"]', 'interior');
  await p.click('#phBatchGo');
  await p.waitForFunction(() => (V60.state.photos || []).length === 3, null, { timeout: 20000 });
  const kinds = await p.evaluate(() => V60.state.photos.map(x => x.kind + ':' + (x.hash ? 'h' : '-')));
  ok(kinds.join() === 'bay:h,interior:h,other:h', 'batch saved the two new photos with the chosen type and fingerprints ' + kinds.join());
  await p.reload(); await p.waitForTimeout(800);
  await p.evaluate(() => __v60.go('my'));
  await p.setInputFiles('#phFile', [{ name: 'b3.png', mimeType: 'image/png', buffer: png(1) }, { name: 'd.png', mimeType: 'image/png', buffer: png(3) }]);
  await p.waitForSelector('#phBatch .phbl li', { timeout: 15000 });
  ok((await p.evaluate(() => document.querySelectorAll('#phBatch .phbl li.dup').length)) === 1, 'saved photos are still recognised after a reload');
  /* a synced copy of the same picture from another device collapses to one */
  const n = await p.evaluate(() => { const st = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(V60.state)); const before = st.photos.length; st.photos = st.photos.concat([Object.assign({}, st.photos[0], { id: 'zz', asset: 'other' })]); return [before, __v60.clean(st).photos.length]; });
  ok(n[0] === n[1], 'a second copy of a saved picture (another device) collapses to one ' + n.join('->'));
  ok(errs.length === 0, 'no errors ' + JSON.stringify(errs));
  await b.close();
})();
```

### `tests/portrait.js`

```javascript
/* Upright phone audit (Kyle uses the app only held vertically): every page at 390 x 844 with Show everything on.
   Fails on: text drawn smaller than 11 px (in SVG diagrams too, after they shrink to fit), buttons and links smaller
   than 32 px to tap, and boxes that scroll sideways. Prints what it found, page by page.
   node tests/portrait.js --report lists everything without failing. */
const { chromium } = require(process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_PATH || 'playwright');
const path = require('path'), fs = require('fs'); const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..'); const SH = path.join(ROOT, 'tests', 'shots'); fs.mkdirSync(SH, { recursive: true });
const REPORT = process.argv.includes('--report');
function ok(c, m) { if (!c && !REPORT) { console.log('FAIL', m); process.exitCode = 1; } else console.log((c ? ' ok ' : ' -- ') + m); }
(async () => {
  const b = await chromium.launch(process.env.CHROMIUM_PATH ? { executablePath: process.env.CHROMIUM_PATH } : {});
  const ctx = await b.newContext({ viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 } }); await ctx.addInitScript(() => { window.__V60_TEST = true; });
  const p = await ctx.newPage(); const errs = []; p.on('pageerror', e => errs.push(e.message));
  await p.goto('file://' + ROOT + '/index.html'); await p.waitForTimeout(600);
  await p.evaluate(() => { __v60.go('story'); const o = document.getElementById('stOpts'); if (o) o.open = true; }); await p.check('#stAll'); await p.waitForTimeout(200);
  const tabs = await p.evaluate(() => [...document.querySelectorAll('main > .panel')].map(x => x.id.slice(2)));
  const views = await p.evaluate(() => V60_MANUAL.data.views.map(v => v.id));
  const pages = tabs.filter(t => t !== 'view').map(t => ['tab', t]).concat(views.map(v => ['view', v]));
  let bad = 0;
  for (const [kind, id] of pages) {
    if (kind === 'tab') await p.evaluate(t => __v60.go(t), id); else await p.evaluate(v => V60_MANUAL.go('view', v), id);
    await p.waitForTimeout(120);
    /* open every <details> so folded content is measured too */
    await p.evaluate(() => { const v = [...document.querySelectorAll('main > .panel')].filter(x => !x.hidden)[0]; v.querySelectorAll('details').forEach(d => { d.open = true; }); });
    await p.waitForTimeout(60);
    const r = await p.evaluate(() => {
      const panel = [...document.querySelectorAll('main > .panel')].filter(x => !x.hidden)[0], out = { small: [], svg: [], taps: [], scroll: [] };
      const vis = e => { const s = getComputedStyle(e); if (s.display === 'none' || s.visibility === 'hidden') return false; const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0; };
      const name = e => (e.id ? '#' + e.id : e.tagName.toLowerCase() + (e.className && typeof e.className === 'string' ? '.' + e.className.trim().split(/\s+/)[0] : ''));
      /* HTML text */
      const seen = new Set();
      panel.querySelectorAll('*').forEach(e => {
        if (e.closest('svg') || !vis(e)) return;
        const own = [...e.childNodes].some(n => n.nodeType === 3 && n.textContent.trim().length > 1); if (!own) return;
        const fs = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(e).fontSize); if (fs < 11) { const k = name(e) + ' ' + fs + 'px'; if (!seen.has(k)) { seen.add(k); out.small.push(k + ' "' + e.textContent.trim().slice(0, 30) + '"'); } }
      });
      /* SVG text after scaling */
      panel.querySelectorAll('svg').forEach(s => {
        if (!vis(s)) return; const ts = [...s.querySelectorAll('text')].filter(vis); if (!ts.length) return;
        const hs = ts.map(t => t.getBoundingClientRect().height).filter(h => h > 0); const min = Math.min.apply(null, hs);
        if (min < 11) out.svg.push((s.getAttribute('aria-label') || name(s)).slice(0, 50) + ': smallest text ' + min.toFixed(1) + 'px, drawing ' + Math.round(s.getBoundingClientRect().width) + 'x' + Math.round(s.getBoundingClientRect().height));
      });
      /* tap targets */
      panel.querySelectorAll('button, a[href], input:not([type=hidden]), select, [role=button], summary, label').forEach(e => {
        if (!vis(e) || e.closest('svg') && e.tagName !== 'g') return;
        if (e.closest('svg[data-also]')) return; /* a drawing whose every point is also a full-size button below it */
        if (e.tagName === 'LABEL' && !e.querySelector('input')) return;
        if (e.tagName === 'A' && e.closest('p, li, dd, span.d')) return; /* links inside a sentence */
        if (e.tagName === 'INPUT' && /checkbox|radio/.test(e.type) && e.closest('label')) return; /* the label is the target */
        const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.height < 32 || r.width < 32) out.taps.push(name(e) + ' ' + Math.round(r.width) + 'x' + Math.round(r.height) + ' "' + (e.textContent || e.getAttribute('aria-label') || e.value || '').trim().slice(0, 24) + '"');
      });
      /* sideways scrolling boxes */
      panel.querySelectorAll('*').forEach(e => { if (!vis(e)) return; const s = getComputedStyle(e); if (e.id !== 'tdCards' /* swipeable cards, by design */ && /(auto|scroll)/.test(s.overflowX) && e.scrollWidth > e.clientWidth + 2) out.scroll.push(name(e) + ' ' + e.scrollWidth + ' in ' + e.clientWidth); });
      out.page = document.documentElement.scrollWidth - innerWidth;
      if (out.page > 0) out.wide = [...document.querySelectorAll('body *')].filter(e => e.getBoundingClientRect().right > innerWidth + 1 && !e.closest('#tdCards')).slice(0, 4).map(e => name(e) + ' ' + Math.round(e.getBoundingClientRect().width) + 'px "' + e.textContent.trim().slice(0, 30) + '"');
      return out;
    });
    const label = kind === 'view' ? 'view ' + id : id;
    const issues = [].concat(r.small.map(x => 'small text ' + x), r.svg.map(x => 'drawing ' + x), r.taps.slice(0, 8).map(x => 'small tap ' + x), r.scroll.map(x => 'scrolls sideways ' + x), r.page > 0 ? ['page scrolls sideways by ' + r.page + 'px: ' + (r.wide || []).join('; ')] : []);
    if (r.taps.length > 8) issues.push('... ' + (r.taps.length - 8) + ' more small taps');
    bad += issues.length;
    ok(!issues.length, label + (issues.length ? '\n      ' + issues.join('\n      ') : ''));
    if (issues.length && REPORT) await p.screenshot({ path: path.join(SH, 'portrait-' + label.replace(' ', '-') + '.png'), fullPage: true });
  }
  ok(errs.length === 0, 'no page errors ' + JSON.stringify(errs));
  console.log(bad + ' issues');
  await b.close();
})();
```

### `tests/run.js`

```javascript
// Builds the app, then runs every test in Chromium and in WebKit dressed as an iPhone (Bluefy's engine).
//   node tests/run.js                 build + all tests, both engines
//   node tests/run.js manual story    only these tests
//   node tests/run.js --webkit        one engine (--chromium or --webkit)
//   node tests/run.js --no-build      skip the build
// Prints one line per test and engine; the full output of a failing test follows. Exit code 1 if any failed.
const { spawn, spawnSync } = require('child_process');
const path = require('path'), fs = require('fs');
const ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const flags = new Set(args.filter((a) => a.startsWith('--')));
const pick = args.filter((a) => !a.startsWith('--')).map((a) => a.replace(/\.js$/, ''));
const ALL = fs.readdirSync(__dirname).filter((f) => f.endsWith('.js') && !['run.js', 'engine.js', 'figshot.js'].includes(f)).map((f) => f.slice(0, -3)).sort();
const tests = pick.length ? pick : ALL;
const unknown = tests.filter((t) => !ALL.includes(t));
if (unknown.length) { console.error('No such test:', unknown.join(', '), '\nTests:', ALL.join(', ')); process.exit(2); }
const engines = flags.has('--chromium') ? ['chromium'] : flags.has('--webkit') ? ['webkit'] : ['chromium', 'webkit'];

if (!flags.has('--no-build')) {
  const py = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'python' : 'python3';
  const r = spawnSync(py, [path.join('tools', 'build.py')], { cwd: ROOT, encoding: 'utf8' });
  if (r.status !== 0) { console.error('Build failed\n' + (r.stdout || '') + (r.stderr || r.error || '')); process.exit(1); }
  console.log((r.stdout || '').split(' modules:')[0]);
}

function run(test, engine) {
  return new Promise((done) => {
    const t0 = Date.now();
    const env = { ...process.env, V60_ENGINE: engine };
    const p = spawn(process.execPath, ['-r', path.join(__dirname, 'engine.js'), path.join(__dirname, test + '.js')], { cwd: ROOT, env });
    let out = '';
    p.stdout.on('data', (d) => (out += d)); p.stderr.on('data', (d) => (out += d));
    const kill = setTimeout(() => { out += '\nTimed out after 5 minutes'; p.kill(); }, 300000);
    p.on('close', (code) => { clearTimeout(kill); done({ test, engine, ok: code === 0 && !/^\s*FAIL/m.test(out), out, s: ((Date.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(1) }); });
  });
}

(async () => {
  const jobs = [];
  for (const e of engines) for (const t of tests) jobs.push([t, e]);
  const results = [];
  const width = Math.max(2, Math.min(6, require('os').cpus().length - 1));
  let next = 0;
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
    while (next < jobs.length) {
      const r = await run(...jobs[next++]);
      results.push(r);
      console.log((r.ok ? '[pass] ' : '[FAIL] ') + r.test.padEnd(11) + (r.engine === 'webkit' ? 'iPhone/WebKit' : 'Chromium').padEnd(14) + r.s + 's');
    }
  }));
  const bad = results.filter((r) => !r.ok);
  for (const r of bad) console.log('\n===== ' + r.test + ' (' + r.engine + ') =====\n' + r.out.trim());
  console.log('\n' + (results.length - bad.length) + ' of ' + results.length + ' passed. Screenshots: tests/shots/');
  process.exitCode = bad.length ? 1 : 0;
})();
```

### `tests/scan.js`

```javascript
/* Scanner test: reads a synthetic receipt on the device (Tesseract.js from jsDelivr), checks that personal details
   are blacked out in the saved image and the stored text, and that date, mileage, total and work were decoded.
   Uses only made-up data and the public example VIN 1HGBH41JXMN109186. */
const PW = process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_PATH || "playwright";
const { chromium } = require(PW);
const http = require("http"), fs = require("fs"), path = require("path");
const ROOT = path.join(__dirname, "..");
const SHOTS = path.join(__dirname, "shots"); fs.mkdirSync(SHOTS, { recursive: true });
let fails = 0; const ok = (c, m) => { console.log((c ? " ok " : " FAIL ") + m); if (!c) fails++; };

const srv = http.createServer((q, r) => {
  let f = path.join(ROOT, decodeURIComponent(q.url.split("?")[0])); if (f.endsWith("/")) f += "index.html";
  fs.readFile(f, (e, d) => { if (e) { r.writeHead(404); r.end(); return; } r.writeHead(200, { "content-type": f.endsWith(".js") ? "text/javascript" : f.endsWith(".css") ? "text/css" : "text/html" }); r.end(d); });
}).listen(0);

(async () => {
  const port = srv.address().port;
  const b = await chromium.launch({ executablePath: process.env.CHROMIUM_PATH });
  const p = await b.newPage({ viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 } });
  const errs = []; p.on("pageerror", e => errs.push(e.message));
  await p.addInitScript(() => { window.__V60_TEST = true; });
  await p.goto(`http://localhost:${port}/index.html`); await p.waitForTimeout(800);

  /* 1. rules without OCR */
  const unit = await p.evaluate(() => {
    const S = window.V60_SCAN, L = t => ({ words: t.split(" ").map((w, i) => ({ text: w, bbox: { x0: i * 10, y0: 0, x1: i * 10 + 8, y1: 8 } })) });
    const lines = ["Customer: Jordan Sample", "VIN 1HGBH41JXMN109186", "Call (512) 555-0142", "Visa 4111 1111 1111 1111", "1234 Example Ln", "Austin, TX 78701", "Oil & filter change 49.99", "Part 31330050 qty 1"].map(L);
    const boxes = S._detect(lines, ["Sample"]);
    const hid = {}; boxes.slice().sort((x, y) => x.li - y.li || x.wi - y.wi).forEach(b => { hid[b.li] = (hid[b.li] || []).concat(lines[b.li].words[b.wi].text); });
    const rc = ["Lakeline Auto Care", "8200 Example Pkwy", "Austin, TX 78750", "(512) 555-0199", "Customer: Jordan Sample", "1234 Example Ln", "Phone: (512) 555-0142"].map(L);
    const rb = S._detect(rc, [], { receipt: true }), shown = {}, hidden = {};
    rb.forEach(b => { (b.redact ? hidden : shown)[b.li] = 1; });
    const shop = { shown: Object.keys(shown).join(","), hidden: Object.keys(hidden).join(",") };
    const door = S._parse("MFD BY VOLVO CAR CORPORATION 11/15 GVWR 2390 KG", "", S._classify("MFD BY VOLVO CAR CORPORATION 11/15 GVWR"));
    /* a VIN with no label, read one character long or short, is still caught as a VIN */
    const misread = ["Stock 1THGBH41JXMN109186 ok", "Stock 1HGBH41JXMN10918 ok"].map(L).map(l => S._detect([l], []).map(b => b.kind + ":" + l.words[b.wi].text).join());
    return { hid, door, shop, misread, cls: S._classify("REPAIR ORDER ... TOTAL 12.00") };
  });
  ok(unit.misread.join("|") === "vin:1THGBH41JXMN109186|vin:1HGBH41JXMN10918", "VIN read with a character too many or too few is hidden (" + unit.misread.join("|") + ")");
  ok((unit.hid[0] || []).join(" ") === "Jordan Sample", "name after Customer: hidden");
  ok((unit.hid[1] || []).indexOf("1HGBH41JXMN109186") >= 0, "VIN hidden");
  ok((unit.hid[2] || []).join(" ") === "(512) 555-0142", "phone hidden");
  ok((unit.hid[3] || []).length >= 4, "card number hidden");
  ok((unit.hid[4] || []).length === 3 && (unit.hid[5] || []).length === 3, "street and city line hidden");
  ok(!unit.hid[6], "work line left visible");
  ok(!unit.hid[7], "part number left visible");
  ok(unit.door.build === "2015-11", "door label build month decoded (" + unit.door.build + ")");
  ok(unit.cls === "receipt", "receipt classified");
  ok(unit.shop.shown === "1,2,3" && unit.shop.hidden === "4,5,6", "shop header visible, customer block hidden (" + JSON.stringify(unit.shop) + ")");

  /* 2. full run: synthetic receipt photo through Glovebox */
  const png = await p.evaluate(() => {
    const c = document.createElement("canvas"); c.width = 1100; c.height = 1500; const g = c.getContext("2d");
    g.fillStyle = "#fff"; g.fillRect(0, 0, c.width, c.height); g.fillStyle = "#111"; g.font = "bold 46px Arial";
    const rows = ["Lakeline Auto Care", "REPAIR ORDER 20417", "Date: 09/14/2026", "Customer: Jordan Sample", "1234 Example Ln", "Austin, TX 78701", "Phone: (512) 555-0142", "VIN 1HGBH41JXMN109186", "Mileage In: 94,812", "Oil & filter change 89.99", "Cabin air filter 54.99", "Labor 44.49", "Total $189.47"];
    rows.forEach((t, i) => g.fillText(t, 60, 110 + i * 100));
    window.__vinRow = { x: 60, y: 110 + 7 * 100 - 20 };
    return c.toDataURL("image/png").split(",")[1];
  });
  await p.setInputFiles("#gbFile", { name: "receipt.png", mimeType: "image/png", buffer: Buffer.from(png, "base64") });
  await p.waitForSelector("#scanOv:not([hidden])", { timeout: 10000 });
  ok(true, "review sheet opened");
  await p.waitForFunction(() => !document.getElementById("scanSave").disabled, null, { timeout: 120000 });
  const msg = await p.textContent("#scanMsg"), found = await p.textContent("#scanFound"), fields = await p.textContent("#scanFields");
  console.log("   msg:", msg.trim(), "|", found.trim());
  ok(/Done/.test(msg), "text was read on the device");
  ok(/VIN/.test(found) && /phone/.test(found) && /address/.test(found), "VIN, phone and address listed as hidden");
  ok(/2026-09-14/.test(fields) && /94,812/.test(fields) && /189\.47/.test(fields), "date, mileage and total decoded");
  await p.screenshot({ path: path.join(SHOTS, "scan-review-phone.png") });
  /* sample the pixel under the VIN in the image that gets saved */
  const dark = await p.evaluate(() => new Promise(res => {
    const cv = document.getElementById("scanCv"), g = cv.getContext("2d");
    const d = g.getImageData(0, 0, cv.width, cv.height).data, at = (x, y) => { const i = (y * cv.width + x) * 4; return d[i] + d[i + 1] + d[i + 2]; };
    let blackVin = 0, blackWork = 0; for (let x = 300; x < 700; x += 20) { if (at(x, 800) < 60) blackVin++; if (at(x, 1000) < 60) blackWork++; }
    res({ blackVin, blackWork });
  }));
  ok(dark.blackVin >= 15, "VIN area is black in the image (" + dark.blackVin + "/20)");
  ok(dark.blackWork < 10, "work line is not blacked out (" + dark.blackWork + "/20)");
  await p.click("#scanSave");
  await p.waitForFunction(() => /unconfirmed/i.test(document.getElementById("gbStatus").textContent), null, { timeout: 15000 });
  const pending = await p.evaluate(() => ({ date: document.getElementById("gbRDate") && document.getElementById("gbRDate").value, miles: document.getElementById("gbRMiles") && document.getElementById("gbRMiles").value, html: document.getElementById("gbPreview").textContent }));
  ok(pending.date === "2026-09-14" && pending.miles === "94812", "Glovebox form prefilled (" + pending.date + ", " + pending.miles + ")");
  ok(!/1HGBH41JXMN109186|555-0142|Jordan/.test(pending.html), "no personal details in the prefilled form");

  /* 3. cancel stores nothing */
  const before = await p.evaluate(() => (window.__v60 && window.__v60.state ? (window.__v60.state().photos || []).length : -1));
  await p.setInputFiles("#gbFile", { name: "receipt.png", mimeType: "image/png", buffer: Buffer.from(png, "base64") });
  await p.waitForSelector("#scanOv:not([hidden])"); await p.click("#scanCancel");
  await p.waitForFunction(() => /Cancelled/.test(document.getElementById("gbStatus").textContent), null, { timeout: 10000 });
  ok(true, "cancel says nothing was saved");
  ok(errs.length === 0, "no page errors " + JSON.stringify(errs));
  await b.close(); srv.close();
  console.log(fails ? fails + " failed" : "all passed"); process.exit(fails ? 1 : 0);
})().catch(e => { console.error(e); srv.close(); process.exit(1); });
```

### `tests/story.js`

```javascript
/* Story-driven progression: hidden tabs, case closures, reveals, decoding, known risks, The File, Show everything. */
const { chromium } = require(process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_PATH||'playwright');
const path=require('path'),fs=require('fs');const ROOT=path.resolve(__dirname,'..');const SH=path.join(ROOT,'tests','shots')+'/';fs.mkdirSync(SH,{recursive:true});
```
